bsam pa'i rten ni dad sogs bsod nams kyi blo khyad par can dang ldan pa'o/ / gnyis pa rang bzhin la gsum ste/ ngo bo/ rgyu/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i don dang gsum las/ dang po ni theg chen lam gyi sems  gang yin (1) mtshan gzhi/ byang chub sems kyi tha snyad bya rung du mtshon/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod kyi sems smon 'jug gis bsdus pa gang zhig pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi ngo bor gyur pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ / ces so/ / dbye na bdun las/ gnyis tshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdus na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /zhes pa'ang mya ngan 'das pa las/ kun rdzob don dam dbye ba yis/ /byang chub sems de rnam gnyis te/ /sen ngha pa yi sgra bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /gsum tshan gyis dbye na/ tshul khrims gsum gyi rim pas/ dag par byed pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ gnas par byed pa sems kyi bslab pa/ grol bar byed pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i sems gsum gyi rnam pa gsum mo/ /bzhi tshan gyis dbye na/ tshogs sbyor na yod pa mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ sa bdun pa man chad dang po yan chad na yod pa lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems bskyed/ dag pa sa gsum na yod pa rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod pa sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ / mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib gnyis spangs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /lnga tshan gyis dbye na/ lam lnga'i sems bskyed pa lnga'o/ /drug tshan gyis dbye na/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi drug ste yum bar ma las/

pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa drug po gang dang ldan pas zhes so/ /sa mtshams kyi dbye ba dpes mtshon pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*/ /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma klu/ /rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni/ /sgra brnyan chu bo sprin rnams kyi/ /rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes so/ /dpe de dag gis mtshon pa'i don ni/ 'grel pa las/ 'dun pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ smon lam dang*/ stobs dang*/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ ye shes dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang*/ mthun pa'i chos dang*/ snying rje dang*/lhag mthong dang*/ gzungs dang*/ spobs pa dang*/ chos kyi dga' ston dang*/ bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang*/ chos kyi sku dang ldan pa ni zhes so/ /de'ang dang po gsum ni tshogs lam gsum la'o/ /sbyor ba ni sbyor lam na'o/ /sbyin pa nas ye shes kyi bar bcu ni sa bcu la'o/ / mngon shes nas gzungs spobs kyi bar lnga ni dag pa sa gsum la'o/ /phyi ma gsum po sa bcu pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi rjes gsum na yod do/ / de'ang khas blangs pa'i cho gas thob pa'i sems bskyed ni slob lam na yod kyi sangs rgyas kyi sa na med do/ /thugs rje chen po sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems bskyed kyis don mdzad pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod par shes par bya'o/ /so so'i don la bdun las/ smon 'jug gi don ni/ gzhan don du bsam pas smon pa ni 'gro bar 'dod pa lta bu/ smon pa sems bskyed/ 'jug pas spyod pa 'gro bzhin pa lta bu 'jug pa'i sems bskyed de/

spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /bslab pa gsum gyi don ni mi dge ba'i phyogs las rgyud sdom pa ni tshul khrims/ ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa dge ba gong mar spel ba ni sems/ don gnyis bsgrub cing shes bya 'byed pa ni shes rab kyi bslab pa'o/ / sa rim gyi don ni rigs la mos pas spyi yul du byed dus mos pas spyod pa phyogs re mthong ba na lhag bsam dag pa/ zhing khams dag pa la sogs pa dbang thob (1) dus rnam par smin pa de bzhin nyid sgrib pa kun dang bral dus sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed ces bya'o/ /lam lnga'i don ni (2) las dang po pa'i tshe/ thos bsam dang bsod nams kyi tshogs gtso cher spyod pas tshogs lam/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mthong lam la sbyor bas sbyor lam/ chos nyid dngos su mthong bas mthong lam/ mthong zin sgom par byed pas sgom lam/ bslab bya mthar thug nas bsgom du med pas mi slob pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi don ni yo byad ser sna med par gzhan la gtong sems dge ba sbyin pa/ nyes spyod las sems bsrung ba tshul khrims/ rnam 'tshe bzod pas bzod pa/ dge ba la spro bas brtson 'grus/ dmigs pa gcig la rtse gcig tu 'jog pas bsam gtan/ chos kyi rang bzhin shes pa shes rab bo/ /sa mtshams dpe'i sgo nas shes pa'i don la/ slob dpon mche ba'i sde la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lam thams cad smon pa dang*/ bden mthong yan chad kyi sems bskyed 'jug par 'dod la/ a bh+yā ka ra la sogs pa (1) kha cig tshogs lam pa'i sems bskyed chung 'bring che gsum smon par 'dod la/ sbyor lam yan chad bcu dgu po ril por 'jug par 'dod de/ 'dun sogs gsum gyi dbye ba yis/ /smon pa'i sems ni rnam pa gsum/

/'jug pa sems zhes bya ba ni/ /rnam pa bcu dgu dag tu bzhed/ /ces so/ /rgya mtsho sprin la sogs pa byang chub thob 'dod kyi blos ma bskyed pa smon pa/ bskyed pa 'jug par 'dod pa la sogs pa mang yang*/ 'dir gzhan don du byang chub 'dod pa ni smon pa/ sbyor bas khyab nas zhugs pa ni 'jug pa ste/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad du 'dod pa yin no/ / gnyis pa rgyu ni sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa'i dad pa/ sems can la dmigs pa snying rje/ byang chub sems kyi phan yon thos pa dang gsum las skye ba nyid de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ / thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba/ / gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces pa dang*/ dkon mchog ta la la'i mdo las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*/ /byang chub bla na med la dad gyur la/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed na/ /blo dang ldan pa rnams kyi sems skye'o/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug go /dang po la lnga las/ spyod pa rlabs che ba ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan sems mchog skyes ma thag tu yang*/ /mtha' yas nyes pa byed las sems rab bsdams/ /gnyis 'phel byed pas rtag tu dge ba dang*/ /brtse ldan bde dang sdug bsngal dag gis dga'/ /zhes so/ /de la gzhan dag gi phyir bdag gis dka' ba byas pa na/ gzhan bde bas dga' la/ rang dka' spyad kyis sdug bsngal ba la dga' ba skyes pa'o/ /mtshan don ldan thob pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur pa'i skad cig la/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*/ / 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /ces so/ /'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa ni/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang ci 'dod kyang rung ste bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cig dang thob par 'gyur ro zhes pa dang*/

byang chub kyi sems ni 'dod pa thams cad 'grub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /sdig pa thams cad zad par byed pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /ces so/ /dge ba rlabs po che 'phel ba ni gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*/ /gal te de la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de las lhag par 'gyur/ /ces dang*/ gtam byar/ skyes bu gang zhig byang chub sems/ /skad cig tsam zhig sgom byed pa/ /de yi bsod nams phung po ni/ /rgyal ba yis kyang bgrang mi spyod/ /ces so/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas myur du thob pa ste/ sdong po bkod pa las/ myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'dod na bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bur/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan gzung*/ /zhes so/ / de'ang sems ma bskyed na sangs rgyas su mi 'grub la bskyed na 'grub pa'i 'thad pa yang*/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ byang chub sems ni ma bskyed par/ /sangs rgyas nam yang mi 'thob cing*/ /'khor bar bdag gzhan don bsgrub pa'i/ /thabs gzhan yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa shes nas sems bskyed pa'i tshul la gsum las/ sbyor ba ni dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa bshams ste/ slob mas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed pa'i phan yon la sogs pas blo bcos te/ sems tsam pa ltar na bar chad dri ba dang bslab pa khas blang pa la sogs pa byas nas sems bskyed 'bogs kyang*/ 'dir dbu ma pa'i lugs kyis/

phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ sdig pa bshags pa/ dge la yi rang ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba/ dge ba sems can la bsngo ba ste/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ dngos gzhi ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi bder gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes pa lan gsum brjod do/ /rjes ni phan yon brjod pas spro bar bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*/ /  rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste (1) / /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes pa la sogs pa brjod nas/ srung thabs kyang bshad do/ / gsum pa bsrung bya bslab pa'i rang bzhin la gnyis te/ bslab pa'i rab tu dbye ba dang*/ de ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis las/ sems tsam pa ni rtsa ltung bzhir 'dod de/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po ni/ /pham pa 'dra bar dgongs pa yin/ /rnyed dang bkur stir chags pa yis/ / bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*/ / sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la/ / ser snas chos nor mi ster dang*/ /gzhan gyis bshags (2) kyang mi nyan par/ / khros pas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang*/ /theg pa chen po spong byed cing*/ /dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o/ /zhes so/ /dbu ma pa ni bcu dgu 'am nyi shur 'dod de/

bslab btus su/ rgyal po la nges (3) pa lnga/ blon po la nges (4) pa lnga/ phal ba la nges (5) pa brgyad/ thun mong pa gnyis sam gcig go /dang po ni dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i dge slong la/ chad pa gcod pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba bslab pa las 'bebs pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa dang*/ log par lta ba 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa lnga ni/ grong dang*/ ljongs dang*/ grong khyer dang*/ grong rdal dang*/ yul 'khor 'joms pa'o/ / gsum pa (1) brgyad ni/ blo ma sbyangs pa la stong pa nyid ston pa dang*/ theg chen la zhugs pa phyir bzlog pa dang*/ so sor thar pa spangs te/ theg chen la sbyor ba dang*/ nyan rang gi theg pa 'dzin cing 'dzin du 'jug pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur gyi phyir bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod pa dang*/ rang gis zab mo bzod par smra ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor sbyin cing len pa dang*/ zhi gnas pa'i nor kha ton pa la sbyin pa'o/ /thun mong pa smon pa btang ba dang*/ de'i steng du 'jug pa btang ba bsnan pas nyi shur gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul ni/ spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces/ / bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor/ /ces pas/ dran pa dang shes bzhin ma nyams pas/ nag po'i chos bzhi dor nas/ dkar po'i chos bzhi spyad pa la bslab par bya'o/ /nag po'i chos bzhi ni/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub kyi sems brjed par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslus pa dang*/ gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la bsngags pa ma yin pa'i mi snyan pa dang*/ brjod pa ma yin pa'i sgras tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa dang*/ sgyu dang g.yos gzhan la nye bar spyod kyis lhag pa'i bsam pas ma yin pa ste zhes so/

/dkar po'i chos bzhi 'ang de nyid las/ 'od srungs byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na skye ba thams cad du skyes ma thag tu byang chub kyi sems mngon du 'gyur zhing*/ byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du bar ma dor brjed par mi 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na srog gi phyir ram tha na bzhad bgad kyi phyir yang rdzun gyi tshig mi smra ba dang*/ sgyu dang g.yo med par sems can thams cad kyi drung na lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing de dag gi yang dag pa'i bsngags pa phyogs bzhir brjod pa dang*/ nyi tshe ba'i theg pa mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ sems can gang rnams yongs su smin par byed pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa ste zhes so/ /de bzhin du 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las kyang*/ gzhon nu 'du shes bzhi dang ldan na byang chub kyi sems brtan por 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang*/ des bstan pa'i chos la lam gyi 'du shes dang*/ de la

(1) sgrub pa rnams la lam gyi grogs kyi 'du shes dang*/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa'i 'du shes so zhes so/ /gal te'am rgya la nyams na'ang 'gyod pas nyes pa bshags la slar yang blangs pas sor chud par 'gyur te/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na nyin mtshan rtag tu spang bya rnams spong zhing bsgrub bya rnams bsgrubs pas gzhan gyi don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang ma bral ba la bslab par bya'o/ / 'di dag gi don rgyas par ni nges don shing rta chen po las rig par bya'o/ / sems bskyed pa'i tshul bshad zin to/ /don gsum pa tshul des lam ji ltar bgrod pa'i tshul la lnga ste/ tshogs dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ bsgom pa dang*/ mi slob pa'i lam bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rten dang*/ rang bzhin gnyis las/ rten ni theg chen gyi sems bskyed gsar du skyes pa'i rten gang yin pa de'o/ /de'ang theg chen sems bskyed dang por thob nas tshogs lam chung ngur 'jug nus pa yin no/ /rang bzhin la/ rgyu/ 'bras bu/ ngo bo gsum las/ rgyu ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs theg chen la thos bsam byas pas sad pa'o/ / 'bras bu ni sbyor mthong sgom gsum mi slob lam dang bzhi'o/ /ngo bo la mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ rab tu dbye ba/ khyad par gyi chos dang bzhi las/ dang po ni theg chen la dang po zhugs nas theg chen drod ma skyes kyi bar theg chen sems bskyed dang ma bral pa'i dge ba mtshan gzhi/ theg chen tshogs lam gyi tha snyad bya rung du mtshon/ sangs rgyas thob byed kyi dge ba las dang po pas bsdus pa/ gang zhig theg chen gyi drod sogs nges 'byed cha mthun gyi skad cig dang po shes rgyud la skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa ste 'grel chung las/ thar ba'i cha dang mthun pa skyes pa'i spro ba can la nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'byung bas so zhes so/

/ mtshan gzhi ni theg chen la dang po zhugs pa nas theg chen gyi sbyor lam ma skyes kyi bar gyi rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pas kun nas bslang ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ dbang po'i sgo sdom pa dang*/ zas kyi tshod shes pa dang*/ nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson pa dang*/ blang dor gyi bya ba shes bzhin du gnas pas dga' ba dang*/ dge ba la mi 'gyod pa dang*/ spro ba dang dad pa dang*/ mos pa la sogs pa thar ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba gzhan dang*/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyis bsdus pa/ sbyor lam skye ba'i 'os su gyur pa rnams so/ /dbye na tshogs lam chung ngu*/ 'bring*/ chen po gsum mo/ /chung ngu ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi mgo brtsam pa la zhugs pa/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi sgom pa'i dus sbyor lam skye ba'i dus ma nges pa'o/ /de'ang theg bsdus las/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dag /sems brtan khyad par 'gro ba yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' grangs med gsum/ /kun tu brtson par mdzad ces brjod/ /ces so/ /'bring ni yang dag spong ba bzhi bsgom pa'i dus sbyor lam tshe phyi ma phan chod kyi skye dus nges pa'o/ /chen po ni rdzu'aphrul gyi rkang pa bzhi bsgom pa'i dus sbyor lam tshe de nyid la skye bar nges pa'o/ /khyad par gyi chos lnga las/ gnyen po'i khyad par ni zag bcas kyi 'du byed rnams la nyes dmigs su lta ba rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po'o/ /spangs ba'i khyad par ni zag bcas kyi 'du byed la skyon du mthong bas mngon par zhen pa spangs pa'o/ /rtogs pa'i khyad par ni/ bdag med gnyis thos bsam gyi shes rab kyis/ don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa shas che zhing sgom byung gi rtogs pa'ang yod de kun las btus las sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyang rung ste zhes so/ /yon tan gyi khyad par ni sems las su rung bas byang chub kyi lam sna zin pa dang*/

ting nge 'dzin zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la/ blo gnas pa la sogs pa'o/ /de'i mthus spyan dang mngon par shes pa la sogs pa 'thob cing*/ sangs rgyas sprul ba'i sku las gdams ngag thos par bshad de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de tshe chos kyi rgyun las ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la zhi gnas dang*/ /ye shes yangs pa thob bya'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni rnams su 'gro/ /der ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing*/ /gdams ngag rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /ces so/ / bsgom bya'i gdams ngag gi khyad par la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po spyi'i dbang du byas te tshogs lam gsum kar lus ngag gi 'jug ldog la dmigs pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ gsung rab kyi tshig don la dmigs pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab dang*/ chos kyi phyag rgya bzhi dang*/ thar pa cha mthun lnga dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ gtong ba dang*/ lus dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ skye ba dang*/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba rnams rjes su dran pa'o/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i bsgom tshul ni sems bskyed nas/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang*/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin 'khor ba sdug bsngal dang*/ chos thams cad bdag med pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi bar bsgom pa'i rjes la bsngo ba byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du rang gzhan gyi tshe mi rtag pas 'chi ba rjes su dran pa bsgom pa dang*/ lus mi gtsang pa'i 'du shes dgu dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad dang*/ spyod yul yongs su dag pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /de la spyod pa rnams sbyong ba'i chos ni dug gsum spyi'i gnyen por bsgom pa ste/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ 'dod chags shas che mi gtsang sha tshil dang*/ pags pa keng rus blta bas rnam par bzlog /byams dang snying rje'i chus gdab zhe sdang la/ /gti mug la ni rten 'brel lam gyis so/ /zhes so/ /mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes dgu ni/

ro rnam par bam pa dang*/ 'bus gzhig pa dang*/ dmar ba dang*/ sngo ba dang*/ gnag pa dang*/ zos pa dang*/ 'thor ba dang*/ 'tshig pa dang*/ rul ba'i 'du shes bsgom pa'o/ / skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad ni/ bdag gis nam zhig sems can gyi sdug bsngal sel nus snyam pa dang*/ nam zhig dbul bas nyen pa'i sems can rnams 'byor ba chen po la 'jog nus snyam pa dang*/ nam zhig sha khrag dang bcas pa'i lus 'dis sems can gyi don byed nus snyam pa dang*/ nam zhig dmyal bar yun ring du gnas nas kyang sems can gyi don byed nus snyam pa dang*/ nam zhig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'byor ba chen pos sems can gyi re ba rdzogs par byed nus snyam pa dang*/ nam zhig sangs rgyas su gyur nas sems can gyi sdug bsngal nges par 'byin nus snyam pa dang*/ sems can la mi phan pa'i skye ba dang don dam pa'i ro la gcig tu spyod pa dang*/ skye bo thams cad tshim par mi byed pa'i tshig dang*/ gzhan la mi phan pa'i 'tsho ba dang lus dang shes rab dang nor dang dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang*/ gzhan la gnod par byed pa la dga' bar tshe rabs thams cad du ma gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ sems can gyi sdug pa'i 'bras bu bdag la smin cing bdag gi dge ba'i 'bras bu de dag la smin par gyur cig snyam du sems pa yin no zhes gzhung 'grel las bshad pa ltar ro/ /spyod yul yongs su dag pa ni mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras spyod tshe ji lta ji lta bur/ /dbang po'i 'du shes sna tshogs 'jug gyur pa/ / de lta de ltar rigs shing mthun tshig gis/ /sems can phan phyir de mngon 'du byed do/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ phal po che'i spyod yul yongs su dag pa bzhin shes par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' khang pa'i nang du 'jug pa'i tshe sems can thams cad kyis thar pa'i grong khyer thob par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do zhes pa sbyar te/

nyal pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par/ rmi lam rmis na chos thams cad rmi lam ltar rtogs par/ gnyid sad tsa na ma rig pa las sad par/ ldang ba na sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku thob par/ gos gyon na ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi gos gyon par/ ske rags 'ching ba na dge ba'i rtsa ba zung du 'brel bar/ stan la 'dug pa na rdo rje'i stan thob par gyur cig snyam du sems bskyed do zhes pa la sogs pa  gsung pa (1) bzhin nyams su blang ngo*/ / dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba ni ting nge 'dzin bsgrub pa'i sngon rol ba'i thabs rnam rtog 'dul ba ste/ kha dang sna'i rlung mda' gang du phar song tshur 'ong ba'i khug pa la sems bzung bas rtog pa 'dul ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kun rdzob pa byams sogs tshad med bzhi dang*/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la dran bsam 'phro 'du med pa sgom par byed de/ spyod 'jug las/ rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba dang*/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bsgom pa'i (2) tshul gsum las/ tshogs lam chung ngur dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ bsgom pa'i dang po lus dran pa nyer bzhag ni/ mnyam gzhag tu nam mkha' ltar bsgom zhing*/ rjes thob tu mi gtsang ba dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu la sogs par bsgom mo/ /tshor ba dran pa nyer gzhag la'ang mnyam gzhag tu ma skyes pa dang*/ rjes thob tu gang ci tshor yang sdug bsngal dang*/ chu shing ltar snying po med par bsgom mo/ /sems la'ang mnyam gzhag tu rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang*/ rjes thob tu mi 'gag la mi gnas par bsgom mo/ /chos la'ang mnyam gzhag tu mnyam pa (1) nyid dang*/ rjes thob tu sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de'ang tshogs lam chung ngu dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi bsgoms pas mthong lam gyi bden pa bzhi la 'jug go /'di ltar dang pos lus sdug bsngal du shes pas sdug bsngal shes pa la 'jug go /gnyis pas tshor ba sdug bsngal du shes pas kun 'byung spong ba la 'jug go

/sems mi rtag par bsgoms pas rtag 'dzin 'gag pa'i 'gog pa mngon du byed pa la 'jug ga ོ / chos bdag med par bsgoms pas bdag tu zhen pa log nas lam bsgom pa la 'jug ste/ dbus mtha' las/ gnas ngan len phyir sred rgyu'i phyir/ /gzhi yi phyir dang ma rmongs phyir/ /bden pa bzhi la 'jug bya bas/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bsgom/ /zhes so/ /tshogs lam 'bring du mi dge ba'i chos rnams ma skyes pa mi bskyed/ skyes pa rgyun gcad pa'i phyir dang*/ dge ba'i chos rnams ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa gong du spel pa'i phyir/ brtson par byed cing gnyen po bdag med pa dang*/ sgyu ma'am rmi lam la sogs pa sgom par byed de/ de nyid las/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po rnams/ /rnam pa thams cad yongs shes nas/ /mi dge spang phyir brtson 'grus ni/ /rnam pa bzhi dag rab tu 'byung*/ / zhes so/ /tshogs lam chen por rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi bsgom pa yang*/ nang du sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhi lhag zung 'brel du bsgoms pas spyan dang mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i 'dod don 'grub pa ste/ dbus mtha' las/ der gnas las su rung ba nyid/ /don rnams thams cad 'byor bar 'gyur/ /ces so/ /skabs 'dir rju 'phrul la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi sems las su rung stobs kyis 'grub pa'i phyir rju 'phrul gyi rkang pa zhes bya'o/ /de'ang 'dun pa/ brtson 'grus/ sems/ dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi'o/ /'di ltar dang por dmigs rten gcig la yid bsdus nas lhan ne bzhag dus/ rnam rtog 'phro na de ma thag ma 'byams par dmigs rten la sems rtse gcig tu bsdus la/ yang yang de ltar bsgoms pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa nyid la sems gtad nas/ /de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya/ /rnam g.yeng myur du rtogs byas nas/ /slar yang de la blan par bya/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa sbyor ba'i lam la'ang*/

rten dang*/ rang bzhin gnyis las/ rten ni gnyis/ lus kyi rten 'gro ba rigs lnga gang rung ngo*/ /bsam pa'i rten ni bsam gtan sa drug gang rung yin no/ /rang bzhin la/ rgyu/ 'bras bu/ ngo bo gsum las/ dang po ni theg chen tshogs lam ste/ dbus mtha' las/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun bskyed nas/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu ni mthong sgom mi slob pa'i lam gsum mo/ /ngo bo la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba/ khyad par gyi chos dang bzhi las/ mtshan nyid ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam rdzogs la (1) mthong lam gyi sngar byung ba'i dge ba theg chen du gtogs pa rnams mtshan gzhi theg chen sbyor lam gyi tha snyad bya rung du mtshon/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam rdzogs pa'i rjes la 'byung zhing theg chen du gtogs pa gang zhig theg pa chen po mthong lam skad cig dang po shes rgyud la skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa'o/ /dbye na drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog bzhi'o/ /de'ang drod rtse gnyis su dbang po lnga dang*/ bzod chos gnyis su stobs lnga bsgom pa ste/ dbus mtha' las/ dbang po rnams dang stobs rnams la/ /nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis gnyis so/ /zhes so/ /de la dbang po lnga ni/ dad pa'i dbang po/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po/ dran pa'i dbang po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po/ shes rab gyi dbang po dang lnga'o/ /ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ sems bskyed nas/ bden pa bzhi'i mi rtag pa la sogs pa'am 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden pa gnyis su shes pa'i don la/ dad pas yid ches pa'i tshul gyis bsgom/ brtson 'grus gyis spro ba/ dran pas rtogs pa ma brjed pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse gcig shes rab kyis ni rang bzhin shes pa'i tshul gyis bsgom mo/ /de'ang rnam byang bskyed pa la (1) dbang po zhes brjod de/ de nyid las/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun bskyed nas/ /'dun dang sbyor bas dbang byed de/ /dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang*/ /mi 'phro rnam par 'byed kyang ngo/

/zhes so/ /stobs lnga ni/ dad pa'i stobs la sogs pa lnga ste/ sgom tshul dbang po dang mthun no/ /de'ang mi mthun phyogs 'joms pas stobs zhes bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mi mthun phyogs nyams chung bas na/ /de dag nyid la stobs zhes bya/ /zhes so/ /'di ltar sbyor lam cha bzhi bsgom dus kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo mnyam gzhag gi cha ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la/ de las langs pa'i rjes thob ni rtog pa rtog med ci rigs su yod do/ /'o na rnam rtog bzhi po ldan rten pa zhes pas rtog pa ma yin nam zhe na/ rnam rtog ldan pas rtog par 'gro na zhwa can zhwar 'gyur te zhwa ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang rnam rtog bzhi po brten pa mi zer ba'i phyir/ rang rgyu 'dra ba las 'bras bu 'dra ba rjes su byed de/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ ko ṭa ba yi sa bon las/ /sā lu'i myu gu mi 'byung ltar/ /de bzhin rnam par rtog bcas las/ /rnam par rtog med 'byung mi 'gyur/ /ces pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gi tshul rgyas par ni kho bos byas pa'i rin chen them skas na gsal bas der blta'o/ /ye shes de dag gi rim pa'ang chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum gsum gyi dbye bas nges 'byed cha mthun bcu gnyis zhes bya ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ /

chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin/ /ces so/ /de dag gi rim pa yang bzhi las/ drod snang ba thob pa ni chos thams cad yid kyi snang ba tsam du mthong ba 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gi ye shes/ snang ba cung zad thob pa des don du 'dzin pa'i gnyen po byed pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de nas de 'drar gyur ba yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam gzhag pas/ /yid kyi brjod pa ma gtogs par/ /don kun rab tu mi mthong ngo*/ /zhes so/ /rtse mo snang ba mched pa ni/ chos kyi snang ba de nyid spel ba'i phyir bdag med bsgom pa la brtson pas 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gi snang ba 'bring du thob pa yin te/ de nyid las/ chos kyi snang ba 'phel bya'i phyir/ /brtson 'grus brtan pas kun tu brtsam/ /zhes so/ /bzod pa de kho na nyid kyi phyogs gcig la zhugs pa ni sems tsam du gnas pa'i 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gi snang ba rab tu thob pas phyi rol don du zhen pa'i gnyen po byed pa yin te/ de nyid las/ chos kyi snang ba 'phel nas ni/ /sems tsam la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas don kun snang ba ni/ /sems su rab tu snang bar 'gyur/ /de tshe de yi gzung ba yis/ /rnam par g.yeng ba de spong 'gyur/ /de nas de la 'dzin pa yi/ /rnam par g.yeng ba 'ba' zhig bsdus/ /zhes so/ /chos mchog de ma thag pa ni/ don du 'dzin pa'i rnam g.yeng med pa'i 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gi snang ba yongs su rdzogs pa/ theg chen mthong lam dang gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa yin te/ de nyid las/ de tshe bar chad med pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la myur du reg /ces so/ /de 'ang drod rtse mo gnyis ni chung ngu ste/ mthong lam skye ba'i dus ma nges pa'i sbyor lam mo/ /bzod pa ni 'bring ste tshe phyi ma la skye bar nges pa'i sbyor lam mo/ /chos mchog ni chen po ste/ tshe de nyid la mthong lam skye ba'i sbyor lam mo/ / bzhi pa khyad par gyi chos la lnga las/

gnyen po'i khyad par ni spong ba gnyen po las/ mgo gnon no/ /spyir gnyen po la bzhi ste/ sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po/ spong ba'i gnyen po/ rten gyi gnyen po/ thag bsring gi gnyen po'o/ /spangs pa'i khyad par ni sgrib pa'i sa bon dang mngon 'gyur nyams smad pa dang so so skye bo'i phongs pa dang rgud pa las grol ba'o/ /rtogs pa'i khyad par ni sgom byung gi ye shes kyis bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'o/ /yon tan gyi khyad par ni ting nge 'dzin dang spyan dang mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa du ma dang ldan pa'o/ /tshogs lam las 'phags pa'i khyad par ni tshogs lam chen po dang sgom byung du 'dra yang*/ mthong lam la nye ring dang ye shes kyi drod brtan mi brtan gyis khyad yod de/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ bar chad med na mthong ba'i lam ches nye bar 'byung ba zhes bya ba ni thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa las 'di'i khyad par yin par rig par bya'o zhes so/ /gsum pa mthong ba'i lam la yang*/ rten dang*/ rang bzhin gnyis las/ rten ni gnyis kyi lus kyi rten 'gro ba lnga gang rung ste/ blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'dod pa dang gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams las bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de'ang chos kyi mig rdul med ces pas mthong lam thob pa yin la/ shin tu rnam par dag go zhes pa ni sa (1) brgyad pa'i ye shes so/ / bsam pa'i rten ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'o/ /rang bzhin la/ rgyu/ 'bras bu/ ngo bo gsum las/ rgyu ni theg chen tshogs sbyor ro/ /'bras bu ni sgom lam dang mi slob lam gnyis so/ /ngo bo la mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang bzhi las/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg pa chen po pa'i chos bzod chos shes rjes bzod rjes shes 'khor dang bcas pa mtshan nyid/ theg chen mthong lam gyi tha snyad bya rung du mtshon/

theg chen gyi sbyor lam rdzogs pa'i rjes la 'byung zhing theg chen gyi dge bas bsdus pa gang zhig theg chen 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam skad cig dang po shes rgyud la skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni ( 2 ) sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam gyi bden pa bzhi po re re la'ang chos shes pa'ibazod pa/ chos shes pa/ rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa/ rjes su shes pa bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa'am/ sa'i dbang du byas na/ dang po rab tu dga' ba'o/ /de'ang mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ /chos shes rjes su shes pa dang*/ /bzod shes skad cig bcu drug ni/ /zhes so/ /de'ang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes thog mar thob pa de'i tshe dga' ba rgya chen po sngon bas 'phags pa thob pas rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub la yang nye ba dang*/ /sems can don grub mthong ba la/ /rab tu dga' ba skyes gyur te/ /de phyir rab dga' zhes brjod do/ /zhes so/ /dbye na bden pa bzhi'i rim pas skad cig bcu drug gi rang bzhin can rnams so/ /khyad par gyi chos la lnga las/ dang po gnyen po'i khyad par ni chos bzod bzhi ni mthong spangs kyi sa bon rtsa ba nas spong ba'i gnyen po bar chad med lam mo/ /chos shes bzhi ni rten gnyen po rnam grol gyi lam mo/ /rjes bzod bzhi dang rjes shes bzhi ni thag bsring gi gnyen po khyad par gyi lam mo/ /de'ang sdug bsngal la chos shes pa/ kun 'byung*/ 'gog pa/ lam bzhi'i chos shes pa bzhi/ blo rdzas gcig gi ngo bo bden bzhi'i ldog pa la ltos nas bzhir bzhag pa bzhin du/ de dag gi rjes bzod dang*/ rjes su shes pa'ang mthun no/ /spangs pa'i khyad par la ngo bo dang*/ rnam grangs gnyis las/ ngo bo ni rang gi ngo skal du gyur tshad kyi mthong spangs nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gnyis kyi cha las grol ba ste/

dbus mtha' las/ nyon mongs pa yi sgrib pa dang*/ / shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis su bstan/ /der ni sgrib pa thams cad de/ /de zad nas ni grol bar 'dod/ /ces so/ /de dag gi ngo bo ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang*/ /nyon mongs pa yi sgrib par 'dod/ /'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*/ /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ces pas/ sems rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa gang mi dge ba'am/ sgrib la lung du ma bstan pa'i ngo bo ser sna la sogs pa ni nyon sgrib yin la/ 'khor gsum la bden zhen dang ma bral ba gang dge ba zag bcas sam ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gyi ngo bo gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa yul yul can ni shes sgrib yin no/ /de dag las nyon sgrib kun brtags rnams ni mthong spangs yin la/ lhan skyes ni sgom spangs yin no/ / shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa rags pa rnams ni mthong spangs yin la/ phra ba rnams ni sgom spangs yin no/ / gnyis pa rnam grangs la gsum ste/ mthong spangs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ ji ltar spong tshul lo/ /dang po ni kun brtags gang zhig mthong lam gyi gnod byar gyur pa'o/ /dbye ba la gsum las/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na drug ste/ lta ba/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom mo/ /log par 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba/ log par lta ba/ lta ba la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba ste lnga dang*/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom ste lta min lnga ste bcu'o/ /dmigs pa dang (1) khams dang log par 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na mthong spangs brgya (2) bcu gnyis so/ /de'ang lta ba lngas 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la sogs pa bzhi la zhugs pa na/ lta min lngas rjes su mthun par zhugs te bcu bcu yod pas bzhi bcu/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi bden pa bzhi la/

khong khro ma gtogs pa dgu dgu 'jug pas/ bsam gtan gyi sa'i bden pa bzhi la sum cu rtsa drug gzugs med kyi bden pa bzhi la sum cu rtsa drug rnams bsdoms pas brgya rtsa bcu gnyis yod pa ni/ kun las btus las/ nyon mongs pa (1) brgya rtsa bcu gnyis ni mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa'i ris zhes so/ /ji ltar spong pa'i tshul ni mthong spangs kyi sa bon mgo non gyi tshul gyis ni nges 'byed cha mthun gyis spong la/ rtsa 'don gyi tshul gyis ni chos shes pa'i bzod pa la sogs pas spong ngo*/ /de'ang bden pa bzhi'i chos shes pas bzod pa'i dngos rgyu dang dus mnyam du tshogs pa'i mthong spangs kyi sa bon gyis nyer len gyi rgyu byas/ dngos rgyu des lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas/ chos bzod dang (2) dus mnyam pa'i sa bon rabs chad po skyed/ de la 'jig byed gzhan mi dgos par skad cig gis 'jig pas na/ skad cig gnyis pa la/ chos shes kyi mthong spangs kyi sa bon las grol ba'i gnas 'gyur thob pa yin no/ /rjes bzod bzhi dang*/ rjes shes bzhi ni rang rang gi spang bya ches phra'i gnyen po mthong lam gyi ye shes snga ma gnyis kyi rjes su skyes pa/ sa bon las grol ba spang bya thag sring byed yin no/ /de'ang bden bzhi so so'i skad cig dang de'i spang bya la ltos nas dri ma rim pa'i gnyen po byed la/ ye shes skye ba la ltos nas bar chad med pa dang rnam grol lam gnyis chos bzod du byung dus ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam zhes bzhag ga ོ /de dag gi spang bya nus ldan dang*/ ye shes kyi brgyud rgyu phrad pas mgo mnan/ nus med dang dngos rgyu phrad pas nyams dman/ ye shes dngos skye dus spang bya sa bon dang bcas pa 'gags pa dus mnyam/ ye shes lhag mas thag bsring rnam grol lam du song (3) ba'i gnyen po byed pa yin no/ /dus kyi khyad par ni dang por bden pa bzhis phye ba'i chos bzod bzhi dus gcig la skye/

de'i 'og tu chos shes bzhi dus gcig la skye/ de'i 'og tu rjes bzod bzhi dus gcig la skye/ de'i 'og tu rjes shes bzhi dus gcig la skye bas/ bya rdzogs kyi skad cig bzhi la ngo bo rigs bzhi ldog pa bcu drug tu skye ba yin te/ bden bzhi cig car du rtogs shing bzod shes bzhi rim gyis skye ba'i phyir ro/ /rtogs pa'i khyad par ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyis bdag med gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'o/ /de'ang chos kyi dbyings de rang gzhan thams cad la kun tu 'gro ba ste/ khyad par rtogs pas bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid byang chub kyi sems rtogs pa'o/ /yon tan gyi khyad par ni dus skad cig la ston nus pa'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis dang*/ spyan dang*/ mngon shes dang*/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod do/ /de'ang dus skad cig ma la sangs rgyas brgyas zhal lta ba/ sangs rgyas brgyas byin gyis brlabs par shes pa/ sprul pa brgya 'gyed pa/ dus skad cig bskal pa brgyar ston pa/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' brgya la ye shes 'jug pa/ ting nge 'dzin brgya la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang ba/ sems can brgya smin par byed pa/ zhing brgya g.yo bar byed pa/ zhing brgya 'od kyis gsal bar byed pa/ chos kyi sgo mo brgya 'byed pa/ rang gi lus brgyar ston pa/ lus re re la yang 'khor phun sum tshogs pa brgya brgyas bskor bar ston pa'o/ /sa 'dir gnas pa des 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal po'i skye ba 'dzin par nus so/ / bzhi pa bsgom pa'i lam la'ang*/ rten dang*/ rang bzhin gnyis las/ rten la lus kyi rten ni gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med 'dod gzugs kyi lha dang bcas pa la skye ba shas che zhing*/ gzhan la'ang skyer rung ste mdo sde rgyan las/ bsam bzhin srid pa len pa dang*/ /zhes pas grub bo/ /sems kyi rten ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'o/ /rang bzhin la/

rgyu/ 'bras bu/ ngo bo gsum las/ rgyu ni theg chen gyi lam dang po gsum mo/ /'bras bu ni mi slob pa'i lam mo/ / ngo bo la mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang bzhi las/ mtshan nyid ni sa gnyis pa yar bcad rgyun mtha' mar bcad kyi theg chen gyi lam mtshan gzhi/ theg chen sgom lam gyi tha snyad bya rung du mtshon/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs pa'i rjes las 'byung zhing theg chen gyi dge bas bsdus pa gang zhig theg chen mi slob pa'i lam gyi skad cig dang po shes rgyud la skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni sa bcu'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor du gtogs pa'i dge ba rnams so/ /dbye na sgom lam chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum las gsum gsum (1) phye bas dgu'o/ /de'ang chung ngu'i chung ngu sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa ste/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog tu gyur pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'chal tshul rtsol ba'i dri bral phyir/ /dri ma med pa'i sa zhes bya/ /zhes so/ /chung ngu'i 'bring sa gsum pa 'od byed pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ de nyid las/ chos kyi snang pa chen po ni/ /byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa/ /zhes so/ /chung ngu'i chen po sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de nyid las/ 'di ltar byang chub phyogs mthun chos/ /rab tu sreg byed 'od lta bu/ /de dang ldan phyir sa de ni/ /gnyis po bsregs pas 'od 'phro can/ /zhes so/ / 'bring gi chung ngu sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba ni/ (2) yang de nyid las/ sems can rnams yongs smin byed cing*/ /rang gi sems kyang bsrung ba'i phyir/ /blo ldan rnams kyis sbyang dka' ba/ /de phyir sbyang dka' zhes brjod do/ /zhes so/ / 'bring gi 'bring sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa ste/ de nyid las/ shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/

/gnyis 'dir mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/ /mngon du gyur pa'i sa zhes bya/ /zhes so/ /'bring gi chen po sa bdun pa ring du song ba thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ de nyid las/ bgrod gcig lam dang 'brel pa'i phyir/ /ring du song ba'i sar 'dod do/ /zhes pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las/ 'khor ba mtsho yi'adam brgal bas/ /de la ring du song zhes bya/ /zhes so/ /chen po'i chung ngu sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo'i phyir/ /mi g.yo ba yi sar 'dod do/ /zhes so/ /chen po'i 'bring (1) smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa can legs pa'i blo gros ni/ de nyid las/ so so yang dag rigs blo bzang*/ /sa de legs pa'i blo gros yin/ /ces so/ /chen po'i chen po sa bcu pa chos ky-i sprin ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ de nyid las/ sprin bzhin gnyis kyis nam mkha'i khams/ /khyab pa'i phyir na chos kyi sprin/ /ces so/ /de'ang ting 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sprin gnyis gdul bya'i nam mkhar khyab pas/ chos kyi char 'bab pas don byed pa de bzhin gshegs pa lta bu ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni/ /rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*/ /sems can yang dag sgrol ba la/ /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid/ /ces so/ /de'ang 'phrin las kyi byed tshul 'dra bas de skad btags kyang*/ bya ba dang*/ byed pa gnyis ka'i tshul sangs rgyas lhag pa de nyid las/ de lta mod kyis sa rdul

dang*/ /rgya mtsho ba glang rmig rjes chu/ /khyad par gang yin sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i khyad de nyid/ /ces so/ /de ltar sgom lam sa dgu ni rang rang gi sgrib pa'i gnyen po che 'bring dgu'i dbang gis/ yon tan gyi skyed tshul dgu'i dbang gis phye ba yin no/ /bzhi pa khyad par gyi chos la lnga las/ gnyen po'i khyad par ni sa dgu'i dri ma spong pa la ltos nas/ sbyor ba dang bar chad med lam gnyis ni spong ba'i gnyen po'o/ /rnam grol gyi lam ni rten gyi gnyen po'o/ /khyad par gyi lam ni thag bsring gi gnyen po'o/ /de'ang sa'i sngon rol rang rgyus de dang de'i spang bya gegs su gyur pa rags pa spong pa la sbyor ba'i lam zhes bya'o/ /sa de dang de dang por skye bzhin pas dri ma ngo skal de'i sa bon dngos su spongs pa ni bar chad med lam mo/ /sa de'i skad cig gnyis pa nas sa'i dngos gzhi rnams ni rnam grol lam mo/ /sa'i mjug tu (1) yon tan khyad par can thob nas sa gong mar bgrod bzhin pa ni khyad par gyi (2) lam zhes bya'o/ / spangs pa'i khyad par ni/ mthong spangs ma lus pa spangs/ sgom spangs ngo skal pa rnams kyi rags pa spangs/ phra ba spong ba la 'jug pa'o/ /de'ang ngo bo lhan skyes kyi (3) nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gnyis yin la/ dbye na bzhi las/ ngo bo'i sgo nas drug ste/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ mthar 'dzin ba'i lta ba'o/ khams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dod pa na drug khams gong ma gnyis su khong khro ma gtogs pa (4) lnga lnga ste bcu dang bsdoms pas bcu drug go /sa'i sgo nas dbye na 'dod pa na drug bsam gtan bzhi na lnga tshan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi na lnga tshan bzhi ste bsdoms pas bzhi bcu rtsa drug yod do/ /sa dang che 'bring gi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dod pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ gzugs med nam mkha' dang*/

rnam shes dang*/ ci yang med pa dang*/ srid rtse ste sa dgu na/ 'dod chags che 'bring dgu dgu ste brgyad cu rtsa gcig yod pa bzhin du/ nga rgyal dgu tshan dgu/ ma rig pa dgu tshan dgu/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba dgu tshan dgu/ mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba dgu tshan dgu ste brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa tshan lnga bsdoms pas bzhi brgya dang lnga'i steng du/ 'dod pa'i khong khro che 'bring dgu bsnan pas bzhi brgya dang bcu bzhi yod do/ / de dag sbyor ba dang*/ bar chad med lam dang*/ rnam grol dang*/ khyad par lam bzhir so sor spang pa yin no/ /yon tan gyi khyad par ni sa dang po'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis po de dag sa gnyis pa la skad cig re re zhing stong 'gyur mngon du byed do/ /sa gsum par brgya stong 'gyur dang*/ sa bzhi pa la khrag khrig 'gyur dang*/ sa lnga pa la khrag khrig phrag (1) stong dang*/ sa drug pa la khrag khrig phrag (2) brgya stong dang*/ sa bdun pa la bye ba khrag khrig phrag (3) brgya stong dang*/ sa brgyad pa la stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang*/ sa dgu pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra ba snyed dang*/ sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra ba snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yon tan ston par nus pa dang*/ ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing gsal bar sems can gyi don du mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa dus mnyam du ston par byed do/ /de lta bu'i yon tan yang khams kyi steng gi sgrib pa bral stobs kyis gsar du mthong yang*/ sngaun med pa skyes pa ma yin te yon tan de lta bu dang gzhan yang tshad med pa nyid ye nas lhun grub tu yod pas so sor khams gsar du mthong ba je (1) dag tu song bas snang ba'i phyir ro/ /lus 'dzin pa'i khyad par yang*/ sa gnyis pa la gnas pas gling bzhi'i 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/

gsum pas brgya byin dang*/ bzhi pas mtshe ma dang*/ lnga pas dga' ldan dang*/ drug pas 'phrul dga' dang*/ bdun pas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed/ brgyad pas stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi bdag po tshangs pa dang*/ dgu pas stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi bdag po tshangs pa chen po dang*/ bcu pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i (2) bdag po lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po'i skye ba 'dzin par nus te/ phal po che las/ 'di la gnas pa de dag khams gsum dbang phyug 'gyur/ /ces so/ /de'ang de dag gi rgyal por skye ba 'dzin pa'i nus pa yod kyi skye ba 'dzin pas kyang ma khyab la/ de dag gi rgyal po yin tshad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sa de dag la gnas pas ma khyab ste/ kha cig so so'i skye bo bsod nams rlabs chen bsags pa yin la/ kha cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa der snang bas sems can gyi don mdzad tshul gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang sa dang po yan chad nas tshe la dbang thob pas/ skye shi rang mtshan pa med kyang sems can gyi don du de ltar 'gyur ba ston pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ rga dang na dang 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston/ /ces pa dang*/ rgyud bla mas/ 'phags pas 'chi dang na ba dang*/ /rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skye/ /de la de med phyir de med/ /ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir/ /skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang*/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang*/ /'chi dang rga dang na bar ston/ /ces so/ / lnga pa mi slob pa'i lam la'ang*/ rten dang*/ rang bzhin gnyis las rten la gnyis las/ lus kyi rten thun mong ba ltar na 'dzam bu gling pa'i rgyal rigs sam bram ze las sangs rgya bar 'dod kyang*/ thun mong ma yin pa ltar na 'og min du sangs rgya ba'i rten gang yin pa yin la/ de nas 'gro ba so so'i gnas su sprul pa 'char ba na sangs rgyas su snang ba'i rten gang yin pa de yin par 'dod do/

/bsam pa'i rten ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'o/ /rang bzhin la rgyu/ 'bras bu/ ngo bo gsum las/ rgyu ni slob lam bzhir tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'o/ / 'bras bu ni 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pas 'gro ba thams cad byang chub gsum la 'god pa'o/ /ngo bo la mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang bzhi las/ dang po ni sku gsum ye shes dang bcas pa mtshan gzhi/ theg chen mi slob pa'i lam gyi tha snyad bya rung du mtshon/ theg chen gyi spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i dge ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mi slob pa'i chos bcu/ zag med kyi phung po lnga/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ga ོ /dbye na rten sku/ brten pa ye shes/ mdzad pa 'phrin las dang gsum las/ dang po ni chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku gsum las/ chos sku ni dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i ye shes rtogs pa mthar phyin pa nam mkha' lta bu ste/ sangs rgyas gtso las/ chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes skur ldan/ /ces pa dang*/ spring yig bdud rtsi'i thig le las/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*/ /mar la mar ni rjes zhugs ltar/ /shes bya spros bral de nyid dang*/ /dbyer med ye shes rnams 'dres pa/ /de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin chos sku zhes byar brjod/ /ces so/ / 'di la dbye na gnyis te/ dbyings dag mnyam stong pa sku rnams kyi chos nyid byed pa'i cha nas ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes bya la/ ye shes spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa rig pa'i ngo bo ste (1) sde tshan nyi shu rtsa gcig ni rtogs pa ye shes chos kyi sku zhes 'dod de/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin pa gang zhig dbyings rig mthar thug mngon du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /dang por ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni mngon rtogs rgyan las/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/

/ces so/ /rtogs pa ye shes chos sku tshad med ni/ khams kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i rig cha'i ldog pas chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa ste/ de nyid las/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*/ /rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni/ /snyoms 'jug dgu yi bdag nyid dang*/ /zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang*/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni/ /rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang*/ /nyon mongs med dang smon mkhyen dang*/ /mngon shes so so yang dag rig /rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*/ / dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang*/ /mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang*/ /bsrung ba med pa rnams gsum dang*/ /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam gsum dang*/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang*/ /bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang*/ /skye la thugs rje chen po dang*/ /thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos/ /bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*/ /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ / ces so/ /de'ang ngo bo nyid dbyings nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang na rtogs pa ye shes (1) nyi ma lta bu glo bur gyi sgrib pa sprin dwangs pa ltar snang ba nyid de/ rgyud bla ma las/ sangs rgyas nyid ni dbyer med pa/ /dag pa'i chos kyis rab dbye bar/ / nyi mkha' bzhin te ye shes dang*/ /spangs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid de/ /'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /'jug can gaṅgā'i klung gis ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /ces so/ / de'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin te/ de nyid las/ thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med/ /gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong*/ /gzhal med gaṅgā'i bye ma las 'das pa/ /bsam med mnyam med yon tan nyid dang ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med dbyings de ni/ /bag chags bcas pa'i nyes kun rnam spangs pa'o/

/zhes pa ste/ mdor na dri ma bral stobs kyis snang yang gsar du 'dus ma byas pa la sogs pa ste/ de nyid las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs pa de yin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni 'khor ba'i cha'i kun gzhi tshogs brgyad dang bcas pa (1) dbyings su nub pa'i stobs kyi cha nas bzhag pa'i gzhi'i gnas lugs kyi snang cha'i yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs pa ste/ nges pa lnga dang ldan pa de nyid rtag tu nor bu ltar bzhugs kyang tha mal sna tshogs kyi dngos po ltar rags pa ther zug gi rnam pa mi rtag par snang ba'ang ma yin la/ rang bzhin stong pa ltar snang mi nus pa'ang ma yin te/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i nor bu dang*/ snang la ngo bo med pas 'ja' tshon dang*/ rig pa'i ye shes su gnas pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer mnga' ba'i skus/ /'gro ba'i rnam grol don bsgrubs la brtson pa/ /mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal bzhin te/ /sna tshogs dngos kyang de yi rang bzhin min/ /ces so/ /de la nges pa lnga ni/ gnas nges pa 'og min stug po bkod par/ 'khor nges pa sa bcu'i sems dpa' la/ chos nges pa theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig ston pa nges pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ dus nges pa rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor (2) 'byung ba ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid 'di/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ /ces pa dang*/ de'i 'grel bar/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo nyid 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa bcu la bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ thabs cig tu theg pa chen po'i chos kyi longs spyod kyis dga' ba dang bde ba shin tu kha na ma tho ba med pa nye bar spyod pa'i phyir/

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin no zhes so/ /de'ang sangs rgyas rnams thog mar mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas ni 'og min te/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ gzugs med 'dod dang gzugs rnams dang*/ /'du shes med pa de bzhin te/ /khams las 'das so sangs rgyas dag /bzhugs so stug po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /zhes so/ /de'ang khams gsum las 'das pa'i/ gnas stug po bkod pa na sangs rgyas so/ /de phyogs gang na yod ce na/ rmi lam nyid gang du song ba der 'ong gis 'di kho nar yod do zhes (1) ma chad pa ltar/ gang du sgrib pa mtha' dag dang bral nas dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med du 'dres pa de na yod do/ /chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las/ dbang phyug chen po'i gnas mchog dang*/ /'og min de nyid rnam mdzes pa/ /shes pa gsum pa gcig nyid du/ / 'dres par gyur la bdag smra'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ theg bsdus las/ bdag tu 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir/ /gnas la tha dad yod ma yin/ /sngon gyi rjes su 'brangs pas na/ /de la gdags pas tha dad 'byed/ /ces so/ /'dir shākya thub pa'i dbang du byas na/ thog ma med pa'i dus su 'og min du sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa las mi mjed 'di chags nas sems can so so'i snang ba dang mos pa mi 'dra ba'i ngor thog mar gzugs khams kyi 'og min du sangs rgyas nas lha rnams bsdu bar mdzad pa'i rjes la/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdo rje'i gdan du sangs rgya ba'i tshul bstan par 'dod de/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas mngon par sangs mi rgya/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod der sangs rgya/ /zhes pa dang*/ gzugs khams kyi shin tu mthong ba man chad las 'das pa la spang bar bya ba'i pha rol 'og min du 'dod pa nyid de/ lang kar gshegs pa las kyang*/ gtsang ma'i gnas ni spangs nas su/

/'og min zhes bya nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir sangs rgya/ /zhes so/ /'khor nges pa ni sa dang po nas bcu ba'i bar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba ste/ ye shes snang ba rgyan las/ bcom ldan 'das longs spyod rdzogs pa chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bcu la bzhugs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor te zhes so/ /chos nges pa theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig gis 'khor lo bskor ba ni/ de las bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa snyed yongs su bskor te zhes pa dang byams pa'i smon lam las/ rnam snang chen po de bzhin gshegs/ /sku las 'od zer nyi bzhin shar/ /zhal nas bdud rtsi'i gsung byung bas/ /khams gsum gang ba'i nad pa gso/ /zhes so/ / ston pa nges pa dpal rnam par snang mdzad/ des mtshon nas mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas/ don yod grub pa ste/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus 'bar ba'o/ /mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ni mngon rtogs rgyan las/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan dang rus sbal

zhabs/ /phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel pa dang*/ /phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags/ /'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*/ /sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*/ /zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs/ / byin pa e na ya 'dra phyag ring mdzes/ /mdoms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog /pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang*/ /spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang*/ /zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge'i 'dra/ /'di yi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas/ /'di la ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog snang*/ / sku ni n+ya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab/ /gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*/ /tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems/ /shin tu dkar dang thags bzangs tshad mnyam dang*/ /grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang ba dang*/ / spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rdzi ba mchog gi /'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /ces so/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yang de nyid las/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*/ /mngog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams/ /zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang*/ /rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med/ /long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang*/ /seng ge glang chen bya dang ni/ /khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang*/ /mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags/ /phyi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tshams/ /gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku/ /mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang*/ /gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni/ /dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang*/ /sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang*/ /shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*/ /yan lag shin tu rnam dbyes dang*/ / gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang*/ /dku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang*/ /phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni/ /zab dang g.yas su 'khyil ba dang*/ /kun nas blta na sdug pa dang*/ /kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni/ /sme ba gnag bag med pa dang*/

/phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang*/ /phyag ris zab ring mdangs yod dang*/ /zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang*/ /mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang*/ /ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang*/ /dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang*/ /gsung snyan 'jam la mche ba zlum/ /rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang*/ /byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang*/ /mchog tu dag pa nyid dang ni/ /spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug /pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*/ /smin mtshams ring dang 'jam pa dang*/ /snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang*/ /phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang*/ /nyams pa rnam par spang ba dang*/ /dpral pa legs par 'byes pa dang*/ /dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang*/ /dbu skra bung ba ltar nag dang*/ /stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings dang*/ /mi bshor dri zhim skyes bu yi/ /yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*/ /dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni/ /g.yung drung 'khyil pas brgyan pa ste/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed/ /ces so/ /dus nges pa ni rtag tu bzhugs pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ 'jug pa las/ zhi sku dpag bsam shing ltar gsal gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji ltar rnam mi rtog /'gro sgrol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad rtag /'di ni spros dang bral la snang ba yin/ /ces so/ /rtag pa'i rgyu mtshan ni longs sku de nyid chos sku dang dbyer med ngo bo gcig pas chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa nyid dang*/ ye nas lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas pa nyid dang*/ gdul bya'i bsod nams tshad med pa 'khor ba ji srid par bskrun pa de'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma las/ chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang*/ /ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon po rtag /ces pa dang*/ 'chi med zhi ba'i ga nas thob ste/ /'chi bdag rgyu ba med pa'i phyir/ /'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /thub pa gdod nas rab zhi'i phyir/ /rtag par skyabs med rnams kyi ni/ /skyabs la sogs pa mdzad pa'i phyir/

/gzugs kyi sku yi rtag nyid de/ /phyi ma gsum gyis ston pa yi/ /chos kyi sku ni rtag pa nyid/ /ces so/ /sprul pa'i sku ni gdul bya'i ngor longs sku'i dbyings chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du gang la gang 'dul du srid pa ji srid pa sna tshogs su 'byung bas/ rgya che ba'i rtag pa zhes bya ste/ de nyid las/ 'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang*/ /rab tu smin dang lung ston rgyu yi gzugs/ /gang yin de la 'dir ni rtag gnas te/ / nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi khams bzh-in no/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gdul bya yod na yod/ med na med pa chu zla'i gzugs lta bu ste/ sangs rgyas yod kyang sangs rgyas la bskrun pa'i dge ba med na sa bon rul ba 'phel du mi rung ba lta bu ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ rgyud ni yongs su smin gyur nas/ /gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya bas phan gyur pa/ /de dang de la de snang ngo*/ /lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*/ /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang*/ /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*/ /zhes so/ /sprul pa de yang gsum ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang de bzhin du/ /byang chub mchog gi sprul pa ste/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po/ /zhes so/ /de'ang lugs dang bris dang glegs bam la sogs pa thams cad ni 'gro ba'i dkar po mngon par 'phel ba'i phyir bzo sprul pa'o/ / des pa la sogs par sprul nas nad dang mu ge la sogs pa (1) skyobs pa ni skye ba sprul pa'o/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pas 'dul ba ni byang chub mchog gi sprul pa ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ / 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba na/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*/

/lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang*/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /ces so/ / de'ang chos sku la gzugs skur gnas te/ sku gsum brnyes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ de nyid las/ 'dir ni dang po chos sku ste/ /phyi ma dag ni gzugs kyi sku/ /nam mkha' la ni gzugs gnas bzhin/ /dang po la ni tha ma gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes bya ste/ /rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ / gzhan ni sprul ba'i sku yin no/ /sku gsum dag gis rang bzhin gyi/ /don 'di rten dang bcas par bstan/ /ces so/ /de dag gis rten sku bshad zin to/ /de la'ang brten pa'i ye shes bshad pa la gsum ste/ thun mong gi rab tu dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ shes bya mkhyen pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes tsam dbye ba'i gzhi'o/ /dbye ba'i ngo bo ni ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'o/ /dang po ni ngo bo rgyu 'bras la sogs pa'i shes bya thams cad spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba mngon sum du mkhyen pa yin te/ yum bar ma las/ chos gcig mkhyen pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ste/ chos nyid zhi ba'i rnam pa'o zhes so/ /gzhung 'ga' zhig tu chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes zhes tha snyad bya'o/ / gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rang bzhin dbye ba/ rgyu'o/ /dang po ni ngo bo rgyu 'bras la sogs pa'i shes bya thams cad sgyu ma lta bur mngon sum du mkhyen pa ste/ de nyid las/ rnam pa gang dag dang*/ rtags gang dag dang*/ mtshan ma gang dag gis chos rnams rab tu brjod pa'i rnam pa de dag dang*/

rtags de dag dang*/ mtshan ma de dag de bzhin gshegs pas thugs su chud par 'gyur ro zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes la bzhi ste/ me long lta bu dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de dag gi rgyu la gnyis te/ sel byed gnyen po'i rgyu dang*/ bsal bya rang bzhin gyi rgyu'o/ /dang po ni slob lam du chos kyi rnam grangs mang du thos pa 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du bsgom pa dang*/ gdul bya la chos skal ba dang 'tshams par ston pa dang*/ gzhan don bsgrub pa'i grogs byas pas ye shes bzhi po rang la yod pa'i sa (1) dri ma dag nas 'grub pa'i rgyu byed pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'dzin pa'i phyir dang sems mnyam phyir/ /yang dag chos rab ston phyir dang*/ /bya ba grub pa nyid kyi phyir/ /ye shes bzhi po yang dag 'byung*/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni rang la yod pa'i ye shes de'i steng gi sgrib byed bral stobs kyis snang ba'i cha nas gnas gyur du btags pa ste/ ma dag pa'i dus kyi rnam shes tshogs brgyad rten kun gzhi dang bcas pa log pas/ ye shes su shar ba la/ kun gzhi dag pas chos kyi dbyings/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag pas me long lta bu'i ye shes/ yid dag pas mnyam pa nyid/ nyon yid dag pas so sor rtog pa/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes dag pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ kun gzhi dbyings su nub pa ni chos kyi dbyings so/ / kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ / nyon mongs pa can gy-i yid dbyings su nub pa ni/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ / sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so zhes so/ /gnas gyur 'dod pa'ang nyon mongs pa de dag rten dang bcas pa dag pa'i cha la de skad btags te/

de ma dag na de dag gi chas bzhag pa'i yon tan rnams mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /rang mtshan du nyon mongs pa nyid ye shes su gnas gyur pa mi srid de ye shes dang shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ spang byar bshad pas dag dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / gal te rgyu mtshan nyid pa yin na khams la lhun grub 'dus ma byas su ye nas yod par bshad pa dang 'gal te/ gsar du gnas 'gyur gyi 'du byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na mi rtag par 'gyur te 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na rnam par grol ba 'pho 'gyur byed pas/ yang sdug bsngal bden par thal pa la sogs pa'i rigs pas gnod la/ 'gro grol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad rtag /ces pa la sogs pa'i lung gis kyang gnod pas de ni thos par yang mi bya na/ bden par zhen nas khas blang ba lta smos kyang ci dgos pa yin no/ / gnyis pa so so'i rang bzhin la bzhi las/ me long lta bu'i ye shes ni/ ngo bo chos lnga dang ldan pa ste/ ngar 'dzin gyi ris yongs su bcad pa med pas rgyun ma chad pa dang*/ yul de na yod pa shes la gzhan na yod pa mi shes pa med pas yul ma chad pa dang*/ mi rtag pa dang 'pho 'gyur med pas kun rdzob kyi dus gsum med pa'i phyir ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa rtag tu yod pas dus ma chad pa dang*/ chos can ma lus pa mkhyen pas dmigs pa ma chad pa dang*/ yul gyi rnam pa shar ba la mi ltos pas shes bya la yod tsam gyis mkhyen pas rnam pa ma chad pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ me long ye shes nga yi med/ /yongs su ma chad rtag tu ldan/ /shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa/ /rtag tu de la mngon phyogs min/ /ces so/ /grogs su ye shes gzhan gsum ldan pa yin te de nyid las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste/ /ye shes gsum ni de la brten/ /mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na'o/ /zhes so/ /byed las ni me long byad bzhin dang phrad na gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar/

ye shes 'di gdul bya dang phrad na longs sku dang ye shes gzhan gsum gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du 'byung bas/ sprul sku 'phro gzhi byed pa ni de nyid las/ ye shes kun gyi rgyu mtshan phyir/ /ye shes 'byung gnas chen po 'dra/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ye shes gzugs brnyan 'byung phyir de/ /zhes so/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo ni 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas par thams cad mnyam pa nyid du thugs su chud pa ste/ de nyid las/ mi gnas zhi bar bzhugs pa ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yin par brjod/ /ces so/ /grogs byams pa chen po dang thugs rje chen po ldan la/ byed las gdul bya'i mos pa dang*/ mthun par gzugs sku'i snang ba dngos su ston pa ste/ de nyid las/ dus rnams kun tu byams pa dang*/ /thugs rje chen po dag dang ldan/ /sems can rnams la mos pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas sku ni nges par ston/ /zhes so/ /de'ang sku'i 'char gzhi me long lta bus byed kyang*/ gdul bya la ston byed mnyam nyid ye shes yin par lta'o/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ni chos can thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes chos ston pa la mnga' brnyes pa yin te/ de nyid las/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs/ /zhes so/ /grogs ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs la sogs pa dpag tu med pa ldan te/ de nyid las/ ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/ /gter dang 'dra ba kho na yin/ /ces so/ /byed las 'khor gyi nang du sku'i 'byor pa sna tshogs bstan nas chos kyi char 'bebs pa ste/ de nyid las/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni/ /'byor pa thams cad ston mdzad cing*/ /the tshom thams cad gcod mdzad pa'i/ /chos chen char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /zhes so/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ni sprul pa dpag tu med pa sprul nas sems can gyi don sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i ye shes yin te/

de nyid las/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /khams rnams kun tu sna tshogs zhing*/ / dpag med bsam yas sprul pa yis/ /sems can kun don grub pa'o/ /zhes so/ /byed las gdul bya'i don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sangs rgyas sprul pa de rtag tu/ /mdzad pa bsgrub pa'i bye brag dang*// grangs dang zhing gi rnam kun tu/ /bsam mi khyab par shes par bya/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa ye shes de'i (1) shes bya mkhyen pa'i tshul la (2) gnyis te/ phyin ci log gi lugs dor pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dgod pa'o/ /dang po la gsum las/ dbu ma par 'dod pa kha cig sangs rgyas la ye shes med pas/ ye shes kyi mkhyen pa'ang med de shes bya spros pa yin la/ de dang bral ba'i phyir dang*/ rig pa ma rig pa'i khyab bya yin te/ khyab byed ma rig pa ldog pas khyab bya rig pa ldog pa'i phyir/ 'jug pa las/ sems 'gags pa de sku yis mngon sum mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de ni mi rigs te/ stong ngos chos sku la ltos na ye shes yod med gnyis kar ma grub pas yod ces bzhag kyang 'gog la/ med ces 'dod kyang 'gog pa mtshungs pa'i phyir med pa'ang mi 'thad la/ snang ngos gzugs sku la ltos nas/ gdul bya snang nas don mdzad pa snang dgos pas ye shes kyang snang dgos pa'i

(3) phyir dang*/ shes bya shes byed la sogs pa'i grub mtha' btags pa thams cad spros pa yin yang*/ gang gis kyang ma btags par snang ba'i rnam gzhag gi yul rnams spros pa zhes gzhag tu med pas/ de nyid 'jig rten pas kyang khas len pas 'gog par mi rigs te/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi mdo las/ gang 'j-ig rten pas yod par khas len pa de ni ngas kyang yod par rnam par gzhag go zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /rig pa ma rig pa'i rten yin gyi khyab byed ma yin pas ma rig pa log pas rig pa ldog par mi 'gyur te/ khang pa zhig kyang sa gzhi gnas pa bzhin no (1) / /sangs rgyas pa'i chos sku rig pas mngon du byed par gsungs te/ sems 'gags pa de sku yis mngon sum mdzad/ /ces khyod kyang 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /sems 'gags kyang ye shes ni mi 'gag gi steng du ches bzang ba de rtag tu yod do/ /gzhan du na sems gang gi steng du 'gags/ 'jug pa rgyun chad nam mkha' ltar 'dod na rgyang 'phen pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /des na sems sems byung kun gzhi tshogs brgyad kyis bsdus pa rig pa ye shes kyi steng du 'gag par byed do/ /'jug pa'i 'grel bar yang*/ gang gi don du mdzad pa 'di mdzad pa bla na med pa'i ye shes de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'og min gyi gnas kho nar brnyes par mdzad do (2) zhes gsungs pas ye shes yod par gsungs pa'i phyogs 'os pa nyid do/ / gnyis pa ni yang sems tsam pa 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis phyi rol gyi don mkhyen pa mi 'thad de/ rnam pa dang bcas par mkhyen na gzung 'dzin dang bcas par 'gyur la/ rnam pa ma shar yang mkhyen na ha cang thal ba'i phyir zhes 'dod pa'ang rigs pa ma yin te/ khyod kyi phyogs la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes med par 'gyur te/ phyi rol gyi don du snang ba mi mkhyen cing shes pa la'ang rnam pa yod med kyi brtags pa mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/

/gsum pa ni yang dngos por smra ba bden gnyis pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la ma dag pa 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang rang mtshan pa dngos su snang la/ de nyid ji snyed pa'i ye shes kyis mkhyen no/ /gal te mi mkhyen na ma dag pa'i snod bcud shes bya la mi srid par thal/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis ma gzigs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs pa la shes bya (1) med pas khyab ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyis/ /mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir/ /ces pa dang rnam nges las/ thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs pa logs pa ni thams cad na med par go bar bya'o zhes pas grub bo/ /des na ma dag pa gzigs kyang 'khrul pa'i nyes pas mi gos pa yin no zhes 'dod pa'ang yang dag pa ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes phar zhog / dag pa sa gsum nas sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur pas zhing khams dag pa la dbang bar bshad de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yid dang 'dzin dang rnam par rtog /gyur phyir rnam par mi rtog dang*/ /zhing dang ye shes las dag la/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yi gnas/ /dbang de mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /sa gsum la ni rnam bzhi ste/ /gcig la rnam gnyis de las gzhan/ /dbang ni re re 'dod pa yin/ /ces pa 'di'i don ji ltar drang*/ sangs rgyas ni 'khrul snang gi dri ma dang bral ba'i phyir rang ngo la nam yang 'khrul pa snang bar mi rigs so/ /yang kha cig sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis dag pa'i snod bcud mkhyen yang*/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud mkhyen mi srid de/ de dag sems can gyi nyon mongs pa dang las kyis bskyed pa'i phyir dang*/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dag par gnas gyur pa'i phyir ro zhes pa'ang mi rigs te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin nam ma yin/ yin na 'gro ba'i 'khrul snang mi mkhyen pa bud la/ ma yin na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin pa nyams

(2) so/ /des na lugs de thams cad mthun phyogs la mthong tsam mam (3) /mi mthun phyogs la ma mthong bas zhugs pa'i phyir yang dag pa ma yin no/ /gnyis pa yang dag pa'i lugs dgod pa la gnyis te shes bya gzigs pa'i tshul dang*/ rtsod pa spang pa'o/ /dang po ni rang snang la ltos nas 'khrul pa thams cad shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ 'khrul snang rdul tsam yang gzigs pa med de/ 'khrul pa gtan nas spangs te ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan snang 'khrul ngo la ltos nas 'gro ba so so la 'char tshul rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa mtha' dag skyu ru ra phyag mthil du bzhag pa ltar mkhyen no/ /de'ang ye shes gcig gis dus mnyam du rang gzhan gyi snang ba thams cad mkhyen pa yin te thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bden gnyis las/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis kyang*/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'di gnyis kyi don dpe zhig gis go bar 'gyur te/ 'di ltar rin po che'i khang bzangs mchog 'byor pa mtha' yas pas brgyan pa na/ khyim bdag spun gnyis yod pa las/ phu bo de ni snga rol du gnyid du song ba las sad de pha rol gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes can du gyur pa de'i rmi (1) lam du/ nu bo de yang gnyid du (2) song nas 'gro drug so so'i 'khrul snang bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang bar ma sna tshogs pa rmi bdo ba'i dus der/ de ma thag gnyid sangs pa med pas gnyid slong yang phan pa med nas/ phu bo des nu bo lha la sogs par skyes te bde sdug la spyod pa de'i drung du dge sbyong ngam bram ze'am skyes pa'am bud med dam sangs rgyas sam nyan rang ngam byang chub sems dpa'am/ so so skye bo la sogs pa gang rung gcig tu sprul nas/ kye 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ snying po med pa/ yang dag par srid pa ma yin te/ 'khrul snang 'di rdzun pas bden par ma zhen cig chos spyod cig ces pa la sogs pa'i chos bstan nas/

rgyu des mi dge ba dor/ dge ba bsgrubs pas tshe rabs yang yang 'phos pa ltar snang dus mtho ris kyi bde ba dang chos spyod pa'i rigs su gyur te gnas skabs su bde bar gyur pa las/ gnyid kyang khad kyis bsrab pa'i 'og tu 'khor ba rdzun par shes pa'i rkyen des gnyid sad pa na/ sngar gyi mal las ma g.yos bzhin du rmi lam 'byung (1) ba yang mthong la/ phu bos sprul pa bkye nas don byas pa'ang dran bzhin du/ phu bo dang don la bzang ngan med pa yin yang*/ dar cig bzang ngan du snang ba de nyid la/ spun gnyis bzhad gad du don de gleng ba ji lta ba bzhin te/ sangs rgyas dang sems can snying po ye shes kyi khang bzangs la mnyam du dbang yang re zhig glo bur bsgrib pa'i gnyid sad ma sad (2) khyad lta bus khong du chud par bya'o/ / de'ang shes bya'i mkhyen tshul gnyis las/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi ngo bo la skye 'gag la sogs pa'i spros pa dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs mtha' dag chod nas rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i shes bya cung zad kyang ma dmigs par mngon sum du thugs su chud pa la/ chos nyid ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen zhes bya ste/ mdo las/ 'ga' yang mthong ba med pa ni chos mthong ba yin no zhes pa dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ /de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ /zhes so/ /ji snyed pa mkhyen tshul ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis mnyam par gzhag pa las ma g.yos bzhin du/ shes bya mtha' dag rdzun pa sgyu ma lta bur mngon sum du mkhyen pa ni ji snyed pa mkhyen pa yin te/ mdo las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dmigs pa ni dngos po med pa'o zhes so/ /de'ang dbang shes ltar yul so sor 'dzin pas mkhyen pa (1) ma yin gyis/ shes pa rdzas gcig gis kyang chos can ma lus pa mkhyen pa yin te/

phal po che las/ rgyal ba'i ye shes bla med kyis/ /skad cig gis ni don kun rig /ces so/ /dus gsum gyi shes bya rnams snga phyi rim gyis mkhyen pa ma yin gyis/ dus cig car mkhyen pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig btang bas/ /'gro ba snang bar byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin shes bya thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas ye shes cig car snang*/ /zhes so/ /de dag kyang mnyam gzhag gi ngang las ma g.yos par gzigs kyis/ rjes thob mtshan nyid pa med de/ rnam g.yeng bag chags dang bcas pa spang ba'i phyir ro/ /  de nyid las (2) / thub pa sgrib kun nges par grol/ /ces so/ /mnyam rjes su btags pa ni rang don chos sku las mi g.yo ba mnyam gzhag la/ de'i ngang las gzhan don 'phrin las 'byung ba rjes thob tu brjod pa yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba yi/ /rgyu ni ye shes gnyis yin te/ /mi rtog pa dang de yi ni/ /rjes thob de ni ye shes 'dod/ /ces brda tsam gyi (3) cha la dgongs nas brjod kyang*/ rtag tu mnyam gzhag las mi g.yo bar dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ glang chen bzhugs kyang mnyam par gzhag /glang chen gzims kyang mnyam par gzhag /glang chen mnal yang mnyam gzhag yin/ /ces grub bo/ / gnyis pa rtsod pa spang ba la gnyis las/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i yul chos nyid mi srid pa'i phyir de gzigs pa'i ye shes mi srid par thal te/ rdo rje gcod pa las/ chos nyid shes bya ma yin te/ /de ni shes par yod mi nus/ /zhes  pa'i lan (1) ni/ chos nyid de ngo bor grub pa'i shes bya ma yin pas de skad gsungs kyang*/ brjod med bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtha' bral tsam du so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyi yul yin pas mkhyen te sgra gcan 'dzin gyis yum la bstod pa las/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/

/dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /ji snyed pa'i ye shes kyi yul ma dag pa rang mtshan par mi srid pa'i phyir de gzigs pa'i ye shes mi srid par thal zhe na/ bden pa med kyang rdzun pa yod pas mkhyen no/ /shes bya'i mtha' dang*/ sems can gyi grangs dang*/ 'khor ba'i thog mtha' mi srid pa'i phyir (2) / de gzigs pa'i ye shes mi srid par thal zhe na'ang*/ shes bya la srid pa sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen par khas blangs kyis mi srid pa de shes bya ma yin pas gzigs pa ma yin te ri bong gi rwa bzhin no/ /de'ang rgyud bla ma'i 'grel bar/ thog med gyur kyang tha ma dang ldan pa/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nam rnam par dag pa thob pa rnams kyis nyon mongs pa phyi ma dag pa yin te/ legs par mkhyen pa yin no/ /don gsum pa mdzad pa 'phrin las ni longs sku'i ngang las sprul sku 'gro bas srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar rgyun mi 'chad par 'phro ba'i mos pa bzhin 'byung ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ /ces pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ gzhan gyi dbang gis nges 'byung dang*/ /bdag dang sems can mtshungs gzigs dang*/ /mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir/ /'khor ba ji srid mdzad mi 'chad/ /ces so/ /ji lta zhe na/ sems can gyi khams dang*/ de nyid gang gis 'dul dang*/ thabs kyi bya ba dang*/ dus su 'doms pa las yol ba mi mnga' ba rnams mkhyen nas don mdzad de/ de nyid las/ gdul bya'i khams dang 'dul ba'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyis gdul bya'i bya ba dang*/ /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug / ces so/ /ji ltar lhun gyis grub par 'jug ce na dpe dgus rig par bya ste/ de nyid las/ gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang sprin bzhin dang*/ /tshangs nyi rin chen yid bzhin nor rgyal bzhin/

/sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar/ /'bad med gzhan don byed de rnal 'byor rigs/ /rin chen lha dbang snang zhing ston pa de/ /legs par 'doms mdzad lha yi rnga dang 'dra/ khyab bdag mkhyen dang brtse chen sprin tshogs ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid rtse'i bar du khyab/ /tshangs bzhin zag med gnas la ma bskyod par/ /sprul pa rnam pa du ma rab tu ston/ /nyi bzhin ye shes snang ba rab spro gang*/ /rnam dag rin chen yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung de nyid/ /brag ca bzhin du yi ge med/ /sku ni nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /khyab dang gzugs med rtag pa nyid/ /sa bzhin 'gro ba dkar po yi/ /chos kyi sman ni ma lus pa'i/ /rnam pa kun tu gzhir gyur pa/ / sangs rgyas kyi ni sa yin no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las kyang*/ 'gro ba'i khams la skal ba gang yod der/ /cig car 'jug pa nyi ma lta bu ste/ /de nyid las/ gang phyir gdul bya dag pa yi/ /chu yi snod ni thams cad la/ /bder gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dpag tu med pa cig car 'char/ /ces so/ / de'ang gdul bya'i sems kyi rjes su byed pa nyid la'ang de las/ ji ltar baiḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char/ /'gro bar gzugs brnyan 'char nus rnyog med dang*/ /rnyog pa'i rang sems rab 'jug dbang gis 'jug /ces so/ /de ltar snang ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas kyis chos ston pa la sogs pa'ang gdul bya rang rang gi las kyis snang ba yin te/ de nyid las/ ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyi/ /rnga sgra rang gi las las byung*/ /de bzhin 'jig rten thub pa'i chos/ /gsungs pa rang gi las las byung*/ /zhes so/ /dper na sgra brnyan yod kyang rna ba med pas mi thos pa ltar/ rang gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa mthong nas chos thos pa'i las ma bsags na mi 'byung pa'ang*/
