de nyid las/ ji ltar rna ba dang bral bas/ /phra mo'i sgra ni mi myong zhing*/ /thams cad lha yi rna bar yang*/ /rna lam du ni mi 'gro ltar/ /de bzhin chos phra mchog tu ni/ /zhib mo'i ye shes spyod yul yang*/ /nyon mongs med yid 'ga' zhig gi /rna ba'i lam du 'gyur ba yin/ /ces so/ / mdor bsdu na cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyis 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du don mdzad nas 'gro ba rnams zhi ba'i lam la 'god pa'o/ /cho 'phrul gsum ni rgyud bla ma'i 'grel ba las/ lus kyi cho 'phrul gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa khyab pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ces bstan to/ /sems kyi rnams grangs mkhyen pas de rtogs pa sems can gyi sems kyi spyod pa zab mo snang ba ni/ kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /ngag gis dbyangs brjod pas nges par 'byin pa'i lam las brtsams te de 'doms pa dang rjes su bstan pa ni rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul ces gsungs so/ / bzhi pa mi slob pa'i lam gyi khyad par gyi chos la gsum las/ spang ba'i khyad par ni/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa spang ba ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ nyon mongs pa dang de bzhin skyes/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib de bzhin/ /gang yin mi mthun phyogs chos bcom/ /deng 'dir bcom ldan 'das su bshad/ /ces pa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ thub pa sgrib kun nges par grol/ /

ces so/ /rtogs pa'i khyad par ni chos thams cad mngon sum du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa ste/ yum bar ma las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ni chos gang yang mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas pa'am ma gzigs pa'am/ ma mkhyen pa 'ga' yang med de/ chos thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du mngon sum du rab tu mkhyen to zhes so/ /yon tan gyi khyad par ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan ma lus pa dang ldan pa ste/ dbye na sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gter 'chang ba'o/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi ni rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa las/ de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag rnam pa gcig tu mngon par bsdus te drug cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur ro zhes so/ /stobs bcu ni rgyud bla ma las/ gnas dang gnas min las rnams kyi/ / rnam smin dang ni dbang po dang*/ khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang*/ /kun 'gro'i lam dang bsam gtan tshogs/ /nyon mongs dri ma med pa dang*/ /gnas ni rjes su dran pa dang*/ /lha yi mig dag zhi ba dag /mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rnams pa bcu/ /zhes so/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi ni de las/ chos kun rdzogs par byang chub dang*/ /gegs ni 'gog par byed pa dang*/ /lam ston pa dang 'gog ston la/ / mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes so/ /chos ma 'dres pa ni de nyid las/ 'khrul dang ca co mi mnga' ste/ /ston la dran pa nyams mi mnga'/ /mnyam par ma bzhag thugs mi mnga'/ /'du shes sna tshogs kyang mi mnga'/ /ma brtags btang snyoms mi mnga' ste/ /'dun pa brtson 'grus dran pa dang*/ /shes rab rnam grol rnam grol gyi/ /ye shes gzigs pa nyams mi mnga'/ /las rnams ye shes sngon 'gro dang*/ /dus la ye shes sgrib pa med/

/de ltar bco brgyad 'di dag gzhan/ /ston pa'i ma 'dres yon tan yin/ /ces so/ /mtshan nyid theg pa bshad zin to/ /theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa grub mtha' rin po che'i mdzod las/ lam nyams su blang tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // de nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa bstan par bya ba la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid las khyad par 'phags tshul bstan pa dang*/ khyad par can gyi gsang sngags nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ theg pa chen po'i dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ khyad par 'phags tshul bye brag tu bshad pa dang*/ 'bras bu yin tshul ngos gzung ba'o/ /dang po ni theg pa chen po de yang rgyu mtshan nyid dang 'bras bu gsang sngags gnyis te/ theg pa chen po yongs su grub pa'i rgyud las/ theg pa chen po rnam gnyis te/ /pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /ces pa dang*/ legs par grub pa'i rgyud las/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbye ba yis/ /pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /ces so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni phy-i mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las/ nang gsang sngags kyi theg pa ches khyad par tu 'phags te/ de yang gzhi 'od gsal ba'i snying po dang*/ de la brten pa'i chos rnams gtan la 'bebs par don gcig kyang*/ mtshan nyid kyis ji lta ba bzhin gzhi lam 'bras bu gtan la 'bebs pa la rmongs la/ sngags kyis ma rmongs par shes pa'i khyad par yod de/ 'di ltar zab pa dang rgya che ba dag 'jal ba na/ mtshan nyid kyis gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas gzhig ste rjes dpag nges pa'i tshad mas gzhal pa'i don dam gyi bden pa blos byas kyi gzhi dang*/ de'i ngang la 'bad pas 'jog pa'i lam (1) zhi lhag tsam dang*/ dus bskal pa mang po na thob pa la phyogs pa'i 'bras bu la dmigs pa'i zab pa tsam dang*/ rgya che ba'ang khams la brten pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa kun rdzob kyi bden par gtan la phab nas blang dor 'ba' zhig tu byed pa tsam las med

do/ /sngags ni gtan tshigs la ma ltos par/ lus ngag rtsa rlung thig le la sogs pa'i gnad bsnun pa tsam gyis/ blos ma byas pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos sku'i snying po gzhir gtan la phebs nas/ de'i ngang du rang bzhin gyi blos gnas pas tshe gcig la sogs pa na/ dbyings (1) don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs nas byang chub mngon du byed pas zab mo mngon sum du skye ba nyid dang*/ rgya che ba'ang dbyings 'od gsal gyi dkyil 'khor du ye nas grub pa gzhi'i rgyud du gtan la phab nas/ de la brten pa'i kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa phung khams skye mched thams cad spang blang med par lha dang gzhal yas khang dang zhing gi bkod par gtan la 'bebs pa'i lam gyi rgyud rnams nyams su len pa bstan pas/ gnas skabs su grub chen brgyad dang mthar thug byang chub mchog la sogs pa mngon du byed cing*/ gang yang lam du gyur pa'i chos ston pa 'bras bu'i rgyud gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don la rmongs pa med pa yin no/ /thabs mang bas kyang 'phags te/ spang bya 'dod chags lta bu gcig spong ba la yang*/ thun mong du bskyed pas bsgyur ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gya nom gyi 'dod chags so sor rtog pa bde ba chen por lam du slong ba la sogs pas ma spangs bzhin du dbyings su dag par byed la/ mtshan nyid kyis yul dang yul can spong ba la ltos la/ bsgrub bya thun mong gi yo byad lta bu gcig la yang*/ sbyin pa'i rjes su byed pas sngon gy-i las su byas te/ rkyen tha mal pas bsgrubs pa ltar tshong so nam la sogs 'bad pa mtshan nyid las gsang sngags 'phags te/ chu dbang dang gnod mdzes la sogs pa'i sgrub pas dngos su 'byor pa 'phel du yod pas/ sngon las dang tha mal gyi sgrub lugs las 'phags pas na/ tshe spel ba dang dbang du bya ba la sogs pa rnams grangs mang po don gcig la'ang gsungs pa'i phyir 'phags so/

/dka' ba med pas kyang 'phags te/ mtshan nyid kyi (1) lam spong len dka' spyad kyis mthar ngal zhing dub pa las/ sngags ni gang yang grogs su 'char bas spang blang gi ngo bo rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir 'dod pa'i yon tan la sogs pa brten pas 'grub bo/ /dbang po rnon po'i lam yin pas kyang 'phags te/ tshegs chung la don che ba man ngag dam pa'i rang bzhin mthar thug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar tshul bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa yang*/ tshul gsum pa'i sgron ma las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /de dag kyang dmigs pa dang*/ grogs lta spyod dang rang bzhin bsgrub pa dang bcas pa phun sum tshogs pas sngags kyi theg pa chen por gzhag pa yin te/ theg pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag las/ dmigs pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ /grogs kyi mthu dang spyod pa yis/ /blo dang ldan pa'i theg pa ni/ /chen po'i chen por yongs su grags/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa 'phags tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni/ ra li bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ nyan thos la sogs theg chung la/ /man ngag yod pa ma yin te/ /lta ba spyod pa sems bzung dang*/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu sa/ /dus dang longs spyod rnal 'byor dang*/ /bdag gzhan don dang dgos pa dang*/ /ngal dub mtha' spangs tshegs chung dang*/ /tshogs bsags pa yi khyad par dang*/ /khyad par rnam pa bco lnga yis/ /rigs 'dzin theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mtshan nyid pa lta ba stong nyid spros bral tsam las/ bden pa dbyer med gdod ma nas lha dang sngags kyi rang bzhin gnas par ma rtogs la/ sngags kyis rtogs te/ kun rdzob kyang med la snang ba sprul pa tsam du lhar dag pa sbyaur la/ don dam dbyings dang ye shes ye nas gnyis su med pa gnyis/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i ngang du dbyer med par rtogs te/

sgyu 'phrul lam rim las/ don dam kun rdzob dbyer med par/ /mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /zhes so/ /phung po lnga lhar dag pa yang*/ ye shes grub pa'i rgyud las/ gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'du shes snang ba mtha' yas nyid/ /'du byed don yod grub pa la/ /rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'byung ba lnga yum lngar dag pa'ang de nyid las/ 'byung pa lnga ni yum lnga'i dngos/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams kun/ /thams cad dag pa sangs rgyas zhing*/ /zhes so/ /sgyu 'phrul gsang snying las kyang*/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen te zhes so/ /spyod pa'ang mtshan nyid la blang dor gnyis bcas las med la/ sngags su dag mnyam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin lha dang gzhal yas khang gi ngang las/ tshogs dang*/ mgon po kun tu spyod pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor so so'i skabs su 'chad pa lta bus/ lha mchod pa dang*/ chos nyid dang mthun pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dag pa la sogs pas 'phags so/ /sems kyi ting nge 'dzin la'ang*/ mtshan nyid las zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bsgrub pa la yun ring por sems 'dzin gyi dka' ba chen pos 'bad dgos pa nyid/ sngags su mtshan bcas bskyed pa'i rim pas spros pa zhi nas/ mtshan med rdzogs pa'i rim par rtsa rlung gi gnad gcun pa tsam gyis ye shes 'char ba'i phyir 'phags so/ /rgyu'ang mtshan nyid du bskyed bya skyed byed kun rdzob sngon du song ba las don dam rtogs par 'dod la/ sngags su dag rgyu'am bral rgyu rang gnas kyi ye shes btsan thabs su ngo sprad nas bsgoms pas da lta nyid du don dam rtogs pa la 'jug pas 'phags so/ /lam yang mtshan nyid du tshogs gnyis la mnyam rjes res 'jog tu gyur pas lam lnga bskal par mi bgrod pa nyid/ sngags su dbyer med ye shes kyi lam la zhugs pas myur du bgrod pas 'phags so/

/'bras bu'ang mtshan nyid du dus ring zhig na phyis 'byung bar 'dod la/ sngags la da lta lhun grub tu rang gnas su 'dod pas 'phags so/ /sa'ang mtshan nyid du spang gnyen rim can gyi dbye bas bcu gcig tu 'dod la/ sngags su dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyis dbyings de bzhin nyid lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ dag mnyam ye shes chen po'i sa rim gnyis 'od gsal dam pa dang*/ lhun grub chos mchog dag pa'i sa 'bras bu rnam dag chen po dang gsum mo/ /yang na rgyu'i sa rnams kyi steng du bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma can gyi sa dang*/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pas 'phags te/ gsang snying las/ sa yi khyad par bcu dang gsum/ /zhes so/ / dus la'ang mtshan nyid las bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pas mi grub pa/ sngags la brtson zhing dam tshig gtsang bas tshe 'dir 'grub ste/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ shin tu grangs med bskal pa ru/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /sngags pa rnams kyis dus gcig tu/ /tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob/ /ces so/ /longs spyod la yang mtshan nyid kyis 'dod yon spangs te bsgrub pa/ sngags las grogs su byed pa nyid rdo rje bkod pa las/ gang las spangs te rmad du gyur pa yi/ /longs spyod 'dod yon rnams pa lnga/ /thabs ldan sngags la grogs kyi mchog /skal pa ldan pas rab spyad bya/ /zhes so/ /rnal 'byor la'ang mtshan nyid la mnyam gzhag mi dmigs pa nam mkha' ltar stong pa bsgom zhing*/ rjes thob sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor lam du byed la/ sngags las dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor lam du byed pas 'phags so/ /bdag gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa la'ang*/ mtshan nyid las gnas skabs su cung zad phan pa tsam las cher mi 'grub/ sngags las char dbab pas mu ge zhi bar byed pa dang*/ rnal 'byor grub pas zas skom nor bu la sogs pa'i char 'bebs pa dang*/ nad dang 'khrug pa zhi ba la sogs pa yul 'khor tsam du bkra shis pa gzhan gyi don dang*/

rim gnyis bsam gyis mi khyab pas nang gi rtogs pa dang ting nge 'dzin skad cig re res kyang*/ gong nas gong du 'phel ba (1) rang gi don byed pas 'phags pa yin no/ /dgongs pa'ang mtshan nyid las rgyu'i theg pa tsam las ma shes pa nyid/ sngags las 'bras bu gsang chen nges par byed de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sngags rnams kun kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi thugs yin te/ /chos kyi snying po sgrub byed pas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang yang dag ldan/ /ces so/ /bya dka' ba med pas ngal dub kyi mtha' spangs te/ tshegs chung ngus 'bras bu chen po 'grub pa'i phyir yang mtshan nyid las 'phags te/ thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /zhes sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /tshogs bsags pa'i khyad par la yang*/ mtshan nyid las thun mong gi tshogs sbyin pa tsam dang*/ tshul khrims tsam la sogs pa phar phyin drug tsam las med pas/ yun ring du 'gor ba las/ sngags su thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du shes pas/ ci longs spyod pa thams cad tshogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir rgya che ba dang*/ yo byad bdud rtsir shes pas bzang ba dang*/ rang bzhin dag mnyam du rtogs pas mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ nyon mongs rang bzhin gyis ma spangs (1) la dag pas tshogs gnyis myur du 'dums shing rdzogs pas tshe gcig gi (2) skye bas grol ba 'grub pa yin no/ /de ltar thabs lhag pa ltar thabs des bzhag pa'i shes rab kyang lam spyod pa'i tshe bla (3) lhag tu yod par shes par bya'o/ /mdor na thugs kyi gsang ba lam du byed pa dang*/ gsung gi gsang ba lam du byed pa dang*/ sku'i gsang ba lam du byed pa dang gsum du rig par bya ste/ ye shes grub pa'i rgyud las/ rgyu yi theg pa chen po las/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lam rnams kyi/ /gsang ba che las gsang sngags mchog /rab tu 'phags pa'i rig par bya/ /zhes so/ /de'ang mtshan nyid du sku snang la sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang*/ lus kyi bya ba tha mal gyi sgo nas dge ba la 'jug pa las med/

sngags su sku'i gsang ba snang srid/ lha dang gzhal yas khang dang*/ lus dkyil 'khor du rdzogs pa la phyag rgya gar la sogs pa'i 'du 'phro lam du byed pas 'phags so (4) / /mtshan nyid du gsung brag ca ltar stong pa dang*/ ngag kha ton nam 'jug pa bsdams te smra ba bcad pas dge ba la 'jug pa las/ sngags su gsung gi gsang ba sgra dbyangs ā li kā li'i rang bzhin du shes pas chos kyi char du phab pa dang*/ ngag gsung gi dkyil 'khor du ye nas gnas pas sgra tshig sngags su rang bzhin gyis shar te bzlas brjod kyis nus pa thogs pa med pas don grub pa'i phyir 'phags so/ / mtshan nyid du thugs dran rtogs rang bzhin med par rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ yid tha mal gyi rnam rtog 'phro 'du log nas ched du bkag pa'i zhi lhag bsgrub pa la/ sngags su  thugs kyi gsang ba (1) dran rtog chos nyid kyi rol bar shar ba las/ yid rang gsal rang byung gi ye shes su shar bas/ ting nge 'dzin chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du grub pa'i phyir/ thugs mi rtog par 'char ba'i dkyil 'khor du lhun gyis grub pas 'phags so/ /gzhan yang ḍom+bhi (2) he ru kas/ 'dir ni snod kyi khyad par dang*/ /snod du byed pa'i chos dang ni/ /gzhung dang lam gyi khyad par dang*/ /'bras bu dag gi khyad par gyis/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang*/ in+d+ra bhū tis/ bla ma'i khyad par dang snod dang cho ga dang las dang dam tshig dang sgom pa'i lta ba dang spyod pa'i khyad par kyis 'phags so zhes dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ de dag kun gyi gsang sngags

kyi/ /cho ga zab mo 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /zhes so/ /khyad par du (3) 'phags tshul rgyas pa (4) ni bskal par brjod kyang zad mi shes pa yod do/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i yin tshul ngos bzung ba la gsum las/ dus myur ba la ltos nas 'bras bur bzhag pa dang*/ thabs mchog tu gyur pas 'bras bur bzhag pa dang*/ 'bras bu dang 'dra ba lam du byed pas 'bras bur bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni thabs gang gis byang chub dus nye bar thob pas 'bras bur bzhag ste/ dper na mtshon rnon pos shing myur por chod pa la 'dis shing chod ces brjod la/ rtul pos dal gyis bsrings na chod kyang 'dis mi chod ces btags pa ltar/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pas ring por mi thob pa'i byang chub sngags su tshe rabs gcig la sogs pas thob pa'i phyir dus nye ring gi sgo nas kyang 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ / de'ang brtson 'grus chen pos tshe gcig la thob par bshad de/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ bskal ba bye ba du ma ru/ /bsgrub par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bas na/ /'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ bskal pa bye ba grangs med kyis/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos mi thob pa/ /gsang sngags tshe 'di'i cho ga yis/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /ces so/ /brtson 'grus 'bring gis bar dor grol ba ni/ rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ bu ga dgu yi steng phyogs nas/ /'phral du yid kyis 'pho byed na/ / nyin zhing (1) bram ze gsod pa dang*/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*/ /chom rkun las kyis (2) longs spyod pa/ /'di yi lam gyis grol 'gyur te/ /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ gzugs can phung po rang lus 'dis (3) / /tshe 'di nyid la ma grub kyang*/ /yid ni rdo rje'i sku grub nas/ /bar dor yang dag 'grub par 'gyur/

/ces pa dang*/ lam rim las/ brtson pa 'bring gi rnal 'byor ba/ /rnam smin 'byung ba'i lhag lus bzhag /rdo rje 'chang sar rig pas 'gro/ /rnam par smin zhes de la brjod/ /ces pa dang*/ ye shes thig le las/ yang na lus 'di spangs ma thag / bla na med pa'i ye shes sku/ /brtson pa mi ldan pas kyang 'grub/ /brtson 'grus ldan na smos ci dgos/ /zhes so/ /dbang po tha ma'i rab rnams skye ba phyi ma la grol te/ mtshan brjod las/ skyes ma thag tu 'gro ba'i bdag /ces pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ de phyir rnal 'byor blo ldan gyis/ /shin tu sbyor ba'i sems kyis ni/ /skye 'dir dngos grub ma thob kyang*/ /skye gzhan srid par dngos grub thob/ /ces so/ /tha ma'i 'bring ni skye ba bdun na grol te/ gsang ba mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yis skye ba bdun la ni/ /ma bsgoms kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ / ces so/ /tha ma'i tha mas kyang skye ba bcu drug na 'grub ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ pha rol phyin pa'i theg pas (1) ni/ /bskal ba grangs med mi 'thob pa/ /gal te rnal 'byor pa de brtson/ /tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan 'da'/ /yang na mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /skye ba bcu drug mya ngan 'da'/ /so so skye bo sangs rgyas nyid/ /'grub par 'gyur gyis gzhan du min/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa thabs mchog tu gyur pas 'bras bur bzhag pa ni/ dper na gcig gis nyin bdun du 'bad pa'i bya ba de/ gcig gis skad cig la thabs kyi bya ba de grub dus/ bya ba de gnyis kyi 'bad pa che chung mi 'dra yang ngo bo 'dra ba ltar/ mtshan nyid du sems rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub pa'i zhi lhag lo dang zla bas mi 'grub pa dus ring mo zhig na 'grub nas mnyam par bzhag pa la sogs pa de nyid/ sngags kyi lam du nyin zhag gcig tsam la lus dang rtsa'i gnad las 'char ba dngos su gtan la dbab tu yod pas kyang*/

'bras bu lam du byed par bzhag ste/ pad+ma rtse mo las/ shin tu dka' bas mi grub pa/ /skad cig yang dag sbyor ba'i phyir/ /rgyu sngon song la ma ltos par/ /gnad las 'bras bu 'byin pa'i phyir/ /'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa 'bras bu rang dang 'dra ba lam du byed pas 'bras bu'i theg par gzhag pa ni/ sangs rgyas de dri ma thams cad dang bral dus sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa zhing gi yon tan bkod pa yongs su rdzogs par 'char ba de dang 'dra ba zhig bsgoms pas/ dbyings la de ltar yod pa'i dri ma bsal stobs kyis/ mngon du byed pa'i phyir 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya ste/ de nyid (1) las/ dri med dbyings kyi rang bzhin ni/ /sku gsum ye shes zhing dang bcas/ /gang tshe dag pa de nyid du/ /rang gsal mngon du 'char ba dang*/ /'dra ba lam du byed (2) pa la/ /'bras bu'i theg par yang dag brjod/ /ces byung bas/ dbyings ngo bo nyid kyi 'bras bu dam par/ ye nas bzhugs pa de'i rang bzhin shes pa gzhir byas nas/ de nyid la slob (3) pa'i phyir 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /de'ang dri ma sel ba la ltos nas bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa bsgom ste/ de kho na nyid la sbyangs pas glo bur gyi dri ma dag par byed do/ /de'i phyir yid kyis sgom pa lha dang*/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin yang*/ dbyings kyi 'bras bu lha dang dkyil 'khor dngos lam du byas te sgom pa ma yin yang*/ dbyings de'i don dang nye ba'i phyir lam zab mo slu ba med pa yin par lta'o/ /des na dbyings dngos lam du bya mi nus par rgyu'i theg pa dang 'dra yang*/ rnam pa 'dra ba dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad kyis lam nye ring la khyad che ste/ nor bu dang mar me gnyis mtshan mo bsgrigs yod pa las rkun po (4) gnyis kyis 'od la nor bur zhen nas blangs ba las/ rkun bu rmongs pa des mar me thob la/

ma rmongs pa'i mkhas pa des nor bu thob pa bzhin du/ 'dod don myur du thob pa dang mi thob pa'i rgyu byed pa la khyad che ba nyid de rnam nges las/ nor bu sgron me'i 'od dag la (1) / /nor bu'i blo yis mngon rgyug pa/ /log pa'i shes par khyad med kyang*/ /ji ltar don byed la khyad yod/ /ces bshad pa bzhin no/ /des na 'dir 'bras bu ni sku gsung thugs yin la/ de dang 'dra ba mngon du byed tshul yang*/ dang po dbang bskur ba'i tshe slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sa chog dang*/ sta gon byas te/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa'i rjes la/ slob dpon nyid bdag 'jug blangs nas/ slob ma bcug ste dam tshig dang sdom pa phog nas ye shes mngon du phab pa ni thugs mngon du byas pa yin la/ me tog dor gdong g.yogs bkrol nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ sku mngon sum du byas pa'o/ /dbang bskur ba'i rjes la sngags dang phyag rgya'i rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ gsung mngon du byas pa zhes bya ste/ lus ngag yid gsum la dbang bzhi bskur bas dri ma dag nas/ sku gsung thugs mngon du byas pa ste dang por dbang mnos nas/ grol lam gyi tshe de'i rgyun sgom zhing sku gsum (2) ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du shes pas 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes bya ste/ gsang ba rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus thams cad ni/ /sku gsum yongs su grub pa gsang sngags theg chen te/ /sku gsum nyid la 'jug pa 'bras bu'i theg pa yin/ /sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /zhes so/ /lam du sku dang ye shes ji ltar byed na bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ bsgom pa'i dang por stong pa nyid bsgom pa ni chos sku/ de'i ngang nas lha'i sku bsgom pa longs sku/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sems can gyi don byed pa sprul sku/ nyon mongs pa lnga thabs kyis dag pa ye shes rnam pa lnga ste/

gsang 'dus las/ 'di yis chos kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho (1) rnam par brgyan/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ dur khrod rgyan las/ stong pa mngon 'gyur chos sku la/ /mtshan dpe bde ba longs spyod sku/ /rol pa mdzad pa sprul sku la/ /zhes pa dang*/ ye shes rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyud las/ chos dbyings ye shes chen po las/ /bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa rmad du byung*/ /snying rje chen po las byung ba/ /sprul sku rmad byung rol bar shar/ /ces so/ / sngags kyi theg pa yang dri ma sbyong byed lam gyi char gyur na/ 'bras bu lam du byed ces pa gang (2) / rgyu'i theg pa dri ma sbyong byed du bskyed pa'i phyir mtshungs so snyam na/ khams kyi dri ma cig car dag nas sangs rgyas grub par gcig mod kyang*/ dus nye ring dang*/ mtshan nyid kyis yun ring 'bad pa'i lam gyi drod tsam sngags kyi skad cig la lam du byed kyang*/ dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas pa ji lta ba dang mtshungs pa bsgom pas spang bya'ang (3) grogs su 'char ba'i phyir/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa yin gyis mthar thug gi  'bras bu (4) ji lta ba  dngos su lam du (5) byed pa ma yin pa'i phyir lam zab la rgya che ba bsgom dgos par byung ngo*/ /spyir rgyu 'bras kyi rnam par bzhag nas kun rdzob go bar byed pas/ 'bad pa tshegs chen po'i rgyus bskyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i 'bras bu'i tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa sbyong ba'i lam la rgyu zhes btags te mtshan nyid kyi theg  pa'o (6) / /tshegs chung ngus thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa tshogs dang 'bad rgyus ma bskyed pa'i phyir/ 'bras bur bzhag pa des dri ma sbyong ba la 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes brjod do/ /de dag gi chos kyi rnam grangs kyang dang po nas rgyu rkyen gyi rnam gzhag lam gtso bor bstan nas mthar thug 'bras bu ston pa dang*/

dang po nas dbyings dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag 'dus ma byas pa blang dor ro mnyam ye nas sangs rgyas pa gtso bor ston pa yin no/ /rgyu 'bras ltar dbye dus sku gsum ye shes dang bcas pa lam du blangs pas 'bras bu yang de 'dra ba skye bar rigs te/ khams kyi dri ma de dag stobs kyis yon tan gsar du snang ba nas mthar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes kyis brgyan pa thob nges so/ /mtshan nyid las tshogs gnyis tsam las/ sku dang ye shes su bsgom pa med pas rgyu 'bras rnam pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ yun ring du mi thob pa'ang rgyu 'bras rang gi grub mtha' nang 'gal ba'i phyir gsang sngags 'phags par grub pa yin no/ / don gnyis pa khyad par can gyi gsang sngags nyid bshad pa la gnyis te/ gsang sngags ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rnam par gzhag pa dngos so/ /dang po ni thog ma dang tha ma med dus nas/ grangs med pa'i rdo rje 'chang rim pas byon cing bzhugs la slad kyis 'byon pa thams cad kyis dbang po shin tu rno ba'i gdul bya rnams la/ rnam grangs dpag tu med pas gsungs te/ mtshan brjod las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang*/ /zhes pas/ dus dang tshad dang ris su chad pa 'ga' yang med de/ thog ma med pa'i sngon rol nas rdo rje 'chang byon nas gsungs pa rnams/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa sangs rgyas nyid sems dpa'i tshul du bstan pa tshad med pa'i tshogs kyis/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams gzung zhing*/ zhing khams 'di dang phyogs bcu gzhan du/ rdo rje 'chang dpag tu med pa snga phyir gshegs te/ da ltar bzhugs pa dang bcas pa'i mdun du dus rtag par gnas pas thos pa bzung nas/ zhing de dag nas ma g.yos bzhin du/ zhing khams tha dad pa rnams su 'gro ba so so'i nang du rgyud kyi ming dang rnam grangs tshad med pa ston par byed de/

de'ang sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rdo rje phyag na rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ sku rdo rje 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa 'bras bu'i sems dpa' tshad med pas rang gis gsung pa po dang*/ zhu ba po dang*/ sdud pa po dang*/ chos dang gnas kyi rol pa mdzad nas gsang ba chen po rnams 'gro ba'i don du snang bar mdzad pa yin te/ he badz+ra las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*/ /rang gi tshogs sdud 'khor kyang nga*/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'ang nga*/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir phyag na rdo rje ni sngon rol ba'i sangs rgyas te/ ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces byung ngo*/ /des gsungs pa'i rgyud la dus 'di tsam nas gsang sngags byung zhes thog mtha' bsam par mi nus la/ ston pa'ang 'di kho nas gsungs zhes tshad gzung du med de/ 'jig rten gyi khams na rdo rje 'chang gi rol ba tshad med pa'i phyir/ re zhig mi mjed 'di'i dbang du byas na/ snod bcud kyi rim pa chags nas ma stongs kyi bar la thun mong gi sangs rgyas stong dang*/ sems dpa' gnyis byon pa'i tshul bstan nas/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis phyi'i rgyud sde 'ga' gsungs par 'dod la/ shākya thub pas rgyud bzhi rdzogs par gsungs pa'ang*/ kha cig tu shākya thub pa'i rnam pas dngos su gsungs te/ de nas bcom ldan shākya thub/ /nyid kyi zhal nas ljags bzang ba/ /ring zhing yangs pa brkyang mdzad de/ /zhes pa dang*/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dus 'khor gsungs pa la sogs pa dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bzhengs te gsungs par 'dod la/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas mos pas gsung bar 'dod do/ /de dag kyang phyag na rdo rje dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bzung nas rtag par gnas la/

thun mong ma yin pa'i ston pa/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas brjod du med pa'i tshogs kyis 'og min na rtag par bzhugs nas/ 'khor dpag tu med pa la sngar gsungs da lta gsung*/ phyis kyang gsung ba'i phyir dus kho ra khor yug tu snang ba yin no/ /de dag g-is gsungs pa'i rgyud kyang sngon bskal pa dang po nas 'di'i bar la phyag na rdo rje dang*/ dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang grub thob dang rig sngags 'chang dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bzung nas/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang mi'am ci dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas so so na/ dar zhing spyod pa las/ khyad par du 'dzam bu'i gling gi za hor dang*/ siṅga la dang*/ u rgyan la sogs mkha' 'gro'i gnas na bzhugs pa las/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub snying po dang*/ pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ bi ma la mi tra la sogs pas spyan drangs nas skal ldan so so la brgyud pa dag gis nyams su blangs pas grub pa brnyes pa'i grub chen brgyad cu la sogs pa rgya gar du byon pa dang*/ sngon rgyal blon gyi dus su yang bod du mang du byon pa yin no/ /rnam gzhag 'di ltar khong du ma chud pa'i blo chung sgro skur du smra ba dag rgya gar du ma grags pas rgyud yang dag pa ma yin te bod kyis byas pa'o zhes yang dag pa'i rgyud lung dang mdo mang po la skur pa 'debs pa ni ngan 'gror yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyu sog pa kho na'o/ /de'ang rgya gar gyi rgyud rnams kyang u rgyan dang*/ sham+bha la dang*/ ma la ya la sogs pa'i yul nas grub thob chen po rnams kyis spyan drangs te/ rgyud thams cad ni rgya gar na'ang bzhugs pa ma yin la/ gal te bzhugs su chug kyang khyed kyis lan re tsam phyin pas de thams cad mthong bar mi nus la/ gtsug lag khang chung re na bzhugs pa'i mdo rgyud kyi ming byang du ma 'dus pas gzhan rnams min par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir sngon gyi lam ston chen po rnams la smad par mi bya'o/

/bod 'dir rgya gar na yod pa dang*/ med pa'i mdo dang rgyud mang po bzhugs te/ sngon gyi slob dpon pad+ma la sogs pas u rgyan la sogs pa mkha' 'gro'i gling rnams nas rgyud sde mang du bsnams nas byon te bsgyur zhing*/ mdo yang nyi ma dngos grub kyis mes ma tshig gong du rgya nag la 'gyur ba'i mdo rnams las/ phal po che dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ 'dul ba lung la sogs pa mang po zhig rgya nag gi paṇ+ḍi ta ha shang ma hā yā na'i blo las bai ro tsa na dang 'ba' sangs shis lo tsā byas te bsgyur ba yin no/ /de'i phyir chos dang gang zag gi tshad ni thams cad mkhyen pa las gzhan gyis gzung bar mi nus te/ dkon brtsegs las/ 'od srungs nga'am nga dang 'dra bas chos dang gang zag gi tshod gzung bar rung gis/ gzhan dag gis ni ma yin te log par ltung ba'i phyir ro zhes so/ /chos kyang bka' yang dag pa ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung ste/ sprul sku de yang sngon byung gis da lta med do mi bsam ste/ rtag tu mos pa'i ngor 'byung la/ des sngon mdo dang rgyud ma grags pa gsal bar byed pa'ang srid pas skur pa mi btab la/ chos gang la thar ba'i lam du 'jug cing 'khor ba spong ba ston pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab tshad mar bzhag ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ khams gsum dag na nyon mongs spong byed gsung*/ /zhi ba'i yon tan brjod par mdzad pa gang*/ /de ni drang srong gsung yin ldog pa gzhan/ /ces pas

(1) grub la/ sangs rgyas ni rtag par bzhugs pas/ gdul bya'i don mdzad la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yang*/ ri dang shing dang pad+mo dang dpag bsam gyi (2) shing dang*/ skyes pa dang*/ bud med dang*/ khye'u dang*/ bu mo dang*/ bya dang ri dwags las chos kyi rnam grangs kyi sgra 'byung ba de yang bkar gsungs pa yod na/ sngar byung gis da lta mi srid ces log par mi lta ste/ byin gyis brlabs pa dag 'byung srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gang la yid ches pas dam par bzung nas yi dam du bya ba 'thad kyis/ gzhan la skur pa nam yang gdab par mi bya ba kho na'o/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud kyi byung tshul 'ga' zhig las/ phyag na rdo rjes za hor gyi yul/ ma la ya'i ri la/ rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la dbang bskur zhing glegs bam gyi char phab nas mi'i yul du snang bar byas pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa la sogs pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs pa mang du byung bar gsungs pa'ang de kho na bzhin te dgongs pa lung ston las/ 'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi/ /mi las skal ldan dra ma che/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /phyag na rdo rjes ston par 'gyur/ /ces byung la/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las/ rgyu la sbyor ba rgyu yi chos/ /'khor lo bzhin tu bskor byas nas/ / 'bras bu'i theg pa nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pa dang yang mthun pa yin no/ /sngon gyi dus su byung ba dag bcos ma yin na/ rtsom gzhi gang la byas/ de ltar na phyis 'byung ba rnams bcos mar 'gyur te/ don sngon bas lhag tu ma byung*/ tshig cung zad mi 'dra ba dang*/ mang nyung byung ba las med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gsar rnying gi rgyud chen po 'di dag la slob dpon grub chen mang du byon zhing*/ dbang dang byin rlabs zam ma chad par 'dug pas yang dag pa 'ba' zhig ste/ slob dpon de dag gis 'grel pa dang man ngag mang du mdzad pas yid ches par gzung ngo*/

/de'ang rgya gar na gsang sngags zhes pa tsam las/ 'di ni gsar ma'o/ /'di ni rnying ma'o zhes so sor dbye ba med na yang bod 'dir 'gyur snga phyis so sor grags te/ bai ro tsa na la sogs pa rgyal blon snga dar gyi dus su bsgyur ba nas bzung ste paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti'i bar du bsgyur ba'i rgyud la rnying ma zhes 'dod la/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po man chod bsgyur ba'i rgyud rnams la gsar ma zhes grags so/ /'di gnyis la go dka' sla dang*/ dbyings 'jal ba rlabs che chung ltar 'dug pa ni/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin pas rang dbang bsgyur nus pa'i phyir rlabs che bar mngon no/ /dus phyis kyi lo tsā ba rnams gang zag phal pa'i lugs kyi mkhas pa rnams byon pas/ tshig grims la go bar dka' ba ste/ rgya dpe'i tshig gi rim pa tsam las don 'gyur ma nus pas de ltar byung ba'o/ /theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa grub mtha' rin po che'i mdzod las/ gsang sngags don gyi 'grel dgod pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// // ༈ gnyis pa gsang sngags kyi rnam par gzhag pa dngos la gnyis te/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i rnam gzhag dang*/ rnying ma'i rnam gzhag ga ོ /dang po la bzhi ste/ gsang sngags spyi'i rang bzhin/ dbye ba/ phyi nang gnyis kyi khyad par/ nang pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po spyi'i rang bzhin la bzhi/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ nges tshig ming gi rnam grangs so/ /dang po mtshan gzhi ni/ 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang de la brten pa'i chos sbyang bya sbyong byed dang bcas pa thams cad yin no/ /de'ang sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras rnam pa bzhir 'dus te/ dbyings 'od gsal ba'i chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag ni sbyang ba'i gzhi'o/ /glo bur gyi sgrib pa las dang nyon mongs pa 'khor ba'i chos kun gzhi tshogs brgyad dang bcas pa ni sbyang bar bya ba'i dri ma'o/

/de'ang bag chags sna tshogs pa'i kun gzhi ni 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pas ldog la/ gnas lugs don gyi kun gzhi'i don mi ldog kyang*/ tha snyad kun gzhir btags pa'i ming gi cha de log nas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes zhes bya bar 'gyur ba'o/ /rnam shes gzhan rnams ldog pa'i cha las ye shes lhag ma bzhi 'char tshul ni bshad zin to/ / smin byed dbang bzhi bskur nas/ grol byed bskyed rdzogs sgom pas gsar du yon tan skye ba dang bcas pa'i cha las ye shes lam gyi char gtogs pa rnams ni sbyong byed kyi chos so/ /de ltar sbyangs pas dbyings la sgribs pa thams cad dag nas khams byang chub tu 'gyur bas/ sku dang ye shes lhun gyis grub pa mngon du 'gyur te/ rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i ngo bo ni khams la dri ma spyangs pa'i 'bras bu yin par shes par bya'o/ /de skad du'ang gsang ba grub pa las/ dbyings la bral ba dag thob 'bras/ /gsang sngags rnam pa bzhir bshad do/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa mtshan nyid ni/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang rjod byed thugs rdo rje'i gsang ba 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sngags rnams kun kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi thugs yin te/ /chos kyi snying po sgrub byed pas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang yang dag ldan/ /ces so/ /gsum pa nges tshig ni man+t+ra yā na zhes pas sngags kyi theg pa ste/ ma la na'i rkyen byin pas ma la ni yid de bdag tu 'dzin pa'i don gyi yid do/ /tra la tha'i rkyen byin pas tra tha la ni skyob pa ste/ de'ang myur du skyob/ bde bar skyob ces pa'o/ /myur ba ni skad cig gis nyon mongs pa'i phyogs ye shes su bsgyur ba la sogs pa mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar byed pa yin la/ bde bar skyob pa ni dka' thub la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal med par 'dod yon grogs su 'char ba'i don te/ ma hā mā yā las/

'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams la/ /ci bde bar ni brten pas 'grub/ / ces so/ /de dag gi don ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las myur du skyob pa bde bar skyob pas sngags zhes bya ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ ma ni yid ces bya ba ste/ /tra ni skyob bar byed pa'i don/ /ces pa dang*/ ra li gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyal po las/ yid skyob phyir na sngags yin te/ /rang sems las su rung ba dang*/ /rnam rtog gdon rnams las skyob phyir/ / 'di ni sngags kyi rgyal por gsungs/ /zhes so/ /ya la he du'i rkyen byin nas ya he tu zhes pa rgyu'i rang bzhin yin te/ gzhi lhun grub tu gnas pa des 'dong pas na theg pa'o/ /de la brten pa'i nyon mongs kyang thabs kyis grogs su 'char te/ gzhi yi dus su dug gsum po nyid/ lam thabs shes gnyis med du shes nas sbyangs pas mthar phyin pa'i tshe sku gsum gyi sar 'dong ba'i phyir theg pa zhes bya'o/ /ya ma rga zhes pas/ lam gyi dus su dug gsum po smin grol gnyis kyis sbyangs pas bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum zung 'jug tu shar te/ sku gsum gyi rang bzhin du shes pa'o/ /ya  ma'i sgra (1) ni ma zhes pas/ 'bras bu 'dir 'dong bas na theg pa ste/ 'bras bu'i dus su dbyings la dug gsum dag stobs kyis/ gti mug mi rtog pa chos kyi sku/ 'dod chags bde ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ zhe sdang gsal ba sprul pa'i sku yin pa'o/ /de'ang dug gsum tha mal du spyod pa thabs kyis grol te/ dam tshig dang sdom pas rgyud bsdams pa ni sngags kyi theg pa ste/ gsang 'dus las/ 'jig rten spyod las rnam grol ba/ /gang bshad dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /rdo rje kun gyi bsrung ba ni/ /sngags kyi theg pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ theg chen kun la rab 'jug pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa nyid du byed/

/ces so/ /bzhi pa ming gi rnam grangs bshad pa ni/ sngags kyi theg pa/ rdo rje theg pa/ 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /nyon mongs pa la sogs spang bya gnas su dag pa dang*/ bsgrub bya thob pa'i thabs la mchog tu bsngags 8 pas sngags (1) ste/ rig pa mchog las/ dbang thob yang dag sbyor ba la/ /mchog tu bsngags pas sngags zhes brjod/ /ces so/ /dbye na gsum ste/ dgongs pa grub pa'i rgyud las/ sngags rnams kun gyi dbye ba ni/ /rnam pa gsum du shes bya ste/ /rigs sngags thabs kyi ngo bo yin/ /gzungs sngags shes rab ngo bo yin/ /gsang sngags gnyis med ye shes so/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje theg pa ni sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i don la thabs chen pos sbyor ba yang*/ dbyings las ma g.yos par 'byung ba ste/ gsang 'dus las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /rdo rje theg par rab ston pa/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /rdo rje la dga' dag par gnas// des na sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs/ /rdo rje theg pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa gsang sngags kyi dbye ba la gsum ste/ dbye ba dngos dang*/ bzhir nges pa'i rgyu mtshan/ so so'i rnam grangs dgod pa'o/ /dang po ni dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i steng du/ brjod bya gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum/ ston pa'i rgyud kyi ngo bo la (2) dbye ba/ rjod byed rnam grangs kyis dbye na bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa dang rgyud sde bzhir 'dus pa yin te/ rdo rje snying po bkod pa'i rgyud las/ bde bar gshegs pas dgongs pa'i rgyud/ /rnam pa bzhi ru yang dag bshad/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med do/ /zhes so/ /de la dang po bya ba'i rgyud ni/ krī ya tan+t+ra zhes 'byung ste/ lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud 'grel las/ rgyud 'di ni spyir lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pas na bya ba'i rgyud ces bya'o zhes pa dang*/

su sid+dhi ka ra las/ ji ltar las la 'jug pa'i dus dag tu/ /lus 'di sa yis dril phyis byas nas su/ /chu chen rnyog pa med pa'i nang zhugs nas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa dag tu bkru bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de'ang lus kyi bya ba khrus chen po gsum phra mo'i khrus dang bcas pa dang*/ gos gsum brje ba dang*/ zas gsum za ba dang*/ smyung bar gnas pa dang*/ gtsang sbra dang dka' thub dang*/ 'dug stangs kyi khyad par skyil krung dang*/ phyag rgya 'ching ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ ngag gi bya ba bzlas brjod gtso bor byas nas/ sems kyis bdag bran dang*/ lha rje dpon du lta ba'i sgo nas bsgrub pas bya ba'i rgyud de/ dpung bzangs las/ dus su zos nas dus su khrus byas te/ /phreng ba me tog mar me spos dang dri/ /sha chang med pa'i lha bshos phul nas su/ /ku sha'i khri la 'dug nas bzlas brjod brtsam/ /zhes pa dang*/ bsam gtan bde ba 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pas smyung ba rjes su gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ grwa lnga las/ lus dang ngag gi gtsang sbra dang*/ /gsum pa yid kyi gtsang sbra dang*/ /bzhi pa bden par smra ba dang*/ /lnga pa phyi yi gtsang sbrar bshad/ /ces so/ / gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud ni u pa tan+t+ra zhes pas/ lus ngag gi bya ba cha mnyam nas spyod cing*/ sems kyis rang dang lha gnyis grogs ltar bsgrub pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang gi don bsdus las/ rgyud 'di ni gtsang sbra la sogs pa smad pas 'jig rten pa dang 'gal bar spyod pas spyod pa'i rgyud ces bya'o/ /de'ang lus ngag gi bya ba mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ sems kyi sgom pa cha mnyam nas spyod pa yin no/ / gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni/ yo ga tan+t+ra zhes pas/ lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor mi ston la/ sems kyi bya ba gtso bor ston pa ste/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'dir sgom pa gtso bor ston pa yin pas/ ci dga' ba'i bzlas pa bstan pa'i phyir zhes pa dang*/

de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa'i don bsdus las/ rgyud 'dir ni ting nge 'dzin sgom pa gtso bor ston pas na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces so/ /de'ang rang nyid dam tshig pa la lha ye shes pa bzhugs pas mnyam par bsgom pa yin no/ / bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ni/ ma hā yo ga tan+t+ra zhes pas/ sems kyi bya ba ye shes chen po gtso bor ston pa yin la/ blang dor med pas lus ngag gi bya ba'ang 'dod yon lnga thabs kyis spyod pa ste/ gsang 'dus las/ dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la/ /brten nas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ bde mchog las/ 8 des na (1) bde bas bde ba nyid/ /bde ba mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ ār+ya de bas/ bde ba chen po'i 'bras bu thob par byed pa la/ bde ba chen po'i thabs las gzhan med de/ de'i don du zas dang gnas la sogs pa'i bde bas/ dbang phyug chen po brgyad dang ldan pa'i bde ba bsgrub par bya'o zhes so/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni thun gsang las/ sku yi dbang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ /thugs kyi dbang phyug de bzhin 'phrin las dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul kun tu 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang*/ /gang 'dod gnas dang khyad par don brgyad do/ /zhes pa dang*/ bde mchog las/ phra zhing yangs la phra bar nus pa dang*/ /spyod pa nus dang bdag nyid chen po dang*/ /dga' mgur byed dang thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /ci 'dod byed dang dbang phyug don brgyad do/ /zhes so/ /bsgrub lugs ni gsum las (1) / thugs kyi dbang phyug khyad par gyi don phra ba ye shes kyi rlung*/ dbu ma'i sa/ thams cad ye shes su 'dres pas ches phra ba gsum la/ srog rtsol gyi rlung a wa dhū tīr tshud pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba dbu mar mthong pa'i ye shes 'char la/ rtsa dbu ma mthong ba 'byung la/

de'i dus su ye shes kyi rlung dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes 'char la/ rang bzhin gnyis su 'dzin pa nub nas 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ /sku'i dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa 'gro ba'i mos pa gang yod du 'gro ba'i 'phrin las can/ yab yum gnyis su med pa'i dga' ba/ dbang sgyur ba'i bdag nyid/ don spyod pa'i nus pa gsum la/ dbu mar ye shes kyi rlung 'dzin dus/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la spyod pas longs spyod 'du ba dang*/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku snang ba dang*/ gang la gang 'dul du sprul nus pas sems can gyi don byed pa rnams rang gi snang ba tsam du 'byung ngo*/ /gsung gi dbang phyug chos kyi rnam grangs gang 'dod pa la dbang bsgyur ba can/ sems can gyi dbang po'i skal pa bzhin chos ci 'dod ston pa dang*/ 'gro ba dbang du bsgyur bar bya ba gnyis la/ dbu mar rlung sems 'dres pa'i stobs kyis tshogs rdzogs pas/ 'gro ba mnyan pa dang*/ sgra skad sna tshogs shes pas chos ston pa na/ sems can gyi don 'byung ba'o/ /de lta bu'i nus pa la dbang thob pas dbang*/ zag med kyi yon tan la dngos su spyod nus pas na phyug ces bya'o/ / gnyis pa rgyud sde bzhir nges pa'i rgyu mtshan dgod pa la lnga las/ dang po mi rigs bzhi la dgongs nas rgyud sde bzhir gsungs te/ bram ze rnams khrus dang gtsang sbra gtsor ston pa la bya ba'i rgyud/ rje'u'i rigs rnams phyi khrus dang gtsang sbra nang ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyis gnas pa la spyod pa'i rgyud/ rgyal rigs yon tan dang 'byor pa chen pos yul khams skyong ba la/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ dmangs rigs gtsang btsog chung zhing nyon mongs rags pa

(1) la/ bya ba dang spyod pa dman pa la/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gsungs te/ bde mchog rol ba'i rgyud las/ bya ba bram ze gtsang dang bstun/ /spyod pa rje'u rigs de bas lhag /rnal 'byor rgyal po 'khor tshogs mang*/ /gzhi rmongs gdod nas grol ba ste/ /gzhan du su la'ang ma bstan par/ /mdzes ma khyod la bstan pa yin/ /ces pa dang*/ dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las kyang*/ bram ze rje'u rigs rgyal rigs dang*/ / dmangs rigs gdol ba 'dul don du/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med do/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa gang zag gi blo rigs bzhi la dgongs nas kyang bzhir gsungs te/ dbang po rab kyis tha ma la bya ba/ 'bring la spyod pa/ rab la rnal 'byor/ yang rab la bla med de/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa dus la ltos nas kyang bzhir gsungs te/ bskal pa dang po rdzogs ldan gyi dus na 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams la yon tan bzhi yod de/ tshe lo dpag tu med pa thub/ kha zas bdud rtsi la spyod pa/ lus la 'od yod pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba'o/ /de'i dus su bya ba'i rgyud do/ /de nas yon tan sngar bas chung du song ste/ tshe dang*/ 'od dang*/ rdzu 'phrul rnams 'gribs kyang*/ da dung tshe lo grangs med/ kha zas bdud rtsi la spyod (1) / 'od chag gang*/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa sa la ma reg tsam du 'gro bas/ yon tan gsum ldan gyi dus su spyod pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas longs spyod bdag tu bzung bas bdud rtsi'i kha zas 'gribs te sa'i zhag za zhing*/ kha dog gsal ba tsam yod pas gnyis ldan gyi dus su rnal 'byor rgyud do/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul med pas zhag kyang med 'bras sā lu za zhing*/ pho mo'i mtshan ma dod pas rtsod ldan du 'gyur dus bla med gsungs pa ste/

lha thams cad yang dag par 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ rdzogs ldan dang po bya ba'i rgyud/ /gsum ldan gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ /gnyis ldan gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rtsod ldan bzhi ba bla med do/ /dus bzhi la ni dgongs nas kyang*/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir bshad do/ /zhes pa dang*/ dur khrod rgyan las/ bskal pa rdzogs ldan gsum gnyis dang*/ /rtsod ldan dus bzhi'i rim pa yis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med do/ /zhes so/ / bzhi pa sbyangs gzhi 'dod chags kyi 'jug tshul bzhi la dgongs nas kyang bzhir gsungs te/ de'ang rdzogs ldan gyi dus na nyon mongs pa 'dod chags shas chung ste/ gcig la gcig bltas pa tsam gyis tshim pas de'i don du bya ba'i rgyud gsungs te/ lha rnams phan tshun gcig la gcig blta ba dang bcas pa ni/ rdo rje gtsug tor las/ dkar po'i ras la btags gnas shing*/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha tshogs rnams/ /pho yang mo la blta ba dang*/ /mo yang pho la blta ba bri/ /zhes pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ dbus su ni bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bri'o/ /de'i g.yon du na bza' dkar mo bcom ldan 'das la blta ba bri'o zhes pa dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rigs lnga'i lha mo lnga po ni/ /rgyal ba lnga yi phyogs su bri/ /zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gos dkar mo la gzigs so zhes pas/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi lha thams cad spyan rgyas par 'byung ba yin no/ /gsum ldan gyi dus su bgad pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags 'byung ste/ de'i don du spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs pa'ang*/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ mgon po ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /de yi g.yon phyogs lha mo ni/ /cung zad yid ni 'dzum bcas bri/ /zhes pa dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che/ /yid tsam 'dzum pa'i zhal du bri/ /zhes pas spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lha thams cad zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa 'byung ngo*/

/gnyis ldan gyi tshe gcig la gcig reg cing 'khyud pas/ tshim pa'i 'dod chags byung bas de'i don du rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs te/ dpal mchog dang po las/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha tshogs rnams/ /dpung pa yid tsam dam par bzhag /ces pa dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ lha mo rdo rje ca co sgrog /dpung 'khyud rang gi lha mo ni/ / 'dzum bcas kun tu blta ba yis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'khyud/ / ces so/ /des na yo ga'i lha thams cad phyag rgya dang 'brel par 'byung ngo*/ /rtsod ldan gyi dus su dbang po gnyis dngos su sbyor ba'i 'dod chags 'byung bas/ de'i don du bla med gsungs te/ brtag gnyis las/ bol+la kak+ko la sbyar ba/ /de yi bde ba khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po thams cad brtag par bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ mtshan ma gnyis la bsngags byas te/ /sngags pa mkha' 'gro ma la sbyor/ /ces so/ /de'i phyir bla med kyi lha thams cad yab yum 'khril sbyor du 'byung ba yin no/ /de skad du sgron gsal las/ skyes bu 'dod chags can don du/ /de yi byed pa rdo rje sems/ /zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba'i de nyid las/ dus ni rnam bzhi'i dbye ba yis/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /bgad pa dang ni blta ba dang*/ /de bzhin gzhan gyi lag bcangs nyid/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa gang yin pa/ /de ltar rgyud ni rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes so/ /mi rnams kyi rim pa ltar/ 'dod pa'i lha'i rim pas kyang bzhag ste/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed la sogs pa na bltas pas tshim pa'i don du bya ba/ 'phrul dga' la sogs na bgad pas tshim pa la spyod pa/ dga' ldan la sogs na 'khyud pas tshim pa la rnal 'byor/ sum cu rtsa gsum man chad na dbang po gnyis sbyor ba la bla med de/ brtag gnyis las/ bltas dang bgad dang lag bcangs dang*/ /'khyud dang gnyis sprod la sogs pa'i/

/rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhir gsungs so/ /zhes pa dang*/ sam+bu ṭi las/ bltas dang bgad dang lag bcangs dang*/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa gang yin pa/ /srin bu me yi tshul gyis su/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir gsungs so/ /zhes so/ / lnga pa lha bzhi'i rjes su 'jug pa'i phyin ci log bzhi gzung ba'i don du rgyud sde bzhir gsungs te/ gti mug can tshangs pa ni gtsang sbra chos su smra ste/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ 'dag chal dag gis bgos pa'i gos/ /dri ma med par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /lus la mchod sbyin gyis bgos la/ /'bab stegs bkrus pa de yis 'dag /ces pa'i tshul gzung ba'i phyir bya ba'i rgyud do/ / legs par grub pa las/ khrus byas gtsang ma gzung bya ste/ /bkra shis ngo mtshar bzung byas la/ /bsgrub pa'i rdzas ni rjes su bzung*/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ / zhe sdang can khyab 'jug 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i don du spyod pa ste/ rgyal rigs la ni rgyal rigs dang*/ /bram ze 'dod la bram ze bsad/ /zhes pa dang*/ rjes su mthun par rnam snang mngon byang las/ e ma ho gsod pa 'di ni bzang*/ /gsod pas byang chub thob par byed/ /ces so/ /nga rgyal can brgya byin rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnal 'byor gsungs pa yang*/ dbang phyug 'byor pa lha yi rgyud/ /rnal 'byor yang dag bshad pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'dod chags can dbang phyug ni 'dod chags chos su smra ste/ gau taṃ bud med me yin te/ /de yi nye gnas thab khung yin/ /ces pa 'dul ba'i don du bla med gsungs te/ gsang 'dus las/ bud med gzugs dang mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa la/ /byin gyis brlabs te gnas gsum du/ /dben par mchod pa rab tu brtsam/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa so so'i rnam grangs dgod pa la/ spyir sngags kyi rgyud sde sems can gyi blo dang chos kyi dbyings kyi rjes su byed pas mtha' dang grangs dang tshad dpag par gzung du ga la rung ste/

rdo rje 'chang grangs med pas thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'khor tshad med pa'i nang du gsungs pa'i phyir nam mkha' bzhin no/ /'dir sde tshan gyi nang du 'dus tshul gyi rnam grangs cung zad dgod na/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi rim pas der 'bab pa'i khams dang rlung gi 'du ba las ye shes sam chos kyi rnam grangs de tsam zhig 'char ba dang bstun nas brjod de/ bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /khrag 'bab par ni shes par bya/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /byang chub sems ni rab tu 'bab/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /rlung rgyu bar ni shes par bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi rim lnga'i 'grel pa las/ sngags kyi dbye ba ni stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis so zhes so/ /de dag gi mtshan cung zad re bstan na rgyud sde bzhi'i dang po bya ba'i rgyud la chings gsum las/ spyi ltar bcings na mchod pa dang gtor ma gtso bor ston pa legs par grub pa/ ting nge 'dzin bsgrub pa gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gtso bor ston pa gsang ba spyi'i rgyud/ spyod pa gtso bor ston pa dpung pa bzang po dang bzhi'o/ /bye brag tu sku gsung thugs ltar bcings na/ sku'i rtsa rgyud rdo rje gtsug tor/ bshad pa'i rgyud la 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba'i rgyud rnam par rol pa/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa yid bzhin mchog gi rgyud/ bstod pa glur blangs kyi rgyud/ rdo rje 'phreng ba bshad rgyud cho ga 'dus pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsung gi rtsa rgyud pad+ma brtsegs pa/ bshad rgyud pad+ma cod pan la sogs pa'o/ /thugs kyi rtsa rgyud rig pa mchog bshad rgyud mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs la sogs pa'o/ /byung tshul ltar bcings na/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu las gdugs dkar mo can/ ljags las pad+ma brtsegs pa/ dpung pa las dpung pa bzang po/

thugs las rigs pa mchog phyag las phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba/ lte ba las su si ti ka ra/ gsang ba las don yod zhags pa/ zhabs las 'byung po 'dul byed/ skye mched las yid bzhin nor bu/ dngos grub bum pa/ 'od zer can/ sgrol ma la sogs pa'o/ /mdor na mdo sde dang gzungs 'bum gyi nang na/ la la la rtogs pa zhes bya/ la la la gzungs zhes bya ba rab tu mang ba rnams te/ bsdu na rgyud sde stong phrag bzhi'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi rtsa rgyud rnam snang mngon byang*/ bshad rgyud kun nas bkod pa rgyan chen po glang po che rol pa/ bde ba'i myu gu la sogs pa'o/ /kha cig 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba le'u khri drug stong pa la sogs pa 'jam dpal gyi skor rnams yin par 'dod kyang*/ rnal 'byor chen por gtogs pa bde ba'i myu gu bzhed pas mi 'thad do/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba ni spyod pa'i rgyud ces ming du yod kyang ngo bo med de bya ba dang rnal 'byor rgyud gnyis su 'dus zer yang*/ cha mnyam du ston pa yod pas logs su yod par 'thad do/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la/ rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ dam tshig mngon par 'byung ba/ dum bu bzhi pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dum bu/ don thams cad grub pa'i dum bu/ ngan song sbyong ba'i dum bu/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dum bu/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyud gsum/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyud/ ngan song sbyong rgyud rtogs pa bdun cu pa/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ thabs pha'i rgyud/ shes rab ma'i rgyud/ gnyis su med pa bla na med pa'i rgyud dang gsum las/ dang po la rtsa ba'i rgyud la gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa rgyud 'bum pa/ mi'i yul na bzhugs pa le'u bcu bdun pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud la dgongs pa lung ston/

ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ rdo rje 'phreng ba lha mo bzhis zhus pa/ 'phros pa cha mthun gyi rgyud la/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gshed dmar la sogs pa'o/ /dum bu'i rgyud la sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud le'u 'bum dang nyi khri lnga stong pa'i nang nas/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ras phyung ba la gtso bor 'chi bdag gshin rje 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po zhal gsum pa'i rgyud/ gzhon nu gdong drug 'dul ba'i gnyen por gzhon nu gdong drug pa'i rgyud/ dbang phyug chen po 'dul ba'i gnyen por 'jigs byed rtogs pa bdun pa zhal dgu pa'i rgyud do/ /yan lag gi rgyud la/ rdo rje snyoms 'jug gsang ba'i rgyud/ khro bo bcu'i rgyud/ sngags don gsal ba rdo rje rgyas 'debs/ rdo rje dri ma med pa/ dbang bskur ba kun nas bkod pa/ rdo rje snying po 'byung ba/ rdo rje mngon par 'byung ba la sogs pa'o/ / ma'i rgyud la/ kun gyi rtsa ba rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bkod pa/ sku'i rgyud bde mchog 'khor lo/ gsung gi rgyud ma hā mā yā/ thugs kyi rgyud kyai'i rdo rje/ yon tan gyi rgyud thig le chen po/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud rdo rje gdan bzhi'o/ /ma rgyud sde bzhi la/ mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i rgyud/ rgya mtsho bde ba'i rgyud/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ gser gyi char pa lta bu'i rgyud do/ /'phros pa cha mthun gyi rgyud la/ 'phrin las la dga' chen zla nus kyi rgyud/ bde chen sgeg ma mā ma kī'i rgyud/ gsang ba yid bzhin bde ba'i rgyud/ rgyud de rnams la phan pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro (1) bskyed rim rnam dbye rgyas par ston pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i rgyud/ bsdus par ston pa rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ mo 'ba' zhig ston pa phag mo mngon 'byung*/ de'i khyad par ston pa khrag 'thung mngon 'byung*/ rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud/

las gtso bor ston pa las rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi (2) las ston pa sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ 'phrin las ston pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ dbang bzhi ston pa lta ba rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ mngon spyod ston pa dus gnad rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ rlung gi las ston pa sdom pa 'byung ba/ brtul zhugs kyi las ston pa sangs rgyas thod pa/ thun mong gi gnas la gdams pa ra li la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis su med pa'i rgyud la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo la (3) sogs pa'o/ /'di dag deng sang rgya bod phal la grags che bar rags par bkod pa ste/ phran la bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs te/ sdom 'byung sangs rgyas thod pa las/ rnal 'byor pha rgyud rnams kyi tshad/ /bye ba phrag ni dgu bcur nges/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grangs/ /zhes so/ /don gsum pa gsang sngags phyi nang gi khyad par la/ bya ba spyod pa/ rnal 'byor gsum ni phyi pa yin la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ni nang pa yin te/ smin byed dbang dang*/ grol byed lam bsgom pa'i khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni rgyud sde gang du'ang dbang bzhi tshang bar mi ston zhing*/ khyad par du rig pa'i dbang tsam las mi ston na phyi pa yin te/ dpal ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud las/ bum pa chu yi dbang bskur ba/ /bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs pa ste/ /cod pan dag gi dbang bskur ba/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la zhugs pa yin/ /rdo rje dril bu byin pa yis/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gtogs pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dbang*/ /bya ba'i rgyud las rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu gsal/ /phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar bya/ /de ni drug gi bye brag dbang*/ /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/
/rnal 'byor bla med kyi ni

mtshan/ /gsang ba yi ni dbang rgyal bshad/ /shes rab ye shes bla na med/ / bzhi pa de ltar de bzhin no/ /zhes pas bum pa'i dbang yan chad ni phyi pa'o/ / rgyud sde gang du'ang dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur na nang pa yin te/ gsang 'dus las/ bum pa'i dbang bskur dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur dang*/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes dang*/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ / zhes so/ / gnyis pa grol lam gyi khyad par la drug las/ dang po rtogs pa lta ba'i khyad par ni/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa dkyil 'khor gsum du shes pas dag mnyam blang dor med par rtogs pa'i dbyings gzhir byed na nang pa/ mi byed na phyi pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsgom pa lha'i khyad par la/ lha ci tsam yod kyang zhal sbyor med na/ phyi pa yin la/ yod na nang pa'o/ /gsum pa gnas kyi khyad par ni/ rgyal po'i khang bzangs dang*/ ri rab kyi steng la sogs pa'i gnas gtsang mar mos pa byed pa ni phyi pa yin la/ dur khrod dam u rgyan la sogs par mos pa byed na nang pa'o/ /bzhi pa bya rim spyod pa'i khyad par ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa gtso bor byed na phyi pa ste/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ 'bags pa dang ni ma dag pa/ /dogs pa'i 'du shes byung na yang*/ /dben par gtsang sbras gnas par bya/ /zhes (1) so/ /gtsang sbra mi byed cing bza' btung ci dga' la longs spyod nus na nang pa ste/ gsang 'dus las/ sha la sogs pa brtags te bza'/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa snod spyad kyi khyad par ni/ rin po che la sogs pa gtsang bar mos na phyi pa/ ka pā la la gtso bor byed na nang pa ste/ gsang ba spyod pa las/ bzang po'i snod ni dum bu gcig /de yi nang du bza' bar bya/ /zhes so/ /drug pa rdzas kyi khyad par ni/ dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs gtsang ma'i zas la spyod pa ni phyi pa/ sha lnga bdud rtsi dngos sam bdud rtsi ril bu tsam gyis byin gyis brlabs te mos pa byed pa ni nang pa ste/

legs par grub pa las/ ngas ni bsngags pa kha zas dkar gsum dang*/ /rtsa ba sdong bu 'bras bu'i tshod ma dang*/ /'bru mar tshig ma dar ba 'ol skom dang*/ /thug pa rnams ni bza' btung yin par gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ bshang gci dang ni khrag dag bza'/ /chang la sogs pa rtag tu btung*/ /sha chen rtag tu bza' bar bya/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /don bzhi pa gsang sngags nang pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ thun mong gi rab tu dbye ba dang*/ dbye ba so so'i don no/ /dang po ni rgyud sde gsum du dbye ba yang gnyis su 'dus te/ gnyis su med pa ni thabs shes cha mnyam dbyer med du ston pa las/ dag pa dang*/ rnam grangs dang*/ grub mtha' mi gcig pa med pa'i phyir na gnyis su bshad de/ dgongs pa kun tu grags pa'i rgyud las/ theg mchog bla na med pa yang*/ /ye shes che ba'i khyad par las/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba gnyis su bshad/ /pha rgyud bla na med pa dang*/ /ma rgyud bla na med pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis su phye ba'i rgyu mtshan la/ spyir na sems can gyi khams la/ pho dang mo gnyis su 'dus pas/ de gnyis kyi don du thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud gnyis su (1) gsungs pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ skyes pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud bstan cing*/ /btsun mo rnams ni dga' ba'i phyir/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud gsung*/ /zhes so/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par la/ spyir snang ba bskyed pa'i rim pa thabs dang*/ rdzogs rim las rlung gtso bor byung na pha'i rgyud la/ stong pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa shes rab dang*/ rdzogs rim las thig le gtso bor 'don na ma'i rgyud de/ gsang ba grub pa las/ rnal 'byor mchog la rnam pa gnyis/ /thabs nyid bskyed pa rlung dang ni/ /shes rab rdzogs pa byang chub sems/ /'khor lo bzhi yi gnas dag tu/ /ye shes nam mkha'i khams sdud pa'o/

/zhes pas phye la/ bye brag tu khyad par bdun gyis shes par bya ba las/ dang po de kho na nyid kyi khyad par la/ gang du dbang dang*/ spyin sreg dang*/ rab gnas dang*/ dngos grub dang*/ 'phrin las bsgrub pa la sogs pa'i cho ga mi 'dra ba dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin kyis rgya che ba gtso bor ston na pha'i rgyud la/ gang du bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim dang*/ dngos grub la sogs pa zab pa gtso bor ston na ma'i rgyud do/ / gnyis pa skyed rim gyi khyad par la/ dkyil 'khor gang du gtso bo go 'pho zhing gtso mo mi 'pho na ma'i rgyud la/ gtso mo 'pho zhing gtso bo mi 'pho na pha'i rgyud de/ phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi bstod 'grel las/ gang zhig gtso bo 'pho byed cing*/ /gtso mo dag ni mi 'pho na/ /byis pa dag gis rtog bya'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud du bshad/ /gang zhig gtso mo 'pho byed cing*/ /gtso bo dag ni mi 'pho na/ /rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud du bshad/ /ces so/ /dper brjod na/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du gtso bo rnam snang yin la/ gtso mo dbyings phyug ma (1) gnas pa las/ rnam snang gi shul du mi bskyod pa byung nas/ dbyings phyug yum du gnas na/ ma'i rgyud de shān ti pas/ 'khor lo can gyi rten gnas kyis/ /gang zhig rgyal gzhan dbus mar 'gyur/ /de yi gnas su mi bskyod gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ mar me mdzad kyis btus pa las/ de yi dbus gnas gang yin pa/ /de yi 'khor lo de zhes bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag po/ /de nas mi bskyod yang dag gnas/ /gzhan la rdo rje de gnas la/ / rang bdag kho na rang gi bdag /phyung nas sngon du blo ldan pas/ /cho ga bzhin du thim par bya/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe rigs bdag kyang mi bskyod pa byung bas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ gang zhig gang gi lha bdag po/ / de ni de dang de rgyas gdab/ /ces pa dang shān ti pas/

gang tshe 'khor gtso sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /phyung ba der ni bstim par bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtso bor 'gyur/ /de yi rigs bdag bstim par bya/ /rgyal ba la gzhan dkyil 'khor la/ /gal te 'khor lo'i gtsor byed na/ /dbus ma de yang de bzhin nyid/ /rang gnas su yang gzhan de nyid/ /ces so/ /de bzhin du rigs gzhan rnams kyang phan tshun du go brje la/ gtso mo go mi brje ba ni ma'i rgyud do/ sku yis sku'i tshe rnam snang nyid la/ sku'i dkyil 'khor der sku'i gsung bsgrubs na 'od dpag med/ sku'i thugs la mi bskyod pa/ sku'i yon tan la rin 'byung*/ sku'i phrin las la don grub/ dbus su gtso bo 'phos pa'i shul der/ dbus ma'i rnam snang 'phos na/ de ba'i yum dang sbyor bas go brje ba yin no/ /de bzhin du (1) gsung gi dkyil 'khor tshe dpag med lta bu'i/ gsung gis gsung gi tshe dpag med/ gos dkar mo dbus su gnas pa las/ gsung gi sku bsgrubs na rnam snang*/ thugs la mi bskyod pa/ yon tan la rin 'byung*/ phrin las la don grub/ dbus su gos dkar mo dang gnas la/ dbus kyi tshe dpag med gzhan de'i shul gyi yum dang sbyor ba yin no/ /de bzhin du thugs mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo mi bskyod pa gzhan dang go brje tshul/ yon tan rin 'byung gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor rin 'byung dang gzhan bzhi brje tshul/ phrin las don yod grub pa dang gzhan bzhi brje tshul de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /ma'i rgyud kyi'ang tshul de dag bzlog pa'i dpes khong du chud par bya'o/ / des na dkyil 'khor gcig tu'ang dkyil 'khor rigs lnga lnga sgrub par byed la/ gang zag gcig gi dbang du byas na'ang me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs de'i gtso bor dbus su brten nas bsgrubs na dngos grub nye ba yin te/ nye ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rigs yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa rnam pa'am cha lugs kyi khyad par la/

gang du lha pho'i rnam pa mang zhing khyad par du rigs bzhi'i gnas su lha pho'i dbyibs 'byung na/ cha lugs 'jig rten pa dang mthun par stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs/ dbu rgyan dang rna rgyan dang*/ rin po che dang*/ sbrul la sogs pas brgyan pa ni pha rgyud yin la/ gang du lha mo'i rnam pa mang zhing khyad par du rigs bzhi'i gnas su lha mo'i dbyibs 'byung zhing*/ gcer bur skra grol ba/ thal ba'i gos dang rus pa'i rgyan dang*/ ro'i gdan la sogs pa yod na ma rgyud de/ he badz+ra las/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /mgul gyi 'phreng ba rin chen gdags/ /zhes pa dang*/ ra li las/ gdan gyi khyad par ro yi gdan/ /rgyan gyi khyad par rus pa'i rgyan/ / gos kyi khyad par thal ba'i gos/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa phyogs kyi khyad par la/ mngon rtogs la sogs pa'i tshe g.yas skor du bskor ba pha rgyud la/ g.yon skor byed pa ma rgyud de/ nges 'byed bla ma las/ g.yon skor du ni bskor ba yis/ / mchod pa dgod dang gtor ma bya/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa mtshon par bya ba'i khyad par la/ gtso bor skyes pas mtshon cing*/ dus nyin mo dang*/ yar ngo gtso cher byed pa pha rgyud la/ de las bzlog pa ma rgyud de/ bde mchog las/ nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mtshan mo shes rab brtag par bya/ /zhes so/ /drug pa rdzogs rim gyi khyad par la gang du rtsa'i sgo nas thig le'i bde ba lam du byed pa ma rgyud la/ rlung gi sgo nas gsal ba lam du byed pa pha rgyud de/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i rgyud las/ gsang ba mchog gi khyad par ni/ /bde ba lam du byed pa ste/ /rtsa yi de nyid rtogs gyur pa/ /de nyid rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ /rlung gi de nyid rtogs gyur pa/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud/ /ces pa dang*/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa ru/ /steng 'og rlung la zung du 'jug /shes rab rnal 'byor bla ma ru/ /si la ga bur zung du 'jug

/ces so/ /bdun pa rnam dag gi khyad par la/ gtso cher phung po khams dang skye mched rnam par dag pa lha dang lha mor ston pa pha rgyud de/ gsang 'dus las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ / sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i dam tshig ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid yin/ /ces so/ /rtsa dang khams rnam par dag pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mar ston pa ni ma rgyud de/ bde mchog las/ so dang sen mo rnam par dag pa ni dpa' bo keng rus chen po'o zhes pa dang*/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ gnas der bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rtsa yi gzugs su yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ rtsa ni gnyis gnyis rnal 'byor ma/ /re re'ang rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /ro ma rkyang ma kun 'dar ma/ /bdag med rnal 'byor mar shes bya/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gtso che chung gi sgo nas bzhag gi gzhan du na rtsa rlung khams kyi dag pa pha rgyud las kyang skabs 'gar bshad la/ phung khams skye mched dag pa ma rgyud las kyang gsungs te/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad de/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug/ de bzhin 'du byed rdo rje rgyal/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /thams cad rang bzhin he ru ka /zhes pa dang*/ ra li'i dam tshig chen po las/ gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad la/ /tshor ba la sogs de dang 'dra/ /sa ni sangs rgyas spyan yin te/ /chu la sogs pa de bzhin te/ /mig la sogs pa'ang de bzhin no/ / zhes 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gtso che chung gi dbang gis de ltar rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /mdor bsdu na bde ba khams las ting nge 'dzin bsgrubs te/ mchog bsgrub pa ma'i rgyud la/ gsal ba rlung gi thabs las mchog 'dod pa pha'i rgyud de/ de gnyis ka'i gtso de ltar byed pa las/ grogs su rtsa rlung khams su gnad du bsnun pa las/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi thabs las/ sku dang ye shes kyi gnas lugs mngon du byed par 'dod do/

/theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa grub mtha' rin po che'i mdzod las/ thugs (1) rdo rje gsang ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// // don gnyis pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i rnam par gzhag pa la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni gdod ma'i mgon po dpal kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed pa thams cad kyis/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can gyi don du/ 'jig rten gyi sgron ma rnam par bkod de 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro cog thams cad kyang bsdu na rnam pa gsum du gsungs te/ bkod pa chen po las/ bstan pa'i lugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /ji ltar skas kyi rim pa bzhin/ /dbang po'i don du bstan pa dang*/ /'o ma las ni mar bzhin du/ /bsdu ba'i don du bstan pa dang*/ /tsha ba'i nad la ga bur bzhin/ /gnyen po'i don du bstan pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgra thal 'gyur las/ gsungs tshul dgongs pa gsum dang bcas/ /gnyen po bsdu dang dbang po'i don/ /tshig rnams bsdus te snang bar byas/ /de ma yin pa brjod pa'i tshig / dus gsum rgyal bas gsungs pa med/ /ces so/ /de ltar tshul rnam pa gsum las/ gnyen po la dgongs te gsungs pa ni/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi sgo dang rnam grangs de snyed cig bstan pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ nyon mongs stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por/ chos stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gsungs so/ /gsung ngo*/ /gsung bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ /bsdu ba la dgongs te gsungs pa ni chos kyi tshul (1) rgya mtsho thams cad kyi nang nas chos zab cing rgya che ba/ rdo rje snying po'i theg pa ste/ ye shes grub pa las/ ston pa'i gsung ni rgya mtsho kun/ /bsdus te snying po'i bcud phyung ba/ /gsang chen nges pa 'di yin te/ /'di ma snang bar grol ba med/

/ces pa lta bu'o/ /dbang po la dgongs te gsungs pa ni 'jig rten pa lha mi'i theg pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa theg pa gsum gyi rim pa ste che long dang*/ sor bzhag lha mi'i theg pa/ phyin ci log mu stegs kyi theg pa/ yang dag pa nang pa'i theg pa ste/ zhib brtsegs la dgongs nas gsungs pa yang thal 'gyur las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis dag gis/ /'gro ba rnams la chos bstan to/ /zhes pa dang*/  'jig rten pa dang 'das pa ste/ /theg pa dag ni gnyis su 'dod/ / (2) gzhi ni 'jig rten pa yin te/ /'di la 'dod pa rnam pa gnyis/ /'das pa rgyu dang 'bras bu las/ /rgyu la gsum dang 'bras la gnyis/ /gnyis po las phyed drug tu 'gyur/ /'di ltar dbang po'i rim pas so/ /zhes pa dang*/ bkod pa chen po las/ rim dgu blo dang bstun nas ni/ /che long dang ni zhib brtsegs so/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la/ rnam dbye spyir bstan pa dang*/ gsang sngags bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni theg pa'i rim pa dang sbyar na dgu/ rgyud sde drug tu dbye ba las/ theg pa dgu ni chung ngu'i chung ngu nyan thos/ 'bring rang rgyal/ chen po byang sems te gsum po ni rgyu'i theg pa yin la/ drug ni 'bras bu'i theg pa ste/ 'bring gi chung ngu krī ya/ 'bring u pa/ chen po yo ga gsum ni phyi pa/ ma hā a nu/ a ti gsum ni nang pa ste/ rgyud sde drug dang bcas pa ni thal 'gyur las/ 'das pa rgyu dang 'bras bu las/ /rgyu la gsum dang 'bras la gnyis/ /gnyis po las phye drug tu 'gyur/ /'di ltar dbang po'i rim pas so/ /de ltar dgu la brten nas ni/ /khams gsum po yang yang dag gi /

lam du 'dzud par byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa gsang sngags bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ phyi thub pa rgyud kyi theg pa dang*/ nang pa gsang sngags chen po'i theg pa'o/ /dang po ni gtsang sbra dang sgo gsum gyi bya byed gtso bor ston pas sprul sku'i theg pa chung ngu gsum dang chos mthun pa'i phyir/ phyi thub pa zhes bstan la/ gsang sngags kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i chos chen por gyur pa gzhi dang*/ lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag zam ma chad pas rgyud du gzhag pa 'di la dbye na gsum ste/ krī ya/ u pa/ yo ga'o/ /dang po la'ang gzhi/ lam/ 'bras bu/ de dag gi rang bzhin nges par byed pa/ rgyud sde'i rnam grangs bstan pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni (1) legs par sbyar ba'i sgra las/ krī ya ste lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor byed pa'i don la tan+t+ra ni rgyud sde 'brel ba can du 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'di'i grub mtha' kun rdzob 'khrul par snang ba 'di dag sbyang bya dri ma'i chos te/ don dam dbyings kyi rang bzhin sbyang gzhi bden pa dbyer med la 'jug pa'i ngo bo rtogs par bya ba'i gzhir byed de dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i lha khas len to/ / gnyis pa lam la kun rdzob tu snang ba thams cad lha drug gi rang bzhin du shes pas/ yi dam gyi lha ye shes sems dpa' rje dang*/ bdag dam tshig sems dpa' khol gyi tshul du bsgrub cing*/ don dam par ma skyes pa'i chos nyid 'od gsal ba la 'jug go /lha drug gi tshul la snang tsam lha'i sku sgyu ma ltar gsal bas/ gcig dang du ma'i mtha' la mi gnas te/ snang ba gzugs kyi lhar grol ba'o/ /gsung yig 'bru sgra'i lhar gsal bas grag stong bzlas pa'i 'khor lo zam ma chad de yi ge'i rang bzhin du grol lo/ /thugs phyag mtshan la dmigs pas dran bsam ting nge 'dzin du gsal te/ rnam rtog bsam gtan gyi lhar grol ba'o/ /'phro 'du sku mdog tu gsal bas spro bsdu 'od kyi lhar grol te yig 'bru ye shes kyi ngang du grol lo/

/gsal ba bzhugs tshul gyi lha gdan khri cha lugs su gsal bas gang snang gzhal yas khang par grol lo/ /grol ba ye shes kyi lha snang srid chos skur gsal bas spang bya ye shes su grol lo/ /de bzhin du yul drug la mngon par zhen pa drug grol bas/ snang ba gzugs kyi lha la sogs pa drug tu shes pas nyon mongs pa sbyong bar byed do/ /gsum pa 'bras bu ni gnas skabs su lta ba dang ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan gong nas gong du thob cing*/ mthar thug mi tshe bcu drug na lha'i skur sangs rgya bar 'dod pa yin te/ rdo rje lhun po ri rab zom gyi rgyud las/ gang dag sngags pa skal bzang che/ /gtsang sbra dag pas dag brtson pa/ /de tshe bcu drug skye ba na/ /rnam grol ye shes mchog la reg / ces so/ /de'ang grogs spyod pa dkar gsum za ba dang*/ gos gsum brje ba dang*/ khrus dang kun tu spyod pa la sogs pa gsar mar 'dod pa dang gcig go / bzhi pa nges byed rgyud sde'i rnam grangs dgod pa ni rgyal blon snga dar gyi tshe slob dpon chen po zhi ba 'tsho dang*/ pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ bi ma la mi tra la sogs pas paṇ+ḍi ta bgyis/ bai ro tsa na dang*/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra dang*/ rma rin chen mchog dang*/ a tsār+ya ye shes dbyangs la sogs pas lo tsā ba bgyis te/ phyi nang gi rgyud sde mang du bsgyur ba la/ dang po bya ba'i rgyud kyi krī ya spyi'i rgyud drug la/ rigs sngags thams cad kyi khog 'bubs pa dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud/ rigs sngags thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ rigs sngags thams cad kyi gsang ba bstan pa rig pa mchog gi rgyud/ rigs sngags thams cad kyi 'dul ba bstan pa su si ti ka ra legs par grub pa'i rgyud/ rig sngags thams cad kyi 'phrin las ston pa khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud/ rig sngags thams cad kyi dgongs pa ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud do/

/bye brag gi rgyud la rigs gsum gyi spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la/ pad+ma rtse mo sngags kyi rgyud/ pad+ma cod pan gyi rgyud/ cho ga sngags kyi rgyud/ yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud/ a mo gha pā sha'i rgyud/ gnod sbyin gar mkhan gyi rgyud/ kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i rgyud/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyud la sogs pa'o/ / 'jam dpal gyi skor la/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' dri ma med pa'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal rnon po sgrib pa med pa'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal dra ba spyod pa'i rgyud/ bstod pa glur blangs pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /phyag na rdo rje'i skor la/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud/ drag po gsum 'dul gyi rgyud/ rdo rje be con gyi rgyud/ rdo rje rnon po'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /las phran tshegs kyi rgyud la/ gzungs gra lnga dang*/ 'od zer can dang*/ rnam par rgyal ma dang*/ mdzod spu nor bu la sogs pa'i gzungs phran dpag tu med pa'o/ /gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud u pa ya tan+t+ra la'ang*/ spyod pa krī ya ltar gtsang sbra dag par spyod cing*/ lta ba yo ga ltar spyod pas gnyis ka rgyud kyi theg pa zhes bya ste/ gzhi lam 'bras bu rnams bya ba dang rnal 'byor rgyud du 'byung ba bzhin no/ /khyad par du sgom pa lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang dam tshig pa'i mdun du lha ye shes sems dpa' spun nam grogs ltar bsgoms pas dngos grub skye ba bdun na len pa'o/ /nges 'byed kyi rgyud sde la rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud/ me klong 'bar ba'i rgyud/ dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ / gsum pa yo ga tan+t+ra ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces bya ba ste/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ nges par 'byed pa'i rnam grangs dang gsum las/ dang po ni sgom pa ting nge 'dzin yid kyi las gtso bor ston cing*/ lus ngag gi spyaud pa grogs tsam du ston pas/

dngos grub bsgrub pa'o/ /de'ang kun rdzob tu lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ dpal mchog gcig pu'i rang bzhin gyis/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' la lha ye shes sems dpa' 'og min nam rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs pa bstim ste/ 'phro 'du 'od kyi dra ba la sems bzung nas bzlas pa bya ste/ rjes la ye shes pa gshegs par byed do/ /brtul zhugs des mi tshe gsum na grol ba grub par 'dod pa'o/ /dbye na ting nge 'dzin gtso bor byed pas bsgrub pa dang*/ las gtso bor byed pas bsgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sbyor ba dang yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon byang lngas bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa bsgom pa'o/ /de'ang bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom par byed pa na/ gdan nyi zla la brten nas byang chub pa ni/ pad+ma'i dbus su nyi zla bsgom pa ni thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin mtshon pa'o/ /thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa ni/ de'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang*/ ral gri dang 'khor lo la sogs pa bsgoms te/ rigs so so'i cha mtshon par byed pa'o/ /sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ni de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa so so'i lhar gsal ba ni/ mdzad pa chen po yongs su ston pa'o/ /gsung yig 'bru la brten nas byang chub pa ni/ ā li kā li'i 'khor lo ste/ lha so so'i gsung gis nam mkha'i dbyings su grag par bsgoms te bzlas pa ni/ gsang ba chen po'i 'khor lo bskor ba'o/ /rnam dag ye shes sems dpa'i sgo nas byang chub pa ni/ rang nyid dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bstim nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob par byed pa'o/ /de ni dbyings ye shes gnyis su med pa'i mtshon byed do/ /de ltar lnga ni sangs rgyas pa'i tshe 'og min du phun sum tshogs pa lnga nye bar 'byung pa'i mtshon byed du 'byung
