mu tig phreng ba las/ e ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyon/ /de nyid rnam par bshad bya ba/ /don gyi rgyud dang tshig gi rgyud/ /ces pas/ gzhi rig pa'i gnas lugs kun la khyab par yod pa ni don gyi rgyud yin la/ de mtshon cing nyams su len pa'i thabs yan lag dang bcas pa ste  sdai tshan (1) so sor bstan pa ni tshig gi rgyud do/ /dang po don gyi rgyud/ de'i rnam grangs dbye na thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ rang bzhin gyi rgyud gnyis te/ de nyid las/ gsang ba'i rgyud kyi thabs dang ni/ /rang bzhin ji lta bu gcig la/ /zhes so/ / dang po ni dbyings kyi don mtshon (2) byed ston par byed pa'o/ /dbye na mtshon bya thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ mtshon byed thabs kyi rgyud gnyis te/ de nyid las/ gzhi gcig ngo bo'i khyad par las/ /mtshon bya dang ni mtshon byed do/ /zhes so/ /de'ang brjod bya don gyi rnam spyi de mtshon bya'o/ /de'i yin tshul 'byed pa mtshon byed de don dang tha snyad la zer ro/ /de'ang rang rig 'od gsal kun khyab chen po ni mtshon bya'i rgyud de/ de nyid las/ mtshon bya rgyud gcig kun khyab pas/ /thams cad de yi rjes su 'brang*/ /zhes so/ /ji ltar khyab na/ dbyings stong pa ka dag chos nyid dang*/ ye shes snang pa lhun grub chen po dbyer med pa'i tshul gyis khyab ste/ de nyid las/ khyab pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /stong pas khyab dang gsal bas khyab/ /ces so/ /mtshon byed ni de nyid rtogs par byed pa'i thabs su gyur pa/ khregs chod ye grol chen po dang*/ thod rgal 'od lnga rang snang sgron ma dang bcas pa rang chas su ye nas yod pa'i cha la btags te/ mu tig phreng ba las/ thabs zhes khyad par nyid kyang ngo*/ /gang zag blo yi bye brag gis/ /rim pa ji ltar bshad bya ba/ /'bad rtsol med par rang grol dang*/ / 'bad bcas nyams su blang ba'o/ /zhes pa nas/ de ltar mtshon byed thabs kyi rgyud/ /rang gi rgyud la

(1) ma skyes (2) rdzogs/ /mtshon par byed pas thabs yin te/ /rgyun du gnas pas rgyud ces bya/ /zhes pa'i bar du gsungs so/ /de'ang thabs de dag don dang 'du 'bral med par ye nas rang chas su yod pa las/ rdo rje 'chang gis yod pa la yod par gzigs shing gsal bar gsungs pa tsam las/ gshis rig pa la med pa gsungs pa ni med de/ rig pa 'bad med cog gzhag thabs ye grol khregs chod dang*/ 'od gsal rang snang thod rgal du gnas pa goms pas grol nges su gnas pa ye yod phyis gsal bar byas pa tsam mo/ /de ltar bstan pa'i mtshon bya'i ngo bo dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pas khyab pa yin la/ nges tshig de las khyab pa'i phyir na rgyud ces bya'o zhes so/ /dbye na stong pa dang gsal ba gnyis so/ /mtshon byed thabs kyi ngo bo rtogs par byed pa'i thabs su gnas pa de/ de nyid las/ de dag mngon par rtogs pa ni/ / thabs zhes khyab pa nyid kyang ngo*/ /zhes so/ /nges tshig ni de las/ mtshon par byed pas thabs yin no/ /zhes so/ /dbye na 'bad bcas (3) thod rgal dang*/ 'bad med khregs chod gnyis te de nyid las/ 'bad rtsol med par rang grol dang*/ /'bad bcas nyams su blang ba'o/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa rang bzhin gyi rgyud kyi ngo bo ni rig pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od sgron ma dang bcas pa ste/ de nyid las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rgyud kyi snying po rab tu dbye/ /'khor dang 'das pa gang gis kyang*/ /'di nyid shes pa ma yin te/ /mi 'byed rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ /rang rgyud mtshon pa'i gzhi gcig pa'i/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gcig /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ /zhes so/ /dbye na gsum ste/ gzhi'i rgyud/ snying po'i rgyud/ bcud kyi rgyud do/ /de nyid las/ rang bzhin rgyud ni 'di lta ste/ /gzhi dang snying po bcud nyid do/ /zhes so/ /dang po gzhi'i rgyud kyi ngo bor rang byung gi ye shes/

thog ma'i 'od gsal snying po ni/ gdod ma'i mgon po/ 'od mi 'khrugs pa/ dbyings rnam dag mar me mdzad/ 'od mi 'gyur ba zhes btags pa stong gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes de yin no/ /dbye na ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum ste/ de nyid las/ gzhi ni ngo bo rang bzhin dang*/ /thugs rje kun la khyab cing 'char/ /ces so/ /snying po'i rgyud kyi ngo bo ni snying ga'i 'od gsal gdangs phyir snang dang bcas pa ste/ de nyid las/ snying po rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin rgyud/ /snang ba thams cad rgyud yin te/ /thams cad thams cad 'brel zhing chags/ /rang bzhin tsit+ta'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i snying po che/ /de phyir dril ba'i snying po ste/ /kun gyi srog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ /snying po'i rgyud ces rnam par bshad/ /ces so/ /dbye na nang gi snying po ye shes dang phyi'i snying po 'od gdangs so/ /bcud kyi rgyud kyi ngo bo snying po'i don  sbyor bas (1) mthong ba ste/ (2) phreng ba las/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i/ /ngo bo thams cad bcud phyung ba'i/ /snying po bsdus pas bcud ces te/ / stong gsal rig pa bcud du dril/ /ces so/ /dbye na gzhi'i bcud skur snang ba/ snying po'i bcud ye shes su gsal ba/ me tog gi bcud sgron ma bzhir shar ba ste/ de nyid las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bde gsang che/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog can/ /rang rig rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /ces so/ /legs par bsdus na/ bcud kyi rang bzhin gsum po 'dis grol ba'i cha tshang la ma nor bar ston pa'i phyir kun las 'phags te/ gser gyi me tog snying po las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi bcud bsdus nas/ /'gro ba kun gyi snying la bcug (1) /de yi snying po lu gu rgyud/ /dngas ma 'dus pas bcud ces bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ brtson pa don ldan gyi rgyud las/ bstan pa kun gyi yang bcud ni/ /chos nyid mngon sum lam zhes bya/

/zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ gzhi dang snying po me tog ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rang bzhin rgyud/ /khyad par gsang mchog bcud du dril/ /'di ni 'khor ba'i pha rol du/ /skyes bus mda' 'phangs ji bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rang bzhin gyi rgyud rnams gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi rang bzhin du gnas te mu tig 'phreng ba las/ gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu yis/ /gzung bar nges pas rang bzhin rgyud/ /ces so/ /gzhi'i rgyud rig pa/ lam gyi rgyud snang ba bzhi/ 'bras bu'i rgyud bcud dang rnam pa gsum mo/ /de'ang snying po rig pa'i ye shes la ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum du gnas pa ni dngas ma gsum yin la/ rig pa skur gsal ba/ dbyings kha dog tu gsal ba nam mkha' la dbyings rig gsal ba gsum ni gsal ba gsum zhes bya'o/ /gdeng gsum ni lta ba rang byung gi ye shes ye nas grol bas 'bad rtsol bya mi dgos pa'i gdeng*/ rang snang ye shes kyi yul sku dang ye shes su gsal bas zhing khams logs nas bsgrub mi dgos pa'i gdeng*/ 'khor 'das la re dogs dang spang thob bral bas sangs rgyas logs nas bsgrub tu med par thag chod pa'i gdeng ngo*/ /de'i tshe mi ldog pa gsum 'byung ba ni/ rig pa mi ldog pas skur smin/ snang ba mi ldog pas 'od gsal du grol/ rtog pa mi ldog pas ye shes su sangs rgyas pa'o/ /de dag gi dag bya dang dag byed kyi gzhi snang ba gsum dang stong pa gsum du 'dus te/ 'khrul snang*/ dag snang*/ bar do sgyu ma'i snang ba dang gsum ni/ da lta sems can spyi btsan la snang ba/ snang ba bzhi sbyangs na dag snang du 'gyur la/ ma sbyangs kyang bar dor 'od gsal gzhi'i snang ba 'char ba yin no/ /stong pa gsum ni dri ma sbyong ba snang ba bzhi'i gnas skabs te/ dang por chos min las ldog pas sgo gsum 'khrul pa las grol bas 'khrul pa stongs/ de nas chos su 'dzin pa'i dri ma stongs te rlung lnga dbyings su dgade nas phyi nang 'od gsal du grol bas phra rags kyi 'byung rkyen stongs pa'o/

/de skad du mu tig phreng ba las/ de yang bcud kyi rang bzhin ni/ /snying po bsdus pas dngas ma gsum/ /gsal ba gsum dang shes pas khyab/ /gdeng gsum mi ldog gsum gyis ni/ /bcud mi 'gyur ba'i nges pa thob/ /snang ba gsum dang stong pa gsum/ /bcud ni rang bzhin dag pa yis/ /rgyud du gtan la phab pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar thabs kyi rgyud/ rang bzhin gyi rgyud/ so so'i rnam dbye mang po bshad kyang rang byung gi ye shes gcig gi ngo bo la brtags nas so sor ldog pas phye ba yin gyis/ don tha dad du 'gyur ba med de/ gshis kyi yin lugs kyi steng nas rang bzhin gyi rgyud/ mtshon bya don gyi rgyud/ gzhi'i rgyud ces brjod la/ de dag gi yin tshul nyams len gyi don ye nas rang byung gi ye shes nyid la gnas pa'i cha nas/ thabs kyi rgyud/ mtshon byed kyi rgyud/ bcud kyi rgyud ces pa la sogs pa btags kyang*/ mi gcig la ming mang po btags pa na (1) ming mang por byung yang don gcig las ma 'das pa lta bu ste/ de nyid las/ gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu yis/ /gzung bar nges pa rang bzhin rgyud/ /de phyir rgyud ces 'brel pas grub/ /rang bzhin babs kyis grub pas na/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi rgyud ces bya/ /gzhi gcig ngo bo'i khyad par las/ /thabs dang rang bzhin rgyud ces ni/ /btags pa tsam du der snang kyang*/ /ngo bo gzhi gcig rang bzhin stong*/ /tha dad ma yin 'gyur ba med/ /dper na skyes bu gang zhig la/ /ming ni mang po yod gyur pa/ /gang nas bos kyang der snang ltar/ /'gyur med don kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /don gnyis pa tshig gi rgyud kyi rim pa bshad pa la brgyad de/ ngo bo (2) dbye ba/ sdud tshul/ go rims sam so so'i don/ dgos ched/ bshad thabs/ ma bu nges pa'i kha byang bstan pa'o/ /dang po rgyud kyi ngo bo tshig don 'brel bar snang ba bkod pas gang zag gi shes rgyud grol ba'o/

/ nges tshig ni ming tshig yi ger brjod cing gsal ba'o/ /dbye ba la rnam pa bco brgyad de/ rgya mtsho lta bu'i rgyud rig pa rang shar/ nyi ma lta bu'i rgyud rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long*/ seng ge lta bu'i rgyud seng ge rtsal rdzogs/ ri rgyal lta bu'i rgyud yi ge med pa/ 'khor lo lta bu'i rgyud bkra shis mdzes ldan/ lde mig lta bu'i rgyud sgra thal 'gyur/ ral gri lta bu rgyud kun tu bzang po thugs kyi me long*/ gsal shing lta bu rgyud sgron ma 'bar ba/ gser zhun lta bu'i rgyud nor bu 'phra bkod/ ma bu 'brel pa lta bu'i rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor/ me long lta bu'i rgyud ngo sprod spras pa mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu'i rgyud mu tig phreng ba/ sbrul mdud lta bu'i rgyud rig pa rang grol/ khyung chen lta bu'i rgyud klong drug pa/ chu bo lta bu'i rgyud rdzogs pa rang byung*/ spu gri lta bu'i rgyud nag mo khros ma/ rgyal po lta bu'i rgyud sku gdung 'bar ba/ bang mdzod lta bu'i rgyud rin chen spungs pa'o/ /de skad du'ang mu tig phreng ba las/ rgya mtsho dang ni nyi ma dang*/ /seng ge dang ni ri rgyal dang*/ /'khor lo dang ni lde mig dang*/ /ral gri dang ni gsal shing dang*/ / gser zhun dang ni ma bu 'brel/ /me long dang ni mu tig brgyus/ /sbrul mdud dang ni khyung chen dang*/ /chu rgyun dang ni spu gri dang*/ /rgyal po dang ni bang mdzod dang*/ /de dag rnam par phye bas ni/ /tshig rgyud gsal bar byed pa'o/ /de yi don rnams rnam dbye bas/ /ngo bo nyid kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ /ces so/ /rgyud de dag so so'i don gyi chings sdud tshul gyi sgo nas bshad pa ni rang shar rang grol/ yi ge med pa gsum ni (1) rgyud kyi snying po gsum ste/ rje 'bangs 'dzoms pa lta bu'o/ /nor bu 'phra bkod me long gnyis te gsum ni rgyud kyi dngas ma gsum ste rgyud thams cad kyi don mthong ba ri rgyal gyi rtser phyin pa lta bu'o/

/mu tig phreng ba seng ge rtsal rdzogs bkra shis mdzes ldan gsum ni rgyud kun gyi dgongs don zab mo gsal bas me tog gsum ste nyi ma gsum shar ba lta bu'o/ /rdzogs pa rang byung gi rgyud ni rgyud kun gyi sdom 'dus pa gcig ste mkhar gyi rming rdo lta bu'o/ /ngo sprod spras pa ni dpe don gsal bas snang ba gting nas rdzogs pa ste/ mkhar rtse sgron me lta bu'o/ /nyi zla kha sbyor ni bar dor grol bas ye shes g.yul bzlog ste skar khung btod pa lta bu'o/ /rin chen spungs pa dang*/ sku gdung 'bar ba ni rgyud kyi ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i yan lag ste ba gam lta bu'o/ /sgron ma 'bar ba ni nyams len gsal bas rnal 'byor grol ba'i rgyud de rgyal po pho brang gi rtser bzhugs pa lta bu'o/ /klong drug pa ni dgongs pa drang thad du ston pas snying dang 'dra zhing mtshan 'dzin gyi dmag mi 'jug pas sgo bcad pa lta bu'o/ /thal 'gyur ni rang gi grub pa'i mtha' gsal zhing pha rol gyi rgol bas mi tshugs pas gsang ba rang gzhung ste lcags ri lta bu'o/ /nag mo khros ma ni 'gal byed tshar gcod pas mtshon cha lta bu ste sgo srungs go zhubs can lta bu'o/ /de skad du'ang mu tig phreng ba las/ rgyud kyi snying po gsum shes na/ /rgyal blon 'bangs gsum 'dzom pa 'dra/ /rgyud kyi dngas ma gsum shes na/ /ri gsum rtse mor phyin pa

'dra/ /rgyud kyi me tog gsum shes na/ /mkha' la nyi ma gsum shar 'dra/ /rgyud kun sdom gcig shes pa na/ /mkhar gyi 'gram rdo legs tshugs 'dra/ /snang ba gting rdzogs rgyud shes na/ /rtse mor 'byongs pa'i mkhar dang 'dra/ /ye shes g.yul bzlog rgyud shes na/ /phyogs bzhir skar khung btod pa 'dra/ /yan lag rgyud chen gnyis shes na/ /ngos bzhir ba gam btags pa 'dra/ /rnal 'byor grol ba'i rgyud shes na/ /rgyal po mkhar gyi rtser bzhag 'dra/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i rgyud shes na/ /de la sgo mo dam bsgrigs 'dra/ /gsang ba rang gzhung rgyud shes na/ /mtha' ma lcags ris bskor ba 'dra/ /mtshon cha lta bu'i rgyud shes na/ /go zhubs ldan pa'i sgo srungs 'dra/ /zhes so/ /rgyud de dag gi go rims don gyichings nges pa'ang (1) de nyid las/ de la rgyud kyi rims pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud chen rnam gnyis kyi/ /chos kun ngo bo gcig par bshad/ /bshad rgyud ma bu gnyis kyis ni/ /lo 'dab rgyas pa'i tshul du bshad/ /yan lag rgyud ni gnyis dag gis/ /rgya mtshor gza' skar shar bzhin bshad/ /lung rigs gsal ba'i rgyud gnyis kyis/ /me tog kha phye'i tshul du bshad/ /man ngag rgyud sde bzhi yis ni/ /'bras bu smin pa'i tshul du bshad/ /dgongs pa rang gnas rgyud gsum gyis/ /mthong byed mig gi tshul du bshad/ /'jug pa rang grol rgyud gnyis kyis/ /dran gzhi snying gi tshul du bshad/ /mkhas pa cho ga'i rgyud kyis ni/ /mel tshe byed pa'i khyi ltar bshad/ /ces so/ /de'ang rdzogs pa rang byung rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga la brten nas phyi spros bcas (2) kyi dbang gis spros pa la dga' ba rnams smin par byed/ yi ge med pa'i rgyud le'u drug pa la brten nas smin zin grol bar byed pa'i man ngag gi gnad rdzogs par bstan pas rtsa ba'i rgyud chen gnyis pos chos thams cad ngo bo dbyer med du bshad pa'o/

/rig pa rang shar le'u brgyad cu rtsa drug la brten nas lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi'i brjod bya khyad par gsal bar byed la/ rig pa rang grol le'u dgu ba la brten nas dmigs bsal bar byed de/ de ltar bshad rgyud ma bu gnyis kyis shing lo 'dab rgyas pa ltar bshad do/ /rin chen spungs pa le'u lnga pas yon tan rang rdzogs su bstan pa dang*/ sku gdung 'bar bas rtags rnams bstan pa ste/ yan lag gi rgyud gnyis kyis rgya mtsho la gza' skar shar ba ltar bshad do/ /sgra thal 'gyur le'u drug pas sde snod kun gyi rtsa bar bstan pa dang*/ bkra shis mdzes ldan le'u bdun gyis 'khrul pa bzlog tshul ngos bzung ste/ lung rigs gsal ba'i rgyud gnyis po des me tog kha phye ba'i tshul du bshad do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long gi rgyud le'u brgyad pas ngo sprad pa dang dbang dang dam tshig gi man ngag bstan/ kun tu bzang po thugs kyi me long le'u bdun pas gol sgrib shan 'byed du bstan/ ngo sprod spras pa le'u gsum pas dpe don gyi yid ches bskyed pa bstan/ mu tig phreng ba le'u brgyad pas man ngag tha dad pa'i thabs kyis grol bar bstan te/ de ltar man ngag gi rgyud chen bzhis 'bras bu smin pa'i tshul du bshad do/ /klong drug pa klong (1) drug gis rigs drug gnas su dag par bstan/ sgron ma 'bar ba la le'u bzhi pas sgron bzhi bstan/ nyi zla kha spyor le'u bzhi pas bar do bstan te/ de ltar dgongs pa rang gnas kyi rgyud gsum gyis mthong byed mig gi tshul du bshad do/ /seng ge rtsal rdzogs le'u bcu gsum pas lta ba phyogs ris med par bstan/ nor bu 'phra bkod le'u bcu bzhi pas lam srol (2) du 'jug par bstan te/ de ltar 'jug pa rang grol gyi rgyud gnyis pos dran gzhi snying gi tshul du bshad do/ / mkhas pa cho ga'i rgyud dpal nag mo khros mas bstan pa srung pa'i las rgyas par bstan te khyi bzang pos mel tshe byed pa ltar bshad do/

/de ltar sde tshan brgyad du rgyud bco brgyad bsdus te bshad pa ni dgongs pa'i dbang gis bzhag go /de'ang rtsa ba'i rgyud gnyis med na sdong po rtsa ba rul bas yal ga lo 'bras mi 'byung ba dang 'dra'o/ /bshad rgyud gnyis med na/ lo ma med pas me tog 'ong mi srid pa dang 'dra'o/ /yan lag gi rgyud gnyis med na lag rdum gyis bya ba mi 'grub pa dang 'dra'o/ /'jug pa rang grol gyi rgyud gnyis med na snying med pa'i ro dang 'dra'o/ /lung rigs gsal ba'i rgyud gnyis med na me tog med pas 'bras bu mi 'byung ba dang 'dra'o/ /man ngag gi rgyud bzhi med na 'bras bu mi 'byung ba la so nam byas kyang don med pa dang 'dra'o/ /dgongs pa rang gnas kyi rgyud gsum med na mig med kyis snang ba mi mthong ba dang 'dra'o/ /mkhas pa cho ga'i rgyud med na mel tshe med pas dgra rkun 'ong ba dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar don tshan brgyad med na bstan pa gcig gi cha rkyen ma rdzogs la/ de bas mang yang dgos pa med pas brgyad du grangs nges shing don gyi go rims nges pa'i 'thad pa'ang de yin no/ /de dag so so'i don la zug pa rtsa ba ltar bshad pas rtsa ba rang byung gi ye shes su 'dus pa la dgongs/ rgyas pa lo 'dab ltar bshad pas tshig don 'dres pa la dgongs/ yan lag ni 'dril ba sdong po ltar bshad pas dbyings rig gnyis med la dgongs/ lung rigs ni gsal ba me tog ltar bshad pas sgron ma'i rang ngo mngon sum du 'dzin pa la dgongs/ man ngag ni smin pa 'bras bu ltar bshad pas sku gsum lam du byed pa la dgongs/ dgongs pa rang gnas grol lam mthong byed ltar bshad pas mngon sum gnad la dgongs/ 'jug pa rang grol ni dran rig lam du slong bas sgron ma rang ngo sprod pa la dgongs/ mkhas pa cho gas ni bstan pa bsrung ba la dgongs te/ de ltar dgongs tshul brgyad kyis rdzogs par bshad pa'o/ / de dag gi 'bras bu ni rtsa ba rig pa la 'dus la/

rig pa stong pa ngos gzung dang bral ba'o/ /rgyud de nyid rang rig tu bzung bas ye shes dang ngo 'phrad/ bcangs pas ting 'dzin rang la gnas/ /bklags pas brjod bya sems la 'char/ /bshad pas rang gzhan gyi dgos 'dod skong*/ bsgoms pas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs/ mnyan pas snying po'i don la reg pa'o/ /bshad rgyud lo 'dab rgyas pa lta bu ni tshig gi spros pa la brten nas spros med kyi ye shes skye ba'o/ / yan lag gi rgyud kyi tshogs drug yul snang la sgo lnga cer grol du ston pa rgya mtshor gza' skar shar ba lta bu'o/ /lung rigs gsal bas rgyal ba'i lung dang yang dag pa'i rig pa rnal 'byor pa'i shes rgyud la sbyor ba me tog kha phye ba lta bu'o/ / man ngag gi rgyud kyis tshig don gyi spros pa gnad thog tu chod pas sangs rgyas pa 'bras bu smin pa ltar ro/ /dgongs pa rang gnas kyis thun mtshams las 'das pa'i dgongs pa nyin mtshan chu bo'i rgyun du byed pa mig dang 'dra'o/ / 'jug pa rang grol ni snang ba la rig pa zhugs dus/ snang ba rang thog tu grol bas 'jug pa rang sangs/ rig pa snang thog tu grol bas rang shar rang grol/ snang sems gnyis med du grol bas gnyis med phyogs yan de snying dang 'dra'o/ / mkhas pa cho ga'i rgyud kyis ma mo'i gnad nges pas 'gal byed cham la phebs te rang phyogs bsrung ba mel tshe byed pa'i khyi ltar byung ba'o/ /de ltar sde tshan brgyad po'i don yid la bzung bas ye shes dang ngo phrad/ bcangs pas ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ bklags pas mthar thug gi don go bshad pas rang gzhan gyi mun pa sel/ bsgoms pas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skam/ nyan pas nges pa'i don la reg pa'o/ /de dag kyang blo dman pa spros pa la dga' ba'i ngor rnam pa bco brgyad du bstan la/ 'bring po rnams la don tshan brgyad po der bstan zhing*/ dbang po rab la mtshon bya thabs kyi rgyud dang mtshon byed gnyis/ gzhi rang bzhin gyi rgyud dang*/

snying po rang bzhin gyi rgyud gnyis/ bcud rang bzhin gyi rgyud dang lngas rtogs par bstan to/ /shin tu yang rab rnams la tshig gi rgyud dang*/ don gyi rgyud gnyis kyis rtogs par bstan to/ / rab tu spros pa med pa rnams la rgyud bcu bdun po rang gi rig pa la tshang bar bstan to/ /sgra thal 'gyur las/ rang gi ngo bo yi ge med/ /rang rig ye shes sgron 'od 'bar/ /chos nyid dag pas bkra shis mdzes/ /lta ba 'jigs bral seng rtsal rdzogs/ /rang rig smin pas rdzogs rang byung*/ /lu gu rgyud 'brel mu tig phreng*/ /nyams kyi snang ba nor 'phra bkod/ /rang snang ston pas snying me long*/ /gol sa rang chod thugs me long*/ /gzhan las ma byung rang shar nyid/ /rang byung yin pas rang grol la/ /dbyings su gcig pas klong yang drug /yon tan rdzogs pas rin chen spungs/ /rang rig bstan pas ngo sprod spras/ /snang ba dag pas nyi zla sbyor/ /rig pa smin phyir sku gdung 'bar/ /'di dag rnams kyang gzhi las shar/ /'di ltar chos nyid brjod med las/ /tha dad tshig gi gzhi mar shar/ /tshig brjod rim pa rnam dag pas/ /da lta brjod med ngang la rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rgyud sde de dag gi dgos ched ni rig pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ dgos pa'i don ni 'di lta ste/ /rig pa ye shes gtan la phebs/ /de yi dgos pa bstan pa la/ /rgyud lung man ngag thams cad mthun/ /'di yis yang dag grol ba'i phyir/ /dgos ched gnyis su bstan pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i tshig rgyud dag 'chad pa na bshad thabs kyi man ngag la chings chen po lnga/ yan lag bzhi bshad par bya'o/ /chings lnga ni nyi zla kha sbyor las/ lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /rtsa ba don gyis ma bshad na/ /chos rnams rig par mi 'dus pas/ /mtha' yas pa yi skyon du 'gyur/ /yo ga don gyis ma bshad na/

/theg pa'i ru shan mi phyed pas/ /che chung rim pa don med 'gyur/ /tshig gi don gyis ma bshad na/ /rgyud rnams rim par gsal ba'i tshig /'bru mi choms pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /dgos ched don gyis ma bshad na/ /rdzogs chen bya rtsol med pa la/ /don med pa yi skyon du 'gyur/ /ces so/ /yan lag bzhi ni rig pa rang grol las/ khyung chen mkha' lding lta bu'i blos/ /don gyi khog rnams phub ste bshad/ /stag mo'i mchongs stangs shes rab kyis/ /don gyi sa chen bcad de bshad/ /rus sbal nur 'gros lta bu'i blos/ / yi ge'i 'bru rnams choms par bshad/ /mu tig bstar brgyus lta bu'i blos/ / man ngag don du bsdebs te bshad/ /ces pas/ don gyis khog 'bubs/ dkyus kyis sa bcad/ tshig gis don bshad/ man ngag gi don bsdus pa dang bzhi'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i chings kyis bshad de/ thun mong ma yin pa/ thun mong gi gleng gzhi ni phun sum tshogs pa lngas mdor bstan pa dang*/ lung dngos rgyas par bshad pa ste/ ston pa dang*/ chos dang*/ dus dang*/ 'khor dang*/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de'ang thun mong pa rnams las/ gleng gzhi gang rung gcig las mi 'byung la/ 'dir gzhi rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba chos dbyings don gyi 'og min du rang byung gi rig pa 'pho 'gyur med pas blang ba dang dor ba med pa'i rang bzhin ston pa 'di skad bdag gis bstan cing bshad pa'i dus na zhes 'byung la/ tshig gi rgyud de nyid gnas gang du byung bas nyams su len pa da ltar ba'i dus mtshon la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes gleng gzhi gnyis su bka' stsal ba yin no/ /de dag gis ma bu nges pa'i kha byang la rig pa rang shar la/ bshad pa'i yang tig de'i bsdus don sgra don bsdus yig sgra gnas 'khor lo/ de'i rgyab yig de bsdus dpe'u chung ste/ ma bu bdun bzhugs so/ /snying gi me long la/ gzhung don 'grel pa/

gsang ba'i don bsdus/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu bzhi'o/ /seng ge rtsal rdzogs la/ bshad tig chen po/ mtshams sbyar lde mig le'u'i mtshan bshad/ don skor bsdus pa/ dgongs pa'i ti ka dmigs sel bdun pa/ lta ba'i gzer bkod/ de'i rtags yig gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu bcu'o/ /yi ge med pa la/ pad+ma kha 'byed/ don bsdus sgron ma/ gsang ba'i zhal chems/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu lnga'o/ /bkra shis mdzes ldan la/ 'khrul gzhi gsal ba'i me long*/ 'khrul pa'i sdebs yig chen po/ sgron ma 'dus pa/ de nyid don bsdus/ lhun grub yi ge ka dag yi ge 'khor lo drug rim/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu dgu'o/ /thal 'gyur la/ 'byung bzhi'i gnad yig sgra bzhi mtshams sbyor/ rin chen sgron ma/ don bsdus yang snying*/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu drug go /thugs kyi me long la/ theg pa'i ru shan/ smra ba'i mtshon cha/ 'phra rgyud dril ba/ sgron ma 'od 'bar/ de nyid bsdus don te ma bu drug go /sgron ma 'bar ba la/ sgron ma'i khungs gcad (1) /mu tig phreng brgyus/ don bsdus yang tig gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu lnga'o/ /nor bu 'phra bkod la/ 'phra bkod bcu pa/ phyag rgya 'dus pa/ lha'i phyag sor/ snang ba bsdus pa/ rin chen bkod pa/ don bsdus chen po ste ma bu bdun no/ /nyi zla kha sbyor la/ 'od kyi tshul bshad/ rin chen gser 'phreng*/ don bsdus lde mig snying gzer chen po/ rin chen gser yig ste ma bu drug go /ngo sprad spras pa la/ ngo sprod gsum pa/ ye shes lag sprad/ sku gsum lag khrid/ 'od gsal lde mig ye shes lnga skor/ rig pa'i me tog gsal ba'i sgron ma/ bdud rtsi yang zhun/ rim pa drug pa/ snang ba bsdus pa/ lta ba'i dmigs sel/ khregs chod bdun pa (2) ste ma bu bco lnga'o/ /mu tig phreng ba la (3) / mu tig gsal byed/ de nyid don bsdus/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu bzhi'o/

/rig pa rang grol la/ yi ge'i sbyor bshad/ rin chen 'khor lo/ de nyid bsdus don te ma bu bzhi'o/ /rdzogs pa rang byung la/ dbang gi rtsa ba/ dbang gi dag byed/ 'khor lo drug pa/ dbang gi las byang*/ dbang gi phra tig dbang bkod chen po/ spros med go cha/ dbang gi lde mig /dbang gi pra khrid/ don bsdus gsal byed/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu bcu gnyis so/ /klong drug pa la/ klong chen drug pa/ rin chen gsal 'phreng*/ de'i don bsdus/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu bzhi'o/ /sku gdung 'bar ba la/ pad+ma klong yangs/ bkod pa lnga pa/ babs lugs bcu gcig sgron ma 'phreng bkod/ de nyid don bsdus/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu bdun no/ /rin chen spungs pa la/ shes rab 'khor lo/ dgos 'dod bzhi pa/ gcod byed me lce/ de'i bsdus don/ gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu drug go /nag mo khros ma la/ thun drug dril ba/ thun gyi brgyud ( 1 ) dril/ sngags kyi nang them/ bsnyen sgrub/ spyi 'dus/ de'i rtags yig de'i tshad yig bsam grub le'u/ rdzas sgrub drug pa/ sku rkyang sgrub pa/ sna tshogs las sgrub/ gsang (2) ba'i ti ka gsang ba'i rgyab yig ste ma bu bcu gsum mo/ / de ltar gsang chen nges pa'i rgyud bcu bdun khros ma dang bcas pa la/ rtsa ba ma rnams ni rgyud dngos yin la/ bu rnams ni rig 'dzin so sos mdzad pa'i bshad tig yin te/ bsdoms pas rgyud ma bu nges pa'i kha byang zhes bya ba yin no/ / don gnyis po

(3) yang zab (4) man ngag gi nges 'byed la gnyis te/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'o/ /dang po ni shin tu zab pa'i po ti bzhir rin po che'i yi ge lnga bsdus te kha byang nyi mas brgyan par bstan pa'i rim pa la/ gser yig can la bstan pa'i bu gcig mchod pa'i dus gnad nges pa/ 'das rjes 'dren (5) dang ma bu dgu'o/ /zangs yig can la/ spros bcas dum bu bcu drug de'i rgyab yig gsang ba/ gnad yig dang ma bu bco brgyad do/ /dung yig can la/ sgron ma snang byed/ de'i rgyab yig gnad yig dang ma bu gsum mo/ /'phra yig can ni zangs yig can gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i bu rnams te/ rlung gi pra khrid/ chags pa'i pra khrid/ yang gab sbas pa'i dum bu tshad kyi yi ge rtags kyi yi ge dang lnga'o/ /g.yu yig can la/ skabs don bcu gnyis ma/ gces pa'i snying po/ dpe'i sgron me/ 'chi ba brtag pa ka 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis 'di gsum mdzad / 'chi ba bslu ba ka shṝ seng has mdzad/ lta bu'i snying po ka ye shes mad ོ/ ka bi ma las rin chen pra khrid dang ma bu bco brgyad do/ /de'ang po ti bzhi la/ rin po che'i yi ge lnga zhes bya'o/ /de'ang gser yig can/ g.yu yig can/ dung yig can gsum la re re/ zangs yig can dang 'phra yig can bsdoms pas gcig ste bzhi gter nas byon pa'o/ /'di dag rgyal blon rje 'bangs su la'ang ma gnang bar mchims phur gter du gdams so/ /rgyud dang man ngag gzhan rnams/ rje mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan dang*/ sras mu ne btsan po gnyis/ 'bangs nyang ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gsum ste lnga'o/ / 'di dag gis bsgyur te zhwa lha khang du gter du gdams nas/ nyams su blangs pas nyang gis lhag med grub/ gzhan gnyis po rang bzhin sprul pa grub pa yin no/ /rgyus la mi mkhas pa dag rje blon gnyis las su la'ang ma gnang zhes pa'i tshig gis rgyal po dang nyang gnyis las med par 'dod pa ni shin tu mi rigs te/

rgyud lung phal cher ska cog gis bsgyur zhing*/ bcud du (1) ma 'phrul du (2) ma/ mu ne btsan pos zangs yag brag la sbas pa'i phyir/ snying tig ma thob na de dag ga la 'ong*/ yi ge rnams phal gyi mjug na 'di ltar bkod pa la ce re long du song ba yin no/ /gnyis pa rgya che ba la man ngag brgya dang bcu dgu ste/ de'ang man ngag dum dum khrig dang*/ po ti smug chung dang*/ 'khrul gzhi gsal ba'i me long dang*/ 'byung gzhi gnad kyi yi ge dang*/ snang byed sgron ma dang*/ 'od gsal lde mig dang*/ shes bya bum skor dang*/ gsar (3) ba'i sgom (4) byang dang*/ sgra brtags 'khor lo dang*/ sku gsum lag khrid dang*/ babs lugs gsum (5) skor dang*/ 'khrul ba'i sdebs yig dang*/ gsang thig chen po dang*/ gser byang bkol pa dang*/ lam khrid chen po dang*/ ye shes lag 'phrad dang*/ dka' 'grel chen mo/ gsang ba'i me long*/ bsam gtan rang gnas/ gsang ba ( 1 ) nyi (2) khol/ snang ba bsdus pa/ gnas pa byung khungs/ khregs chod bdun pa/ thod rgal dgu pa/ klong chen drug pa/ spyod lam bsdus pa/ lta ba'i gser bkod/ pad+ma klong yangs/ lha'i phyag sor/ gser gyi ut+pal/ dran pa rgyun gcod/ rags pa lam slong*/ gsal ba'i sgron ma/ seng ge rtsal sprugs/ a ti rnal 'byor/ dgongs don bzhi pa/ rdo rje lam bstan/ lhag pa'i 'khor lo/ khyung chen mkha' lding*/ lta ba'i dmigs bsal/ bla ma'i rim pa/ drang ba'i tshig rgyun/ 'khrul gzhi rtsad gcod/ sems kyi dmigs drug sgom pa'i 'khor lo/ dbang gi lde mig dbang gi las byang (3) / spros med dbang chog dbang gi rtsa ba/ dbang gi rigs 'byed/ dbang gi 'phra tig 'khor lo drug pa/ dam tshig rab 'byed/ dbang dgod chen mo/ dbang sbyor pra khrid/ rig pa'i me tog sems lung chen po/ man ngag rtsa ba/ lung tig bco brgyad/ rim pa drug pa/ sems lung sgom khrid/ yang gsang dril ba/ sbas pa nyi ma/ 'phra bkod bcu pa/ lung tig bsdus pa/

bdud rtsi yang zhun/ lung gsum 'dus pa/ man ngag rgyal po g.yu yig can/ dung yig can/ zangs yig can/ 'phra yig can/ gser yig can/ snying gzer chen po/ snying gzer chung ba/ bsam gtan nyal ba'i 'khor lo/ 'phrul yig chen po/ 'phrul yig chung ba/ mkha' 'gro mdzod/ 'pho ba chen po/ rtsa gnas 'khor lo/ rig pa'i sa 'byed/ ye shes sbug 'jug lo rgyus chen po/ gsang ba'i zhal chems/ theg pa'i ru shan/ gsang ba'i sgra yig sgra bzhi mtshams sbyor/ bstan pa'i go cha/ 'gyur med thig le/ dngos po kha bsgyur/ 'bras bu mngon byed/ thi bya tshang 'jug gsal ba rin chen/ lhun grub ye shes/ shes rab 'khor lo/ smra ba'i mtshon cha/ ye shes lnga skor/ 'od kyi tshul bshad/ 'byung ba'i gnad 'byed/ sgron ma khungs gcod/ phyag rgya 'dus pa/ bkod pa lnga pa/ rgya mtsho ar gtod rlung gi sdom sbyang*/ ngo sprod gsum pa/ babs lugs bcu gcig rtsa thig chen po/ rig pa'i gnas sa/ mig gi bsam gtan te brgya dang drug dang*/ pad+ma kha 'byed la sogs pa/ rgyud kyi don gsal ba'i gnas man ngag tu mi the ba bcu gsum dang*/ bsdoms pas brgya dang bcu dgur bzhugs so/ / de'ang rgyud kyi (1) bur bgrangs kyang rgyud bcu bdun bka' srungs dang bco brgyad las med do/ /bur bgrangs (2) pa de dag man ngag gi rnam grangs te rgyud kyi man ngag gsang ba yin no/ /kha cig phyis bi ma las kha skong bar 'dod pa ni/ rtog dpyod rtsings pa yin no/ /'di dag gis ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste mtshan tsam bkod pa las/ so so'i dum bu'i grangs ni man ngag ma bu nges pa'i kha byang nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i zab pa dang rgya cha ེ(3) 'i man ngag gis yi ge rnams kyi don tshig nyung la gnad 'dus par bstan pa ni theg mchog rin po che'i mdzod rim khang nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang*/ tshig don rin po'i che'i mdzod rdo rje'i gnas bcu gcig pa dang*/ chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod le'u bcu gsum pa dang*/

gnas lugs rin po che'i mdzod rdo rje'i gnas bzhi pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro yang tig dngos grub ljon shing chos sde lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa dang*/ zab mo yang tig chos sde bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa dang*/ kho bos bsdebs pa'i yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i chos sde lnga bcu rtsa gcig par shin tu gsal bar byas te phyi rabs skal ba dang ldan pa'i don du smon lam gyi gtad rgya dang bcas pa yid bzhin bsam 'phel du byas pa'o/ /gzhan yang gnad 'thor bu ba'i yi ge gser gyi sgrom bu dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang*/ khyung chen gshog rdzogs dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ bdud rtsi bum pa dang*/ yang gsang snying tig la sogs pa grangs mang bar bkod pa'i kha byang gi rjes su/ ming gi rnam grangs du ma sbyar ba yod de/ klong chen rab 'byams dang*/ klong gsal dri med dang*/ rdo rje gzi brjid dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ dri med 'od zer dang*/ blo gros mchog ldan dang*/ tshul khrims blo gros dang*/ ngag gi dbang po dang*/ pad+ma las grol dang*/ sna tshogs rang grol dang*/ bsam yas pa zhes bya bas rdzogs tshig gi gnas su bstan pa'o/ /'di dag smos pas kho bo'i man ngag yin pa btsal sla ba ste/ skal ldan gyi slob ma spro ba bskyed cing chos kyi tshul dar zhing rgyas pa yun ring du gnas pa'i mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur 'dzugs pa'i che ba lhun gyis grub pa yin no/ /theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa grub mtha' rin po che'i mdzod las yid bzhin drwa ba rdo rje snying po'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de ltar chos tshul shin tu rgya che sa gsum 'byor ba dam pa'i gzhi/ /mdo rgyud yid bzhin snying pos legs 'byor bdag blo'i khang bzang rin chen nas/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i dga' ston 'gyed pas chos bkra'i dge legs gsal ba can/ /de yis 'gro kun thar pa'i gling bgrod chos kyi dga' ston 'phel bar shog

/zab yangs thos sprin snying po las 'thon pa/ /chos dkar dge ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i nyon mongs gdung sel zhing*/ /dam chos rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /blo gros chu 'dzin thos pa'i glog gi 'phreng ba can/ /don zab 'brug sgra phyogs kyi mthar khyab sgrogs pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba zhi bde bsil ba'i tshogs mang pos/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun tshogs gnyis lo thog rnams 'phel shog /bdag blo'i pad tshal skal bzang nyi zer gyis bskul bas/ /ches bkra'i chos tshul rang gzhan grub mtha'i skyed mos tshal/ /shin tu bkod legs blo gsal nyer 'tsho'i bsti gnas 'dir/ /don gnyer 'gro ba kun 'ga'i dus ston 'phel bar mdzod/ /rin chen chu mtsho me tog gis bkram ma lus 'dod gter rol pa can/ /rgya che gting zab nam mkha'i klong khyab blo mtsho'i pha rol phyin rnams kyis/ /lam ldan der zhugs cha shas gsal ba'i rang bzhin 'dir ni snang byas pa/ /gang de dpal ldan pad+ma'i phrin las legs par 'ongs gyur nor ba med/ /rang gzhan kun gyi grub mtha' rin chen mdzod/ /rgya chen thos pa'i dga' ston dang ldan pa/ /gsung rab rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig ste/ /mthong ba tsam gyis don kun gsal bar byed/ /tshul 'di chos mos lhag pa'i shes rab can/ /skal bzang slob ma gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyis/ /bskul ba'i don du legs par bkod pa yin/ /'di ni mdo rgyud blta ba'i me long ste/ /zab cing rgya che'i don kun gsal bar byed/ / chos tshul rin chen snang ba rgya che zhing*/ /thar gling ma lus kun nas snang byed yin/ /'di ni sna tshogs theg pa'i mdzod khang ste/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i don kun gsal bar byed/ /ma rig ldongs pa'i mun pa rab sel zhing*/ /shes bya'i blo mig rab tu rgyas byed yin/ /'di ni bla med theg pa'i snying po ste/ /mchog dang dman pa'i bye brag legs shes nas/

/blo chen ldan rnams chos can mchog zhugs te/ /myur du thar pa'i grong khyer bgrod byed yin/ /de phyir dpag med legs pa'i lam 'di sngon gyi drang srong chen po'i lugs/ /mkhas grub klu dbang nyer bsten las 'ongs mang thos rgya mtsho'i gling gnas pa/ /dri med 'od zer kun nas snang ldan theg mchog snying po'i rnal 'byor pas/ /legs sbyar rin chen bsam 'phel mdzod 'di 'gro blo'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur mdzod/ /gling bzhi brgyan gyur 'jig rten nyi zla'i 'od/ /rab gsal dkyil 'khor gang bas mdzes byas pa/ /de yi dpal dang rin chen mdzod 'di gnyis/ /yun ring 'jig rten brgyan phyir gnas pa yin/ / theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa grub mtha' rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi gnas mdo dang*/ rgyud dang*/ lung dang*/ rigs pa dang man ngag gi don la mang du thos shing theg pa sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i tshul khong du chud pa'i theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis rang byung pad+ma'i gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (15)theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa grub pa'i mtha' rin po che'i mdzod/ - PAGE 334 -- PAGE 335 -- PAGE 1 - PAGE \# "'页：'#' '"
